company_description: Builds liquid rocket engines as an independent supplier, including the Hadley (small launch class) and Ripley (medium-lift) engines. Customers include ABL Space Systems, Stratolaunch, and Phantom Space; growing hypersonic and defense propulsion lines.
co_investors: Woodline Partners, Principia Growth, XN, Alsop Louie Partners; +$50M debt
robotnik_take: Rocket engine and propulsion component manufacturer (metal 3D-printed engines). $100M Series E from Eclipse continues strong growth trajectory. Competes with Aerojet Rocketdyne (now L3Harris) and SpaceX in propulsion. Watch for Ursa Major engines powering first orbital launch vehicle.

company_description: French designer of neuromorphic AI processors for edge computing applications. Competes with Intel Loihi, BrainChip, and SynSense in neuromorphic chips.
co_investors: Maverick Silicon, PhotonVentures, Verve Ventures, Elaia, Earlybird, OVNI
robotnik_take: Designs neuromorphic AI processors for edge computing applications. €18M seed from MIG Capital is strong for French fabless semiconductor. Competes with Intel (INTC) Loihi, BrainChip, and SynSense in neuromorphic chips. Watch for first tapeout and benchmark comparisons with conventional edge AI chips.

company_description: Builds Dexter, a smaller, mobile surgical robot for ambulatory surgery centers, designed to compete with Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci on cost and footprint. FDA-cleared for gallbladder removal, hysterectomy, and hernia repair.
robotnik_take: Dexter surgical robot designed for cost-effective minimally invasive surgery, competing with ISRG.

company_description: Designs silicon photonic interconnect chips for AI data center networking. Backed by CapitalG (Alphabet) as a strategic investor; competes with Ayar Labs, Lightmatter, and Broadcom in optical interconnect.
co_investors: Sutter Hill Ventures, Valor Equity Partners, Atreides Management, Maverick Silicon
robotnik_take: Silicon photonics interconnect chipmaker for AI data centre networking. $100M Series B led by CapitalG (Alphabet) signals strategic importance for Google's AI infrastructure. Competes with Ayar Labs, Lightmatter, and Broadcom (AVGO) in optical interconnect. Watch for design wins with hyperscaler customers.

company_description: French in-orbit servicing company offering life extension for geostationary satellites through rendezvous and docking. Competes with Northrop Grumman MEV and Astroscale in commercial satellite servicing.
co_investors: EIC Fund, IRDI, Newfund, Balnord
robotnik_take: In-orbit servicing and life extension for geostationary satellites. €44M Series A extension positions Infinite Orbits for first mission deployment. Competes with Northrop Grumman's MEV and Astroscale in satellite servicing. Watch for first GEO client contract and mission execution.

company_description: Develops the industry's first power-delivery chiplet that integrates voltage regulation directly into processor packages. First chiplets manufactured at TSMC; claims around 50% reduction in total compute power.
co_investors: Pat Gelsinger (ex-Intel CEO)
robotnik_take: Industry's first power delivery chiplet that integrates voltage regulation directly into the processor package, reducing total compute power by 50%. First chiplets produced by TSMC.

company_description: French developer of inkjet printing equipment for next-generation semiconductor interconnect patterning. Targets a subset of patterning applications previously addressed by lithography, with surgical-level precision in selective deposition.
lead_investors: KBC Focus Fund, Cap Horn, Bpifrance
co_investors: Elaia Partners, Sensinnovat, Beeyond, French Tech Seed Fund, EIC Fund

robotnik_take: Robotics-as-a-service for truck loading; cuts 30-60 min loads to 5 min. Fortune-500 customers (John Deere, GE Appliances, Valeo, Nissan) validate RaaS model in logistics. No infrastructure modification = fast deployment.

robotnik_take: Maker of Ameca (entertainment/expressive humanoids); restructured as US entity to access US capital. Customers include MSG Sphere, Computer History Museum, GSK. Differentiated as social/interactive vs general-purpose humanoid pack.

co_investors: In-Q-Tel, Honda Xcelerator Ventures, JGC Group
robotnik_take: Munich-based lithium-ion battery recycler using a low-acid hydrometallurgical process; In-Q-Tel and Honda anchor a strategic round to bridge to a first-of-a-kind industrial plant scaling from 9 t/day toward 30,000 t/year by 2026.

company_description: Builds the ZAP-X gyroscopic radiosurgery system, a self-shielded stereotactic radiosurgery platform for cranial tumors. Targets hospital and clinic deployments without bunker-grade shielding requirements.
robotnik_take: Late-stage round to commercialize ZAP-X gyroscopic radiosurgery for cranial cancer. Lead by a Chinese strategic — likely paves path to China market entry.

company_description: Builds a first-of-a-kind synthetic graphite anode plant in Bainbridge, Georgia for US-domestic lithium-ion battery supply. Backed by a $117M DOE Bipartisan Infrastructure Law grant plus EXIM debt financing.
lead_investors: Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM)
robotnik_take: Non-binding letter of interest under EXIM's Make More in America program for up to $400M in debt to back a first-of-a-kind synthetic graphite anode plant; complements an earlier $117M DOE BIL grant and is structured as project debt with a minimum 10-year tenor.

company_description: French designer of mixed-signal semiconductor IP, including power management and audio IP cores. Carved out of Dolphin Design with Jolt Capital ownership; licenses IP to chip designers and ODMs.
robotnik_take: Carve-out of Dolphin Design's mixed-signal IP (power management + audio IP, ~60% of legacy revenue) into newly-created Dolphin Semiconductor; €26M committed by Jolt Capital. M&A-style transaction structured as growth investment.

company_description: Develops vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models that let general-purpose robots perform physical tasks from natural-language instructions. Sells the underlying control models to robot OEMs and integrators rather than building robots itself.
lead_investors: Jeff Bezos, Lux Capital, Thrive Capital
co_investors: OpenAI, Bond, Redpoint Ventures
robotnik_take: Foundation model play for general-purpose robotics; reached unicorn status months after founding. Investor list (OpenAI + Bezos + Lux/Thrive) signals belief that physical-AI is the next foundation-model frontier.

company_description: Korean L4 autonomous freight startup operating after Korea's first L4 freight permits were granted. Headquartered on Jeju Island and expanding to mainland Korean freight routes.
co_investors: Yuanta Investment, Korea Investment Partners, Murex Partners, Industrial Bank of Korea, iM Investment Partners, Friend Investment Partners, Korea Investment & Securities, NVestor
robotnik_take: Korean L4 autonomous freight startup; total raised KRW 55.2B. Series B comes after Korea's first L4 freight permits.

company_description: Builds shared-autonomy forklifts — robotic forklifts that combine automation with remote human supervision. Strategic backing from Qualcomm and Zebra Technologies; targets warehouse and distribution-center customers.
co_investors: Innovation Endeavors, Norwest Venture Partners, Qualcomm Ventures
robotnik_take: Autonomous reach forklifts with 'shared autonomy' (remote-takeover fallback) — pragmatic answer to long-tail edge cases. Toyota/Woven lead anchors material-handling vertical.

company_description: Develops fusion energy using pulsed magnetic compression, a single-shot approach distinct from steady-state tokamak or laser inertial designs. Stealth-emerged in October 2024; commercialization milestones tied to tranched funding releases.
co_investors: Andrew Forrest, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Eric Schmidt, John Doerr, Ken Griffin, Lachy Groom, Leitmotif, Lightspeed, Lowercarbon Capital, Mustafa Suleyman, Patrick Collison, Reid Hoffman, Richard Merkin, Trousdale Ventures
robotnik_take: Largest Series A in fusion history; pulsed magnetic approach with milestone-based tranches. Led by Hemant Taneja (General Catalyst). Investors: Andrew Forrest, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Eric Schmidt, John Doerr, Ken Griffin, Reid Hoffman, Mustafa Suleyman, Patrick Collison, Lightspeed, Lowercarbon Capital. Stealth-emerged Oct 2024.

company_description: Chinese lab and cleanroom automation company building robotic systems for biotech R&D — small molecules, cell and gene therapy, and diagnostics workflows.
robotnik_take: Lab/cleanroom automation for biotech (small molecules, cell/gene therapy, diagnostics). Vertical robotics aligned with China's biotech buildout.

company_description: Chinese ADAS and BEV vision software supplier for the automotive industry. Aptiv holds an 18% strategic stake, making MAXIEYE its primary China vision partner.
robotnik_take: ADAS / BEV vision software stack. Aptiv's 18% strategic stake makes MAXIEYE Aptiv's primary China vision partner. Cross-border auto-tech alignment despite geopolitical headwinds.

company_description: Builds autonomous yard trucks with integrated robotic arms for hooking and unhooking trailers at distribution centers. Deployed at customers covering about 20% of the North American yard-truck base.
co_investors: 8VC, ARK Invest, B37 Ventures, FM Capital, Interwoven Ventures, NVentures, Prologis Ventures
robotnik_take: Autonomous yard trucks with robotic arms — narrowly scoped autonomy problem with deployed customers covering ~20% of yard trucks in North America. Logistics-only autonomy is monetizing faster than over-the-road AVs.

company_description: Builds Tally, an autonomous shelf-audit robot that scans retail store shelves for inventory accuracy, planogram compliance, and pricing. Sells to grocery and big-box retailers as a vertical-specific complement to general-purpose AMRs.
co_investors: Eclipse, Valo Ventures
robotnik_take: Retail inventory robots (Tally) deployed at Albertsons, BJ's, ShopRite. Valuation 3x last round (July 2023). Goldman lead signals path to growth-equity / pre-IPO trajectory.

company_description: Builds robotic pizza-assembly stations for restaurant and food service customers. Targets QSR pizza chains and food-service operators.
co_investors: Unlock Venture Partners, Thursday Ventures, Flying Fish Ventures, Creative Ventures
robotnik_take: Robotic pizza-assembly stations. Niche food-service automation; scale-up round for North American rollout.

company_description: Operates a robotic third-party logistics (3PL) fulfillment stack — AI-powered pick robots running inside its own warehouses for e-commerce customers. Strategic partner with FedEx, which has integrated Nimble into FedEx Fulfillment.
co_investors: Cedar Pine
robotnik_take: Strategic round led by FedEx with simultaneous commercial agreement to scale FedEx Fulfillment on Nimble's 3PL stack — strong customer-led validation but raises lock-in concentration risk. Reached $1B valuation.

company_description: Autonomous driving arm of Chinese ride-hailing company DiDi (also known as DiDi Woya). Develops self-driving software for robotaxi services and partners with GAC on jointly produced autonomous vehicles for the Chinese market.
co_investors: Didi Chuxing
robotnik_take: DiDi's autonomous-driving arm (DiDi Woya) — strategic from GAC (Guangzhou Auto) supports robotaxi co-development. Total disclosed raise across 5 rounds >RMB 10B. Robotaxi capex remains heavily strategic-funded in China.

company_description: Danish manufacturer of a solar-powered autonomous sowing and weeding robot, with more than 500 units sold across 20 countries. Mechanical weed control replaces herbicide use for organic and conventional growers.
co_investors: EIFO, Navus Ventures
robotnik_take: Solar-powered autonomous sowing/weeding robot; >500 units sold across 20 countries. Reduces herbicide use by up to 100% — sustainability angle.

company_description: Builds the LaserWeeder, an autonomous farm implement that uses computer vision and high-powered lasers to kill weeds in row crops without herbicides. Sells to specialty-crop growers; claims significant cost reduction versus chemical weed control.
co_investors: NVentures (NVIDIA), Anthos Capital, Fuse Venture Capital, Ignition Partners, Revolution, Sozo Ventures, Voyager Capital
robotnik_take: Laser-weeding ag robot scaling internationally; total raised $157M. NVIDIA's NVentures participation signals continued GPU/edge-AI investment thesis around outdoor robotics.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robotics company spun out of Shanghai University of Science and Technology. Develops service and research humanoid platforms.
robotnik_take: Shanghai-University-of-Science-and-Technology spinout doing service/research humanoids. Investor list not publicly named in English-language sources — single-source flagged.

company_description: Operates a teledriving service in European cities — remote human drivers piloting electric cars to customers, who then drive themselves. Targets fleet operations as a pragmatic L2-bridge before full autonomy.
robotnik_take: €34M EIB venture-debt to deploy ~1,100 teledriven EVs across European cities through 2027. Teledriving is a pragmatic L2-bridge to autonomy — cuts the long-tail labor cost while keeping a human accountable.

company_description: Develops silicon photonic compute and interconnect products for AI and HPC workloads. Main products are Envise (photonic compute), Passage (optical interconnect for chiplets and racks), and Idiom (software stack). Targets the AI scale-up problem that NVIDIA NVLink and Broadcom Tomahawk address electronically.
co_investors: Fidelity Management, GV (Google Ventures), HPE Pathfinder
robotnik_take: Photonic compute / 3D-stacked photonics for AI interconnect; valuation 4x'd from $1.2B (Dec 2023) to $4.4B in 10 months — purest comparable for Celestial AI / Ayar Labs / Xscape benchmarking.

company_description: Develops the Polaris AI-enabled microsurgery robot for cataract removal. Targets one of the highest-volume surgical procedures globally; in pre-first-in-human development.
co_investors: Main Street Advisors, UC Investments
robotnik_take: AI-enabled microsurgery robot (Polaris) targeting cataract removal. Series A funding pre-FIH studies — early but high-volume procedure (cataract is one of most-frequent surgeries globally).

company_description: Operates the TeleFarmer platform, an autonomy retrofit kit that adds remote operation and automation to existing tractors and orchard equipment. Strategic investor Doosan Bobcat anchors industrial OEM distribution; targets specialty-crop and off-road customers.
co_investors: Rethink Food, Toyota Ventures, Allison Transmission, Black Forest Ventures
robotnik_take: Closes Series A at $32.8M total. Software/services layer that retrofits brand-name tractors into autonomy — capital-light ag-autonomy thesis vs vertically-integrated competitors.

company_description: Canadian AI-driven Rapid Alloy Design (RAD) platform for engineering new alloys and composites for aerospace, automotive, mining, and energy applications. Software-led materials discovery layer rather than a producer.
co_investors: Draper Associates, First Star Ventures, Hustle Fund Angel Squad
robotnik_take: AI-driven Rapid Alloy Design (RAD) platform for engineering new alloys and composites for aerospace, automotive, mining and energy applications; positions itself as a software-led materials discovery layer rather than a producer.

company_description: Manufactures silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors and wafers for electric vehicles, industrial, and energy applications. Operates one of the largest 200mm SiC fabs in Mohawk Valley, NY; public on NYSE (WOLF) and emerged from a 2025 Chapter 11 restructuring.
co_investors: The Baupost Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Capital Group
robotnik_take: Senior notes in three tranches; $250M available within 10 business days. Companion to CHIPS Act PMT — both sides bridge SiC capacity build but Wolfspeed's subsequent bankruptcy in 2025 underscored thin margins in commodity SiC. Public co (NYSE: WOLF).

company_description: Develops silicon photonic components — laser-based optical interconnects — for data center and telecom applications. Competes with Ayar Labs, Intel Silicon Photonics, and Cisco in integrated photonics.
co_investors: Altair, Cisco Investments, Fathom Fund, Kyra Ventures, LifeX Ventures, NVIDIA, OUP
robotnik_take: Multi-color programmable photonics for AI data-center fabrics; brings total to $57M. Cisco + NVIDIA participation makes it a dual-strategic round — both networking and accelerator incumbents hedging into co-packaged optics.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot developer spun out of Tsinghua University, building the Xing Xing humanoid platform. Alibaba is a strategic co-investor signaling hyperscaler interest in embodied AI.
co_investors: Orinno Capital, Lenovo Ventures, Century Golden Resources, Jinding Capital, Tsinghua Holdings' Tiancheng Ventures
robotnik_take: Tsinghua University spinout developing humanoid 'Xiao Xing'. Alibaba co-lead signals strategic interest from Chinese hyperscalers in physical AI. Date approximated to mid-October from Manufacturing Tomorrow article date.

company_description: German operator of a thermal-infrared earth observation constellation focused on wildfire detection. Sells data and analytics to forestry agencies, insurers, and emergency management organizations.
lead_investors: Korys, European Circular Bioeconomy Fund (ECBF), Bayern Kapital
robotnik_take: Thermal-IR EO constellation focused on wildfire detection; strategically positioned at the intersection of climate-tech and EO budgets, both attracting cross-over capital.

company_description: Builds ChipAgents — AI agents for RTL design, debug, and verification. Founded by a UCSB AI/LLM researcher; part of the AI-for-EDA category alongside Cognichip.
co_investors: Impact Assets, Amino Capital
robotnik_take: AI agents (ChipAgents) for RTL design, debug, and verification — part of broader AI-for-EDA category alongside Cognichip. Founded by UCSB AI/LLM researcher; thesis is 10x productivity for chip designers.

company_description: Builds AI-enabled robotic welding cells for fabrication shops, addressing the US labor shortage in skilled welding. Sells turnkey robotic welding systems combining vision, planning, and robot arms to manufacturing customers.
co_investors: Yamaha Ventures, Taiwania Capital, MediaTek, Catapult Ventures, Gaingels, Addition, Tiger Global, Basis Set
robotnik_take: AI-enabled welding cells targeting US labor shortage in fabrication. Total raised: $270M. Industrial robotics deal that combines verticalized hardware with manufacturing reshoring tailwinds.

company_description: French very-low-earth-orbit 5G non-terrestrial-network broadband startup. State-supported play targeting European sovereignty in direct-to-cell connectivity against Starlink and Kuiper. Later rebranded Univity.
co_investors: French Tech Seed (managed by Bpifrance)
robotnik_take: Heavily state-supported VLEO 5G NTN play; positions French sovereignty narrative against Starlink/Kuiper, but commercial proof points are years away.

company_description: Israeli developer of 4D LiDAR-on-chip products using proprietary Finite Coherent Ranging. Integrates laser, amplifier, and receiver on a single chip; competes with Aeva and other coherent LiDAR startups.
co_investors: Sapir Venture Partners, OurCrowd, Teramips Technologies, Beyond-Electronics, Howard Morgan (MFCIF), Israel Innovation Authority
robotnik_take: 4D LiDAR-on-chip with proprietary Finite Coherent Ranging — single-chip integration of laser/amplifier/receiver. Pure-play sensor semis play; competitive vs Aeva (AEVA) and other coherent lidar startups.

company_description: Swedish developer of aerial tree-harvesting drones that replace ground-based forestry equipment for selective tree removal. Backed in part by Swedish Energy Agency grant funding.
co_investors: Sveaskog, Kiko VC, CapitalT, Walerud Ventures, SEB Greentech VC, Cloudbreak VC, Swedish Energy Agency
robotnik_take: Aerial tree-harvesting drones — replaces ground-based forestry equipment. Includes €1.7M Swedish Energy Agency grant. Vertical-specific drone application beyond inspection/delivery.

company_description: Builds iron-air batteries for long-duration grid storage, using inexpensive iron as the active material to deliver 100-hour discharge at far lower cost per kWh than lithium-ion. Operating a gigafactory in Weirton, West Virginia with first commercial deployments in 2025.
co_investors: GE Vernova, TPG Rise Climate, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Capricorn Technology Impact Funds, Coatue, Energy Impact Partners, The Engine Ventures, NGP, Temasek, GIC, Prelude Ventures
robotnik_take: Iron-air long-duration storage developer using inexpensive iron metal as the active material; raise funds gigafactory ramp in West Virginia with first commercial deployments in 2025. Strategic collaboration MoU with GE Vernova accompanies the round.

company_description: Develops Z-pinch fusion using sheared-flow-stabilized plasma. Participating in the US Department of Energy's Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program; recently brought a demonstration system online.
robotnik_take: Z-pinch fusion; DOE Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program participant.

company_description: Operates a robotic factory producing timber-hybrid building components for residential and commercial construction. Achieves about 86% automation of the production process, treating buildings as manufactured products.
robotnik_take: Robotic factory for timber-hybrid building components (86% automation). Construction-as-manufacturing — robotics where buildings, not vehicles, are the unit of output.

company_description: Builds autonomous inventory drones for lights-out warehouses. Differentiated by an infrastructure-free deployment that requires no reflectors or beacons; competes with Verity, Gather AI, and B Garage.
robotnik_take: Autonomous inventory drones for lights-out warehouses. No infrastructure (no reflectors/beacons) is the wedge. Combined Series A + earlier seed total $18M.

company_description: Formerly Isotropic Systems. UK developer of multi-orbit user terminals — phased-array antennas that simultaneously track multiple satellites across LEO, MEO, and GEO orbits. Sells primarily to defense and government communications customers.
co_investors: Seraphim Space, AE Industrial Partners, Promus Ventures
robotnik_take: Defense-led round (formerly Isotropic Systems) to commercialise multi-orbit user terminals; reflects continued Pentagon appetite for resilient, multi-constellation comms hardware.

company_description: Swiss developer of a tilting-rotor industrial inspection drone capable of contact-based measurements on flare stacks, wind turbines, and other vertical infrastructure. Customers include Chevron, Holcim, and Acuren.
robotnik_take: Tilting-rotor drone for industrial inspection (flare stacks, wind turbines). B2B subscription model with Chevron/Holcim/Acuren as customers. Total raised $22M.

company_description: Caltech spinout building safety-supervisor middleware for autonomous robots — control-theory-based collision avoidance and geofencing software that integrates with existing autonomy stacks.
co_investors: Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund
robotnik_take: Caltech spinout building safety-supervisor middleware for autonomous robots — control-theory-based collision avoidance and geofencing. Software-only safety play; integrates with existing autonomy stacks.

company_description: Builds in-space transportation vehicles — the Mira orbital tug for last-mile satellite delivery and Helios kick stage for direct-to-GEO transfers. Founded by former SpaceX propulsion lead Tom Mueller; targets commercial and national security in-space mobility.
co_investors: Lux Capital, Spring Tide, DCVC, Airbus Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Balerion Space Ventures, RTX Ventures, Tamarack Global, 137 Ventures, Elysium, First Principles Group, Island Green, Overmatch, Trousdale Ventures
robotnik_take: Final private round before the long-telegraphed RISC-V IPO; NVIDIA strategic + Atreides lead reads as IPO syndicate forming. Comp framing is brutal: ARM (ARM) at >100B market cap is the public reference, and SiFive is being priced as the RISC-V challenger but with a fraction of ARM's design-win base and zero of its mobile-monopoly economics. Strategic argument is sovereignty — Chinese, European, and US export-control-sensitive customers all need a credible non-ARM option. SiFive IPO will be the cleanest read on whether RISC-V clears as an investable category.

company_description: Builds shelf-scanning autonomous robots that map warehouse inventory in real time and reconcile against the WMS, producing a continuously updated digital twin of stock locations. Sells to logistics operators and 3PLs.
co_investors: Latitude Ventures, Wave-X, Bootstrap Europe, Atomico, Lakestar, Capnamic
robotnik_take: Mix of equity and growth debt; UK-based warehouse inventory platform expanding to US with GXO/Maersk/DB Schenker deployments. Round signals enterprise traction beyond pilot phase.

company_description: Designs wafer-scale AI processors and the systems that ship around them, including the CS-3 supercomputer and on-premises and cloud inference offerings. The wafer-scale approach packages an entire silicon wafer into a single chip with 900,000+ cores, targeting large-model training and inference workloads.
robotnik_take: Discounted Series F-1 raise authorized concurrent with IPO filing at $14.66/share, a 47% markdown from the 2021 Series F price. Effectively a down-round bridge underscoring the gap between G42-driven hardware sales and broader market traction.

company_description: Designs wafer-scale AI processors and the systems that ship around them, including the CS-3 supercomputer and on-premises and cloud inference offerings. The wafer-scale approach packages an entire silicon wafer into a single chip with 900,000+ cores, targeting large-model training and inference workloads.
co_investors: UBS Investment Bank, Wells Fargo Securities, Mizuho, TD Cowen
robotnik_take: Filed S-1 with SEC for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker CBRS at ~$4B implied valuation. The filing exposed extreme customer concentration (G42 was ~83% of 2023 revenue), triggering CFIUS review and a multi-year delay; relevant signal for monitoring AI chip equity capital markets risk.

company_description: Italian in-space logistics company operating the ION Satellite Carrier orbital transfer vehicle, which delivers smallsats to precise orbits after rideshare launches. Also developing in-orbit servicing and space-edge computing capabilities.
co_investors: CDP Venture Capital, Seraphim Space, Indaco Venture Partners, Neva SGR, Primo Ventures, Avantgarde, Iberis Capital, European Innovation Council Fund, Terna Forward
robotnik_take: Eur50M extension closes Series C at Eur150M total. Marubeni gains Southeast Asia distribution rights extending earlier Japan exclusivity. Funds in-orbit servicing and space cloud computing build-out.

company_description: Builds a handheld robotic device for ultrasound-guided needle placement, FDA 510(k)-cleared for commercial use. Targets a much larger procedure TAM than capital-intensive surgical robot platforms; chaired by Fred Moll of Intuitive Surgical.
co_investors: Lux Capital, PFM Health Sciences, Fred Moll
robotnik_take: Handheld robot for ultrasound-guided needle placement with FDA 510(k) already in hand — de-risked on regulatory and reimbursement. Fred Moll involvement is the dominant signal in surgical robotics; targets a much larger TAM than capital-intensive da Vinci-style systems.

company_description: Develops L4 autonomous trucking software targeting the Houston-San Antonio commercial freight corridor. Founded by TuSimple co-founder Xiaodi Hou; pursues a capital-light approach versus Aurora and Plus.
co_investors: Cherubic Ventures, EnvisionX Capital, First Star Ventures, Linear Capital, M31 Capital, Taihill Venture, Uphonest Capital, Welight Capital
robotnik_take: Founded by ex-TuSimple co-founder Xiaodi Hou; second-generation autonomous trucking play targeting Houston-San Antonio commercial freight in 2025. Capital-light approach vs Aurora/Plus suggests a different go-to-market thesis on autonomy unit economics.

company_description: Recycles rare-earth permanent magnets from end-of-life EV motors, wind turbines, and hard drives using its Mag-Cycle process. Operates Hub100, a first commercial demonstration facility, as a circular alternative to primary rare earth mining.
co_investors: BDC Capital Climate Tech Fund, Hitachi Ventures, Zero Infinity Partners, Climate Investment, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, Fifth Wall, BMW i Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, Planetary Technologies
robotnik_take: Closed-loop rare earth recycling for magnets used in EV motors and wind turbines. Significant corporate strategic syndicate (Microsoft, Hitachi, BMW) signals industrial offtake intent rather than pure financial bet.

company_description: UK developer of accelerated physics simulation software for robotics training, founded by former NVIDIA simulation engineers. Provides foundation-model training infrastructure for embodied AI companies.
co_investors: Factorial Funds, Samsung Next, Tru Arrow, Xora (Temasek), IQ Capital, Koro Capital, Concept Ventures, Lakestar Scout Fund
robotnik_take: Ex-Nvidia simulation engineers commercializing accelerated physics for robotics training. The picks-and-shovels layer to the foundation-model boom (Skild et al.) is becoming investable on its own.

company_description: Specialty foundry in Bloomington, Minnesota producing power and analog semiconductors. Now US-majority-owned after Niobrara/Prysm took control from Sanken and Allegro; recipient of a CHIPS Act award to expand domestic capacity.
robotnik_take: Niobrara/Prysm closed $175M equity to take majority control, converting Polar from captive Sanken/Allegro fab to independent US-owned merchant foundry. Closed concurrent with the first finalized CHIPS Act binding award ($123M); the catalyst that unlocked total ~$525M project capital.

company_description: Specialty foundry in Bloomington, Minnesota producing power and analog semiconductors. Now US-majority-owned after Niobrara/Prysm took control from Sanken and Allegro; recipient of a CHIPS Act award to expand domestic capacity.
co_investors: Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development
robotnik_take: First binding CHIPS Act commercial fabrication facilities award. $123M direct funding plus $75M from Minnesota Forward Fund anchors expansion of 200mm analog/power/sensor capacity. Sets the legal-binding template for subsequent Q4 2024 finalizations.

company_description: MIT spinout producing low-carbon cement using an electrochemical process at ambient temperature, bypassing the high-emissions calcination step of conventional Portland cement. Strategic partner Siam Cement provides industry validation.
robotnik_take: Combined $75M strategic equity from the world's two largest cement producers (CRH, Holcim), plus binding offtake reservation. Sublime's electrolytic process produces zero-emission cement at ambient temperature. Validates electrification of structural-material production.

company_description: Builds the Vector reconnaissance UAS — a fixed-wing vertical-takeoff drone for tactical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. Sells to European militaries including the German Bundeswehr; active in Ukraine in combat use.
co_investors: Existing investors
robotnik_take: Series B extension brings total round above €100M. Porsche SE participation is meaningful — German industrial money pivoting into defense/dual-use after Zeitenwende. VTOL drone form factor competes with Wingtra commercially and Helsing on defense. Note: also has Nov-25 Series C extension entry.

company_description: UK Scottish developer of AI-powered food packing robotics. Has packed over 1 million bags in production at food processors; backed by Scottish National Investment Bank.
co_investors: Mercia Ventures, WA Capital
robotnik_take: AI-powered food packing robotics with state-bank-led growth funding (Scottish NIB). Niche food-picking automation but already 1M+ bags packed proves operational maturity. Vertical-AI robotics thesis hitting in less-obvious geographies.

company_description: Building a constellation of orbital mirrors designed to redirect sunlight to terrestrial solar farms during the early morning and evening hours when solar power is otherwise unavailable. Sequoia's first space investment since SpaceX.
co_investors: Baiju Bhatt, Keller Rinaudo, Keenan Wyrobek
robotnik_take: Sequoia's first space investment since SpaceX. Building constellation of orbital mirrors to redirect sunlight to terrestrial solar farms. Heterodox thesis — closer to in-orbit services per scope but novel adjacency.

company_description: Builds FAA-approved electric autonomous aircraft for agricultural spraying and military cargo delivery. Commercial customers include Dole and Embraer; defense customers include Sierra Nevada and Skyports.
co_investors: Piva Capital, Prelude Ventures, Metaplanet Holdings, Y Combinator
robotnik_take: Dual-use FAA-approved electric autonomous aircraft — already commercially flying (Dole, Embraer, Sierra Nevada, Skyports). The defense/agriculture wedge with revenue today is rare; commercial-ag traction provides the manufacturing scale defense customers need.

company_description: Spanish operator of a 5G IoT non-terrestrial network (NTN) constellation targeting 100 satellites. Provides standards-based satellite IoT connectivity to telecom operators and direct enterprise customers.
co_investors: Hyperion Fund, Sociedad Espanola de Transformacion Tecnologica (SETT), European Investment Bank (debt)
robotnik_take: Eur30M Series B round (Eur10M lead from GPI, Eur13.8M from Spain's SETT, Eur30M EIB debt facility separately announced). Funds 100-sat 5G IoT NTN constellation; commercial service Q1 2025.

company_description: Korean force-torque sensor manufacturer for collaborative robots and humanoid platforms. CJ Logistics and POSCO are strategic investors anchoring deployment-led demand from Korean conglomerates.
co_investors: POSCO Investment, CJ Logistics, Samsung Next, GS Ventures, DSC Investment, BNK Venture Investment, Kolon Investment, FuturePlay
robotnik_take: Force-torque sensor specialist — the unsexy but critical layer for cobots and humanoids. CJ Logistics and POSCO participations indicate deployment-led demand from Korean conglomerates. Sensor-component plays often outperform full-stack at scale.

company_description: Builds autonomous surface vessels across four size classes from 14 to 100 feet for US Navy and DoD missions. Backed by In-Q-Tel; competes with L3Harris and Textron in unmanned maritime systems.
co_investors: Outlander VC, The Veteran Fund, BV.VC, Decisive Point, Alumni Ventures, New North Ventures
robotnik_take: Low-cost-attritable USV play — a Saronic-lite at the seed stage. Cluster of US ASV startups in 2024 (Saronic Series B, HavocAI seed, Maritime Robotics) reflects DoD's surface-vessel autonomy gap.

company_description: French developer of software-only 3D-vision robot guidance, sold as a plug-in to industrial robot arms. Customers include Ford, Whirlpool, Thyssenkrupp, and Atlas Copco; Exor (Agnelli/Stellantis vehicle) is a strategic investor.
co_investors: MIG Capital
robotnik_take: Software-only 3D-vision robot guidance; Exor (Agnelli/Stellantis vehicle) lead implies strong auto-tier-1 deployment. Customer list (Ford, Whirlpool, Thyssenkrupp, Atlas Copco) shows real industrial traction at Series A.

company_description: Swedish manufacturer of GaN-on-SiC epitaxial wafers using its proprietary QuanFINE structure. Supplies wafers to telecom, aerospace, and defense customers; Wallenberg-backed Navigare is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Wafer Works, RFHIC, Ignite Innovation, BRV Capital Management, Lifelike Capital
robotnik_take: Swedish GaN-on-SiC epitaxial wafer specialist; QuanFINE structure differentiates vs conventional buffer layers. Wallenberg-backed Navigare leading expansion of capacity for telecom/aerospace/defense GaN demand. Notable cross-border syndicate (Sweden, Taiwan, Korea, US).

company_description: Builds liquid and solid rocket motors as an independent propulsion supplier, including the Lynx solid rocket motor. Joint US Navy investment supports domestic SRM production capacity. (Same company as Ursa Major; this row covers government investment.)
lead_investors: DoD Office of Strategic Capital, US Navy
robotnik_take: $12.5M from OSC Transition Acceleration Program matched 1:1 by Ursa Major (total $25M) for Lynx solid rocket motor manufacturing. Includable as Government investment per scope (not a contract for delivered services). Borderline propulsion subsector; classified as Space Components.

company_description: Israeli developer of robotic piece-picking systems using a hybrid gripper combining vacuum, adhesive, and finger gripping. ZIM Ventures (shipping line) is a strategic investor.
co_investors: InNegev, Fusion VC, Israel Innovation Authority, ZIM Ventures
robotnik_take: ZIM Ventures (corporate VC of major shipping line) participation hints at maritime-supply-chain pull-through for piece-picking. Hybrid gripper approach (vacuum + adhesive + finger) is technically differentiated vs Covariant/Berkshire Grey single-gripper bets.

company_description: Builds high-altitude platform station (HAPS) airships for stratospheric connectivity and earth observation. Saudi-backed; positions stratospheric platforms as an alternative to LEO satellites for regional connectivity.
robotnik_take: Saudi-led round at $525M pre-money valuation; amount undisclosed. HAPS (high-altitude platform) airships positioned as alternative to LEO comms for connectivity and EO. Subsector flagged uncertain — closer to satcoms but technically stratospheric platform.

company_description: Designs and manufactures CPUs, AI accelerators, and other semiconductors, and operates Intel Foundry to provide leading-edge fabrication services to external customers. Public on NASDAQ (INTC); CHIPS Act awards including a Secure Enclave program for US government and defense use.
lead_investors: U.S. Department of Defense / U.S. Department of Commerce
robotnik_take: Up to $3B finalized binding award for Intel's Secure Enclave program to manufacture leading-edge semiconductors for US government/defense use. Separate from Intel's broader $7.86B commercial CHIPS award (finalized November 2024). Reflects DoD-Commerce convergence on trusted foundry policy. Public co (NASDAQ: INTC).

company_description: Beijing-based developer of research-grade humanoid robots at a price point below $5,000. Targets the research and education market, backed by Beijing municipal robotics funds.
lead_investors: Piwan Times, MinBank International, Zhongguancun Science City, iCANX Fund
co_investors: Inno Angels (existing)
robotnik_take: RMB 100M Pre-A for sub-$5K research-grade humanoid. Beijing state ecosystem (Zhongguancun) backing reflects municipal robotics funds (Beijing's $1.4B robotics fund launched Jan 2024) deploying capital. Research/edu market is differentiated vs industrial humanoid plays.

company_description: Chinese autonomous mobile robot (AMR) manufacturer for warehouse and logistics applications. Exporting to Europe, Southeast Asia, Japan, and Korea alongside Geek+ and Hai Robotics.
lead_investors: Golden Oriole Capital, FarGlory Group, Wuxi Liangxi Technology Innovation Fund, Weifang Yuanfei Industrial Fund
robotnik_take: Largest Chinese AMR raise of Q3; over $100M USD primarily for international expansion (Europe/SEA/JP/KR). Quicktron, Geek+, and Hai Robotics are now the three Chinese AMR exporters competing with Western incumbents on price.

company_description: Operates a global commercial telescope network and provides space domain awareness and satellite-tracking products to the US Space Force and commercial constellation operators.
robotnik_take: Venture debt to scale space situational awareness operations following 2024 Series A2 equity round and acquisitions of Numerica's SDA division and Seradata. SSA pure-plays best fit Ground Systems given ground sensor network underpinning.

company_description: Norwegian manufacturer of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) for offshore HSE, survey, and environmental monitoring. Civilian USV focus distinct from defense-aligned peers like Saronic and HavocAI.
co_investors: Umoe, Holta Invest, employees and existing shareholders
robotnik_take: Norway's leading USV maker with growth capital led by Nordic cleantech (NRP Zero) and the state climate fund. The 'civilian' USV thesis (offshore HSE/survey) parallels but is distinct from Saronic/HavocAI defense ASV bets.

company_description: Develops the AutoDrive autonomous ground vehicle stack for military logistics and combat support vehicles. Sells autonomy kits and retrofits to the US Army and allied ground forces.
lead_investors: Moore Strategic Ventures, XYZ Venture Capital, Hedosophia
co_investors: Standard Investments, Enlightenment Capital, Crescent Cove Advisors, Four More Capital
robotnik_take: Dual-use autonomy stack already on DoD program of record (ROGUE Fires) — revenue is real, not vaporware. Kalmar partnership for autonomous yard trucks adds civilian leg. 2.5x oversubscription reflects the defense-AV thesis being hot.

company_description: Designs high-speed interconnect ICs targeting 112-448 Gb/s lane speeds for AI and hyperscale data center applications. Competes with Marvell, Astera Labs, and other AI-networking silicon suppliers.
co_investors: Canaan Partners, Wing Venture Capital
robotnik_take: High-speed interconnect IC startup targeting 112-448 Gb/s lane speeds for AI/hyperscale data centers. Builds on $11M seed (March 2024); positions in the same competitive lane as Marvell, Astera Labs, and other AI-networking silicon plays.

company_description: Builds open-architecture small unmanned aircraft systems for defense and a secure software-delivery pipeline for UAS code accreditation. RTX Ventures is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Crosslink Capital, RTX Ventures, Stellar Ventures
robotnik_take: Open-architecture UAS plus secure-software-delivery pipeline play. RTX Ventures participation is the strategic tell — Raytheon's prime-contractor angle on small-UAS code accreditation.

company_description: German developer of hospital mobilization robotics for ICU and rehabilitation patients, claimed to reduce rehab time by around 20%. Backed by the EIC Fund.
co_investors: TQ-Group, Henrik Schunk, Stephan Huber, EIC Fund
robotnik_take: Hospital mobilization robotics for ICU/rehab — reduces rehab time by ~20%. EIC Fund cornerstone follows established pattern of European deep-tech medtech using public co-investment to bridge clinical commercialization.

company_description: Chinese commercial launch company developing the Hyperbola-3 reusable methalox rocket and operating the smaller Hyperbola-1 solid-propellant launcher. Building a Shifang, Sichuan assembly plant; competes with Galactic Energy and Space Pioneer.
robotnik_take: Combined Series C and C+ at ~700M yuan (~$99M); first capital raise since 2020 Series B. Funds Hyperbola-3 reusable methalox launcher development and Shifang assembly plant. Chinese launch capital remains insulated from Western fund flows.

company_description: Uses microwave plasma synthesis to produce battery cathode active materials (CAM) and additive-manufacturing metal powders. Operates the PlusCAM facility in Jackson, Tennessee for sustainable cathode production from recycled feedstocks.
co_investors: Anzu Partners, Energy Impact Partners, LaunchCapital, Material Impact, Volta Energy Technologies
robotnik_take: Insider-led first close of Series E for plasma synthesis CAM (cathode active materials) at PlusCAM facility in Jackson, TN. Coincided with CEO transition from Aaron Bent to COO Saurabh Ullal.

company_description: Builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and tow tractors for warehouse and manufacturing material handling. Customers include Giant Eagle and other US distribution operators.
lead_investors: Giant Eagle Incorporated, G2 Venture Partners
co_investors: Existing shareholders
robotnik_take: Customer-led inside round (Giant Eagle); warehouse AMR market consolidating around incumbents with deployed fleets. Series D from existing investors only is a sign capital efficiency is improving but the new investor base is thin.

company_description: Bangalore-based fabless designer of surveillance camera SoCs targeting the enterprise and consumer surveillance market. Founded by ARM, Intel, and Broadcom veterans; first reference chip on UMC 28nm.
robotnik_take: Bangalore-based fabless surveillance SoC startup, founded by ex-ARM/Intel/Broadcom veterans. Targets enterprise/consumer surveillance camera market with 28nm UMC reference chip in Q1 2025. Indicative of India's emerging fabless ecosystem under semiconductor mission policy.

company_description: Harvard spinout commercializing solid-state batteries based on Dynamic Stability self-healing electrolyte. Building a roll-to-roll pilot line in Massachusetts; targets EV cost parity with internal combustion by 2028.
co_investors: Primavera Capital Group, Rhapsody Venture Partners, MassVentures
robotnik_take: Harvard spinout commercializing solid-state batteries based on Dynamic Stability self-healing electrolyte. Round closed end-Aug 2024 (publicly announced Oct 23, 2024); funds a roll-to-roll pilot line in Massachusetts. Targets EV-ICE parity by 2028.

company_description: Swiss ETH Zurich spinout building a wheeled-quadruped robot — a four-legged robot with wheels on each foot — for last-mile delivery, security, and inspection. Later rebranded to RIVR.
co_investors: Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Armada Investment, Linear Capital
robotnik_take: Wheeled-quadruped form factor is a credible alternative to bipedal humanoids for last-mile/security/inspection. Bezos plus HongShan plus Amazon's Industrial Innovation Fund signals the same Bezos-Amazon thesis hitting both Skild and Swiss-Mile in one quarter. Later rebranded to RIVR.

company_description: Develops scalable Earth Return Vehicles — heat shield, payload bus, and paragliding system technology — for hypersonic testing and orbital reentry missions.
robotnik_take: Four-year STRATFI award for scalable Earth Return Vehicle development (heat shield, payload bus, paragliding system) for hypersonic testing & reentry. STRATFI sits in includable Grant/Government investment bucket per scope.

company_description: First well-funded Korean humanoid robotics company. Hyundai's ZER01NE participation positions Holiday as Korea's national-champion humanoid challenger to Boston Dynamics (Hyundai-owned) and Apptronik.
lead_investors: Atinum Investment, Stonebridge Ventures, SpringCamp, ZER01NE Ventures
co_investors: Intervest, Hyundai Motor ZER01NE
robotnik_take: First well-funded Korean humanoid play; Hyundai's ZER01NE participation positions it as Korea's national-champion challenger to Boston Dynamics (Hyundai-owned) and Apptronik. KRW round — large by Korean seed standards.

company_description: Canadian developer of electrochemical lithium refining technology that converts diverse feedstocks — brines, hard-rock concentrates, recycled black mass — into battery-grade lithium hydroxide or carbonate.
co_investors: Breakthrough Energy Ventures
robotnik_take: Strategic add-on round; tranche size undisclosed but brought total raised to $25M USD. Electrochemical lithium refining converts diverse feedstocks to battery-grade hydroxide/carbonate. The bigger $35M Series B financing closed January 2025.

company_description: Joint venture between Loft Orbital and IHC's Marlan Space, building the Middle East's first private satellite manufacturing line in Abu Dhabi with 50 satellites per year of capacity. UAE-backed effort to localize space supply chains.
robotnik_take: Joint venture between Loft Orbital and IHC's Marlan Space, with $100M+ initial commitment to build the Middle East's first private satellite manufacturing line (50 satellites/year capacity). UAE sovereign-backed industrial play to localize space supply chain.

company_description: Vertically integrated US rare earth mining and magnet manufacturing company developing the Round Top deposit in Texas and a magnet plant in Stillwater, Oklahoma. Public on NASDAQ following a 2025 SPAC merger.
robotnik_take: Definitive SPAC merger agreement signed at $870M pro-forma EV with $35M initial PIPE ($25M funded at signing). Vertically integrated US REE-to-magnet play targeting Round Top deposit (TX) and Stillwater magnet plant. Closed in early 2025.

company_description: US humanoid robotics startup founded by Sankaet Pathak (formerly of fintech Synapse, which filed for bankruptcy in 2024). Developing general-purpose humanoid platforms.
co_investors: Undisclosed angels
robotnik_take: Founder credentialing risk: Sankaet Pathak's Synapse fintech filed for bankruptcy 2024. Tribe self-leading is unusual; humanoid-robotics has become a magnet for displaced fintech operators chasing the next platform shift.

company_description: Asteroid mining startup developing prospecting and mining spacecraft (Odin, Vestri) to extract platinum-group metals from near-Earth asteroids. Pre-revenue; mission timelines stretch over decades.
co_investors: 776, Initialized, Caladan, Y Combinator, Uncorrelated Ventures, Jed McCaleb
robotnik_take: Asteroid mining startup; total raised now $55M. Round funds 2025 Odin/Vestri prospecting missions. Pricing on speculative deep-space mining remains hard; revenue path is multi-decade.

company_description: Develops lunar resource extraction technology to produce liquid oxygen from lunar regolith. Won runner-up status in NASA's Break the Ice Challenge for in-situ resource utilization.
co_investors: Day One Ventures, Balerion Space, Indicator Ventures
robotnik_take: Lunar resource extraction (LOX from regolith); won NASA Break the Ice runner-up. In-orbit services subsector classification reflects lunar resource utilization as adjacent.

company_description: Swiss manufacturer of VTOL commercial mapping drones. WingtraOne survey UAV is the flagship product; targets surveying, mining, and construction users wanting fixed-wing range with vertical takeoff.
co_investors: Brick & Mortar Ventures, Spectrum Moonshot Fund, SymbiaVC
robotnik_take: Series B1 extension for VTOL surveying drone — profile is more commercial mapping than defense-aligned. Capital efficiency relative to recent defense-drone megarounds; VTOL geometry is the right form-factor for commercial wide-area sensing.

company_description: Develops the Pathfinder endoluminal robotic platform for gastrointestinal endoscopy. Strategic investor Olympus brings GI distribution; spinout of Jupiter Endovascular consolidates the company around GI.
lead_investors: Sonder Capital, Olympus Corporation of the Americas
co_investors: Existing and new undisclosed investors
robotnik_take: Olympus strategic lead is the headline — the GI endoscopy incumbent buying optionality on robotics-assisted Pathfinder. Spin-out of Jupiter Endovascular suggests Neptune is consolidating around GI; Fred Moll as Chairman validates the platform.

company_description: Builds self-propelled autonomous battery-electric railcars as retrofits for existing freight rail networks. Operating commercial deployments at the Iron Senergy mine in Pennsylvania.
co_investors: Advantage Capital, Cathcart Rail, Idealab
robotnik_take: Self-propelled autonomous battery-electric railcar retrofit play; addresses the most under-automated transport mode (rail). Already in revenue at Iron Senergy mine — one of the few autonomy plays with active commercial deployment vs demos.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company building the SE01 platform at a unit cost below $14,000. Founded by former XPeng Robotics engineers.
robotnik_take: Sub-$14k unit-cost humanoid (SE01) targeting commercial deployment within months — Chinese cost curve continues to undercut Western humanoids by ~5-10x. Founding team ex-XPeng Robotics; auto-OEM diaspora pattern continues.

company_description: Decentralized AI training platform addressing IP, copyright, and data provenance for AI model development. USC-affiliated spinout with strategic backing from Samsung NEXT.
lead_investors: Pantera Capital, Binance Labs, Polychain Capital
co_investors: Samsung NEXT, Matrix Partners, Sequoia Capital, dao5, Geekcartel, Nomad Capital, SCB 10X, Canonical Capital, Mirana Ventures, Foresight Ventures, Dispersion Capital, Aegis Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Tangent Ventures
robotnik_take: Decentralized AI training platform out of USC, addressing IP/copyright/data-provenance for AI training. Heavy strategic syndicate (Samsung NEXT, Sequoia) is unusual for crypto-native deals and signals enterprise AI ambitions.

company_description: Designs RISC-V CPU cores across three product families targeting performance, efficiency, and embedded applications. Founded by veterans of the Marvell ThunderX2 server CPU team; licenses IP as an alternative to ARM and SiFive.
robotnik_take: RISC-V IP startup (ex-Marvell ThunderX2 team) emerged from stealth with $100M+ across three CPU families targeting Arm and SiFive. Validates RISC-V investment thesis at the IP layer rather than chip layer.

company_description: Develops chiplet die-to-die interconnect IP including its NuLink technology, which competes with the UCIe standard. Strategic backing from SK hynix and Samsung positions Eliyan in the chiplet ecosystem.
robotnik_take: Strategic investment from VentureTech Alliance pushed Eliyan past $100M cumulative funding for chiplet die-to-die interconnect IP. Amount undisclosed but extends the $60M March 2024 Series B. NuLink/UCIe-class IP play with strategic SK hynix and Samsung backing.

company_description: Chinese fabless designer of automotive autonomous driving SoCs for ADAS and L2+/L3 vehicles. Public on HKEX (02533); manufactured by TSMC. Xiaomi is a strategic investor.
robotnik_take: First Chinese autonomous-driving SoC designer to list on Hong Kong Exchange (02533.HK). Raised HK$1.036B (~$132M) at HK$28/share but plunged ~33% on debut, reflecting cooling Chinese auto-chip narrative. Xiaomi-backed; TSMC-linked supply chain.

company_description: Builds autonomous defense systems and the Lattice software platform that links sensors, communications, and weapons across battlefield domains. Products include the Roadrunner counter-drone interceptor, Ghost surveillance UAV, and Dive autonomous undersea vehicle. Sells primarily to U.S. and allied militaries.
co_investors: Fidelity Management & Research Co., Counterpoint Global, Baillie Gifford, Altimeter, Franklin Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Largest defense-tech round of 2024 ahead of Arsenal-1 mass production buildout. 65% valuation step-up from $8.5B (Dec 2022) on a reported revenue doubling to ~$500M; 28x revenue is rich but reflects pricing of US re-armament against a peer adversary.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of quadruped robots (Lynx, X20) and an emerging humanoid product line. Sells industrial inspection and service robots in domestic and international markets; competes with Boston Dynamics, Unitree, and ANYbotics.
robotnik_take: Series B+ extension; amount undisclosed. Quadruped specialist now pivoting toward humanoid/embodied-AI per company statements. Included as a notable Chinese robotics raise in window despite undisclosed terms.

company_description: Designs the Language Processing Unit (LPU), a custom inference accelerator optimized for large language models, and operates GroqCloud as a hosted inference service. Targets developers and enterprises looking for faster, lower-cost inference than GPU-based stacks.
co_investors: Neuberger Berman, Type One Ventures, Cisco Investments, Global Brain's KDDI Open Innovation Fund III, Samsung Catalyst Fund
robotnik_take: AI inference accelerator (LPU) play raising aggressively to scale GroqCloud capacity past 100,000 LPUs. The round positioned Groq as a primary Nvidia-alternative narrative, but heavy capex needs and TaaS economics remain unproven at this 2024 valuation.

company_description: Vertically integrated satellite systems provider operating the Halo platform — turnkey satellite missions covering climate, defense, and RF intelligence applications. Customers include SNC for the Vindler RF constellation.
co_investors: Acme Capital, Costanoa Ventures, Radical Ventures, Congruent Ventures
robotnik_take: End-to-end satellite systems provider; Halo platform serves climate, defense and RF applications. Round paired with $100M+ in customer contracts including SNC for Vindler RF constellation.

company_description: Builds a tractor-mounted pyrolysis robot that converts agricultural residue into biochar in the field, generating verifiable carbon-removal credits. Climate funds Microsoft and Grantham anchor the cap table.
co_investors: Congruent Ventures, Grantham Foundation, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund
robotnik_take: Tractor-mounted pyrolysis robot for biochar carbon removal — vertically-narrow ag-robotics with carbon-credit revenue stream stacked on hardware. Climate-pool LPs (Microsoft, Grantham) substitute for traditional growth equity at this stage.

company_description: Indian space-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, building the Drishti hybrid optical-multispectral and SAR payload for an earth observation satellite constellation.
co_investors: ideaForge, Rainmatter, Navam Capital, Faad Capital, Anicut Capital
robotnik_take: IIT-Madras-incubated. Building hybrid optical-multispectral plus SAR payload (Drishti) for first sat launch. Indian space stack continues to attract early-stage capital despite small ticket sizes.

company_description: Develops AI software and autonomous systems for European defense, including a strike-drone family and software that processes sensor data for situational awareness. Sells to NATO ministries of defense with primary customers in Germany, the UK, France, and Estonia.
co_investors: Accel, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Plural, Greenoaks Capital Management, Elad Gil
robotnik_take: European answer to Anduril; €450M at €4.95B valuation marks Europe's first credible defense-AI unicorn at scale. Round announced same month as Saronic and a few weeks before Anduril Series F — the AI-defense capital cycle peaked in Q3 2024.

company_description: UK Oxford spinout designing in-memory compute AI inference chips for accelerating frontier-model inference at lower power than GPUs. NATO Innovation Fund is a strategic investor.
lead_investors: Kindred Capital, NATO Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises
co_investors: Cocoa, Innovia Capital
robotnik_take: UK in-memory compute startup (Oxford spin-out) targeting frontier-model inference acceleration. NATO Innovation Fund participation is notable as a defense-aligned signal in AI compute. Founder Walter Goodwin pursuing radically different architecture vs GPU.

company_description: Develops a neurovascular surgical robot (Vasco platform) for stroke care, with a telesurgery component to address geographic access constraints in stroke thrombectomy.
co_investors: Cormorant Asset Management, Mirae Asset Capital
robotnik_take: Neurovascular surgical robot for stroke care — underserved category vs soft-tissue surgical-robotics consolidation around Intuitive/Medtronic. Telesurgery angle is strategic for stroke (geographic access constrains thrombectomy outcomes).

company_description: Builds small geostationary communications satellites — roughly the size of a mini-fridge — that deliver dedicated broadband to specific regions at lower cost than traditional GEO sats. Operates the Omega program targeting 100+ Block 1 satellites in orbit by 2030.
co_investors: BlackRock, Fidelity, Baillie Gifford
robotnik_take: Largest US space round of 2024. Equity round fully funded development of next-gen Omega broadband satellite platform; total raised passed $750M with Trinity Capital also providing venture debt alongside the equity.

company_description: Builds robotic systems for automated pathology tissue processing — slicing and slide preparation for histology labs. Strategic health-system investors include Northwell, Mayo, Ochsner, and Columbia University.
co_investors: CU Healthcare Innovation Fund, Mayo Clinic, Ochsner Ventures
robotnik_take: Health-system strategic syndicate (Northwell/Mayo/Ochsner/CU) signals pull-through commercial demand for pathology automation amid pathologist shortage. Adjacent to surgical robotics on lab side — represents an under-covered automation pocket within healthcare.

company_description: Builds a space-based power-beaming grid for LEO satellites, founded by alumni of Made In Space. Targets the orbital energy-as-a-service market as constellation power demand outstrips on-board solar.
co_investors: Rogue VC
robotnik_take: Founded by ex-Made In Space team to build a space-based power beaming grid for LEO satellites. Power-as-a-service is a credible adjacency to in-orbit servicing as constellation power demand outstrips on-board solar.

company_description: Builds a software-defined warehouse automation platform using climbing robots that move heavy material in three dimensions. Founded by former Tesla engineers; competes with Symbotic, AutoStore, and Exotec in ASRS.
co_investors: Eclipse, Abstract Ventures, Promus Ventures, 515 Ventures, Garry Tan, Lachy Groom
robotnik_take: Ex-Tesla Optimus head Chris Walti's stealth raise targets ASRS reinvention with climbing robots in a 3D grid. $78M cumulative across rounds; warehouse automation continues attracting AI-native founders chasing Symbotic-scale outcomes.

company_description: Korean fabless designer of AI inference NPUs (ATOM, REBEL) for data center and edge applications. Merged with rival FuriosaAI to consolidate Korea's AI chip industry; manufactures at Samsung Foundry.
robotnik_take: First Korean startup investment by Aramco's $500M Wa'ed Ventures, signaling MENA sovereign capital pivoting toward Asian AI chip alternatives. Extension to January 2024 $124M Series B; Rebellions later merged with Sapeon (December 2024) to form Korea's first AI chip unicorn.

company_description: Operates a mobile beverage manufacturing platform — modular packaging cells that can be relocated. Strategic customer and lead investor Schreiber Foods anchors the initial deployment.
co_investors: Tech Council Ventures
robotnik_take: Mobile manufacturing platform with first customer Schreiber Foods leading the round; classic strategic-led seed-extension structure. Mobile/modular automation is an under-explored format relative to fixed-cell robotics deployment.

company_description: Builds electric autonomous tractors for orchards, vineyards, and dairy operations. Sells direct to specialty-crop and dairy farmers along with a paired data and software platform.
co_investors: At One Ventures, PMV, Welvaartsfonds
robotnik_take: Largest-ever ag-robotics raise; signals that vertical-specific autonomy (orchards/vineyards/dairy) is commercially proven before general-purpose AV economics work. Astanor lead is a tell — impact pools see ag autonomy as scale-deployable today.

company_description: Builds autonomous surface vessels (Spyglass and Cutlass classes) for the US Navy. Founded by former Navy SEAL Dino Mavrookas; targets maritime unmanned systems as a follow-on category to aerial defense autonomy. (Same company as Saronic; this row covers earlier funding rounds.)
co_investors: 8VC, Caffeinated Capital, Elad Gil, NightDragon
robotnik_take: Defense ASV play hits unicorn status three years after founding; a16z lead and the speed of step-up reflects DoD's pivot to attritable autonomous platforms post-Ukraine. Maritime is the underweighted leg of the unmanned defense thesis vs UAS.

company_description: Builds the MARS open-chiplet platform — a modular alternative to monolithic SoCs for AI and automotive customers. Sells the Chiplet Hub product enabling chiplet integration without custom interposer design.
co_investors: Hanwha Next Generation Opportunity Fund, Event Horizon, Raptor, UMC Capital, BRV, Ignite Innovation Fund, Grandfull Fund
robotnik_take: Open-chiplet platform (MARS) play targeting AI/automotive SoC designers seeking modular alternatives to monolithic GPUs. Total funding now ~$93M; commercial milestone is the Chiplet Hub product entering market.

company_description: Builds the DrinkBot automated beverage-dispensing system for quick-service restaurants. Strategic customer and investor Jollibee anchors commercial deployments in the QSR channel.
robotnik_take: Strategic round led by existing customer (Jollibee); suggests commercial traction is real but signals lock-in/QSR-channel-only risk. Beverage-bot category is narrow; defensibility is supply chain integration not robotics IP.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company building bipedal and quadrupedal robots for general-purpose legged locomotion. SAIC-backed Shang Qi is a strategic investor. (Same company as LimX Dynamics/Zhuji Dynamics.)
lead_investors: China Merchants Capital, Shang Qi Capital
co_investors: Fengrui Capital, Oasis Capital, Ming Shi Capital
robotnik_take: SAIC-backed Shang Qi participation makes LimX a quasi-strategic OEM-aligned humanoid play, similar to AgiBot/SAIC backing pattern. Amount undisclosed; included for completeness as a high-profile Chinese humanoid round in Q3 2024.

company_description: Builds the RO1 6-axis collaborative robot arm with a demonstration-based programming interface. American cobot manufacturer targeting reshoring of US manufacturing; Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Samsung Next, Lachy Groom, Quiet Capital, Box Group, Zeno Partners
robotnik_take: American cobot-arm manufacturer betting on US reshoring; Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund participation suggests fulfillment use cases. Demonstration-based programming pitch positions Standard Bots against Universal Robots/Doosan on UX rather than price.

company_description: Develops a general-purpose robot foundation model — a single AI 'brain' designed to work across different robot bodies. Pittsburgh-based; targets robot OEMs and integrators that want to license the underlying control intelligence rather than build it in-house.
lead_investors: Lightspeed Venture Partners, Coatue, SoftBank Group, Bezos Expeditions
co_investors: Felicis Ventures, Sequoia, Menlo Ventures, General Catalyst, CRV, SV Angel, Carnegie Mellon University, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Alexa Fund
robotnik_take: Foundation model play for general-purpose robotics emerging from stealth. Investor list (Lightspeed/Coatue/SoftBank/Bezos plus the Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund) signals belief that physical-AI is the next foundation-model frontier and that the brain - not the body - is where capital should concentrate.

company_description: Builds a planned 50,000 tpa lithium refinery in Muskogee, Oklahoma producing battery-grade lithium products. Public on NASDAQ (SDST) following a 2024 SPAC merger.
co_investors: PIPE syndicate (undisclosed)
robotnik_take: Closed SPAC merger with GPAC II at $490M pro-forma EV; final PIPE proceeds were ~$10.1M after heavy redemptions (initial $100M target shrank). Plans 50,000 tpa lithium refinery in Muskogee, OK. Listed on Nasdaq as SDST on July 9, 2024.

company_description: Builds camera-only autonomous mobile robots, originally for sidewalk delivery and now pivoting toward indoor industrial automation. Strategic investors include Magna, Shell, and Mitsubishi Electric.
co_investors: Magna International, Shell Ventures, Mitsubishi Electric
robotnik_take: Strategic-heavy investor list (Magna, Shell, Mitsubishi Electric) suggests pivot from food delivery to industrial/indoor automation. Cartken's camera-only AV stack gives auto-tier-1s a low-cost on-ramp to mobile robotics IP.

company_description: Builds open-source AGI infrastructure on a Polygon CDK chain — a token-incentivized decentralized AI platform for model training, inference, and ownership. Co-founded by Polygon's Sandeep Nailwal.
lead_investors: Founders Fund, Pantera Capital, Framework Ventures
co_investors: Robot Ventures, Delphi, Republic, Arrington Capital, Symbolic Capital, Hack VC, Polygon Ventures, Topology, Dao5, Spartan
robotnik_take: Seed round announced July 2 for open-source AGI infrastructure on Polygon CDK chain. Co-founded by Polygon's Sandeep Nailwal. VC-priced equity-and-token round; closes a key 'decentralized AI' compute syndicate signal alongside Sahara.

company_description: Software-defined-vehicle and autonomous driving software arm of the Hyundai Motor Group. Builds the unified software stack and autonomous mobility platform across Hyundai and Kia vehicles.
robotnik_take: Korean autonomy/SDV unit absorbed W253B of additional capital from Hyundai/Kia. Captive equity round consolidating Hyundai's in-house autonomy stack alongside Motional and Boston Dynamics.

company_description: Manufactures Titan Silicon, a silicon-based anode material that replaces graphite in lithium-ion battery anodes for higher energy density. Targets EV-volume production with cells used by automotive OEMs; operates a manufacturing plant in Moses Lake, Washington.
lead_investors: Sutter Hill Ventures, T. Rowe Price Associates
co_investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Coatue, Perry Creek Capital
robotnik_take: Silicon-anode battery materials; Titan Silicon for EV production. Sutter Hill + T. Rowe Price lead at $375M signals continued institutional belief that silicon anodes will scale to mass auto markets despite multiple peer failures in 2024.

company_description: Dutch fabless designer of edge AI inference chips for computer vision and LLM workloads in automotive ADAS, robotics, and industrial applications. Competes with Qualcomm, Hailo, and Intel Movidius at the edge.
lead_investors: European Innovation Council Fund (EIC-A), Innovation Industries Strategic Partnership Fund
co_investors: Invest-NL, Samsung Catalyst Fund, Verve Ventures, Innovation Industries, Fractionelera, CDP Venture Capital SGR
robotnik_take: Edge AI inference processor (Metis) using SRAM-based digital in-memory compute and RISC-V. Brings total raised to $120M. Note: also has Q1 2026 Series C entry.

company_description: Chinese surgical robotics company developing the Carina robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) modular system. Founded by veterans of Intuitive Surgical and Auris Health, targeting the Chinese market against Versius, Toumai, and Edge.
co_investors: King Star Med LP, LongRiver Investments
robotnik_take: Modular Carina laparoscopic surgical platform; targeting NMPA approval and 2025 commercialization. Reflects continuing Chinese capital into domestic surgical robotics despite global slowdown.

company_description: Designs Sohu, a transformer-specific AI ASIC. Hardwires the transformer architecture into silicon, with the bet that transformer dominance makes specialization economical against general-purpose NVIDIA GPUs.
lead_investors: Primary Venture Partners, Positive Sum Ventures
co_investors: Two Sigma Ventures, Peter Thiel, Thomas Dohmke, Kyle Vogt, Charlie Cheever
robotnik_take: Transformer-only inference ASIC ('Sohu') on TSMC 4nm; total raised $125.36M. Aggressive specialization bet — inference economics depend on transformer dominance persisting.

company_description: Builds software-defined manufacturing cells for electronics assembly, combining robotics with computer vision and a manufacturing software platform. NVIDIA and Microsoft are strategic investors aligning the platform with their AI infrastructure work.
co_investors: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Eclipse, Jabil, Shinhan Securities
robotnik_take: Software-defined manufacturing with direct NVIDIA/Microsoft strategic involvement; signals AI-stack convergence with electronics assembly. Excludes $20M J.P. Morgan venture-debt tranche from equity figure.

company_description: Provides Robotics-as-a-Service for small and mid-sized manufacturers, with Mitsubishi HC Capital co-funding the entire RaaS lifecycle. Targets the US SMB manufacturing automation gap.
co_investors: Mitsubishi HC Capital America, NEC, Translink Orchestrating Future Fund, Alumni Ventures, FJ Labs, Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Lorimer Ventures
robotnik_take: RaaS model for SMB manufacturers; Mitsubishi HC Capital co-funding the entire RaaS lifecycle is a notable commercial structure. Total Series A now $52M+.

company_description: Telemetry observability software platform for mission-critical machines including spacecraft. Customer base is space-heavy with Astranis, K2 Space, and True Anomaly using the platform; software product rather than space hardware.
co_investors: Riot Ventures, Caffeinated Capital, Conviction Embed
robotnik_take: Telemetry observability platform for mission-critical machines including spacecraft. Customer base is space-heavy (Astranis, K2, True Anomaly) but product is software — borderline category.

company_description: Australian quantum computing company developing silicon CMOS quantum-dot processors that can be manufactured on standard CMOS lines. UNSW spinout; pursuing a capital-light path versus cryogenic superconducting peers.
co_investors: Main Sequence, Taronga Ventures, Uniseed, UniSuper, Co:Act Capital, UNSW Sydney
robotnik_take: Silicon CMOS quantum-dot processor; extension brought Series A round total to USD 22M cumulative. UNSW spinout pursuing quantum on standard CMOS — capital-light vs cryogenic peers.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot developer building general-purpose embodied AI platforms for industrial and service applications. Backed by China Mobile's Industry Chain Leader Fund; competes with Agibot, Unitree, and Tesla Optimus.
lead_investors: Meituan, BAIC Industrial Investment, SenseTime Guoxiang Fund, iFlytek Fund
co_investors: Qiming Venture Partners, BlueRun Ventures (Lanchi), Matrix Partners China, Source Code Capital, IDG Capital
robotnik_take: Record angel-round size for Chinese embodied-AI sector at time of closing; wheeled-bipedal humanoid building on Peking University Wang He's lab. Proxy for Beijing's strategic embrace of household humanoids.

company_description: Develops Spectrum, a small-to-medium-lift launch vehicle for European institutional and commercial payloads. Targets sovereign European launch capacity from Andoya Spaceport in Norway.
co_investors: G3T, 10x Group, Besant Capital, Finadvice, LP&E, Lakestar, Earlybird, Airbus Ventures, Bayern Kapital, UVC Partners
robotnik_take: Spectrum small launcher developer; brings total Series C to >Eur220M. NATO Innovation Fund participation is the strategic tell — European sovereign defense capital backing indigenous launch.

company_description: Provides Robot-as-a-Service for high-mix manufacturing surface treatment — robotic sanding, polishing, and finishing operations. Targets aerospace, defense, and consumer-goods manufacturers.
co_investors: NGP Capital, Euclidean Capital, Advance Venture Partners, SQN Venture Partners, 3M Ventures, B Capital, Bow Capital, Calibrate Ventures, OCA Ventures, Swift Ventures
robotnik_take: Robot-as-a-Service for high-mix manufacturing surface treatment (sanding, polishing). Wellington's first growth-equity check signals robotics moving from VC to crossover funds.

company_description: Japanese operator of a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellation. Sells SAR imagery and analytics to government, disaster response, and infrastructure-monitoring customers.
lead_investors: Japan Growth Capital Investment Corporation (Nomura SPARX Investment)
co_investors: JAFCO Group, Mizuho Capital, other institutional and individual investors
robotnik_take: SAR satellite constellation operator. Native Y7B raise — relatively modest by global standards but supports JAXA's small-launch ecosystem.

company_description: Builds self-driving forklifts and pallet movers for distribution centers and manufacturing facilities. Vertical-specific AMR play targeting material handling and yard pickup automation.
co_investors: Proficio Capital Partners, IMPULSE
robotnik_take: Closes Series C at $100M (extension of 2022 round). Self-driving forklift / pallet-mover plays directly into the autonomous yard / DC pickup automation thesis. Note: also has Nov-24 row.

company_description: Builds robotic ADAS sensor calibration equipment for vehicle repair shops, automating the post-collision recalibration of cameras and radar. Insurer investors include Allstate and Liberty Mutual.
co_investors: Lux Capital, Construct Capital, Haystack Ventures, Allstate Strategic Ventures, Liberty Mutual Strategic Ventures
robotnik_take: Robotic ADAS sensor calibration for repair shops; insurer participation (Allstate, Liberty Mutual) signals service-network plays for AV/EV maintenance economics.

company_description: UK Cambridge-based developer of computational photonics design tools, process design kits (PDKs), and prototyping packaging for integrated photonics designers.
lead_investors: UK Innovation & Science Seed Fund (UKI2S), Cambridge Enterprise Ventures
co_investors: Redstone QAI Quantum Fund, Kyra Ventures, Parkwalk Advisors, Deep Tech Labs
robotnik_take: Computational photonics design tools / PDK and prototyping packaging for integrated photonics. UK deep-tech seed-stage standout.

company_description: Develops AI-powered autonomous driving software for Class 8 freight trucks and robotaxis. Uses a simulation-first generative AI approach for training and validation, distinct from heavy-real-world-fleet competitors. Founded by Uber ATG's former chief scientist.
co_investors: NVIDIA, Volvo Group Venture Capital, Porsche Automobil Holding SE, Scania Invest, Ingka Investments
robotnik_take: Generative-AI-first autonomous trucking; round backed by carmaker strategics across Volvo, Porsche, Scania. Crucial validation of Waabi's simulator-led approach versus Aurora and Kodiak.

company_description: Develops active phased-array communications payloads for satellites and aircraft, including the Vireo Ka-band antenna and the Skylark satcom terminal. L3Harris is a strategic investor in the defense satcom segment.
co_investors: Development Bank of Japan, Quanta Computer, Kleiner Perkins, Lavrock Ventures, L3Harris Technologies, InMotion Ventures, Matter Venture Partners, MESH Ventures, Assembly Ventures
robotnik_take: Active phased-array communications payloads (Vireo Ka-band, Skylark satcom terminal). Series B+ brings total Series B to $125M; L3Harris strategic continues defense satcoms consolidation thesis.

company_description: Builds construction robots that install solar power plant arrays following the natural contour of the land. Claims around double energy yield per acre through terrain-following installation versus flat fixed-tilt sites.
robotnik_take: Construction robots for solar power plant deployment; doubles energy yield per acre via terrain-following arrays. Robotics intersect with the energy-deployment bottleneck.

company_description: Japanese developer of Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving software stack used by automotive OEMs and AV startups globally. Strategic investors include Suzuki and other Japanese OEMs consolidating around Autoware for L4 development.
co_investors: Aisin, Yamaha Motor, JIC Venture Growth Investments
