co_investors: Xian Caijin, AEF Greater Bay Area Fund
robotnik_take: Autonomous USV maker for water-surface cleaning, lake/river monitoring, and reservoir management. Niche climate-adjacent USV play, less defense-coded than Western peers.

company_description: Polish synthetic-data simulation platform for computer vision AI training, partnered with NVIDIA and Microsoft. Sells synthetic data and digital twins to robotics and ADAS developers.
co_investors: Edge VC, Taiwania Capital, Movens Capital, HTGF
robotnik_take: Synthetic-data simulation platform for vision AI; tripled revenue pre-round and is partnered with Nvidia/Microsoft. A Polish challenger in the data-centric AI tooling layer for robotics.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of autonomous mobile robots for warehouse and factory automation. Strategic investors Midea and Chint anchor domestic supply-chain integration.
co_investors: Zhong Jin Innovation, Midea Capital, Moom Capital, Future Invest
robotnik_take: AMR producer; Midea/Chint corporate participation maps to a domestic-supply-chain push for warehouse automation in Chinese factories. Total funding ~$28M.

company_description: Vehicle-data decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) — drivers connect their cars and contribute telematics data in exchange for the DIMO token. Targets mobility data as a primary asset class.
co_investors: Slow Ventures, ConsenSys Mesh, Borderless Capital, Bill Ackman's Table Management, G. Rick Wagoner Jr. (former GM CEO)
robotnik_take: Vehicle-data DePIN. Borderline scope (mobility-data more than compute/AI). Wagoner ex-GM angel investment unusual signal.

company_description: Italian in-space logistics company operating the ION Satellite Carrier orbital transfer vehicle, which delivers smallsats to precise orbits after rideshare launches. Also developing in-orbit servicing and space-edge computing capabilities.
co_investors: Avantgarde, CDP Venture Capital Sgr, Seraphim Space Investment Trust, United Ventures, Indaco Venture Partners, Neva SGR, Primo Ventures, Iberis Capital, European Innovation Council Fund, Terna Forward
robotnik_take: Series C first close at Eur100M. Marubeni lead anchors Japan distribution; ION OTV space-logistics platform. Note: also has Sep-24 Series C extension entry — both share entity_id.

company_description: Norwegian humanoid robot company building NEO, a consumer-oriented bipedal android designed for the home. Strategic and product collaboration with OpenAI; competes with Figure and Tesla Optimus on consumer humanoid form factors.
co_investors: Samsung NEXT, Nistad Group, OpenAI, Tiger Global
robotnik_take: Funded the consumer-oriented NEO bipedal android, broadening the humanoid race beyond US/Asia and giving EQT a flagship physical-AI bet. OpenAI ties remain central to the financing logic.

company_description: French manufacturer of calcined-clay supplementary cementitious materials (SCMs) as low-carbon Portland cement substitutes. Building a plant in Saint-Maximin with initial 100,000 tons/year capacity, scaling to 200,000 tons/year.
co_investors: Nord France Amorcage, CBGreen, CIC Nord Ouest, Credit Agricole Nord de France, La Banque Postale, Bpifrance
robotnik_take: Calcined-clay supplementary cementitious materials. Funds Eur50M plant; 100,000 tpa initially scaling to 200,000 tpa. French regional + Bpifrance co-financing model.

company_description: Builds composite micrometeoroid and orbital debris (MMOD) shielding for spacecraft. Targets the satellite manufacturer and prime contractor market for protection against orbital debris.
co_investors: Starburst Aerospace, Jim Hunt (Lavrock Ventures), Garrett Langley (Flock Safety)
robotnik_take: Equity portion of combined $9.2M raise: $4.95M seed equity for composite micrometeoroid/orbital-debris (MMOD) shielding. Companion SBIR grant tracked as separate row per multi-row convention.

company_description: Builds composite micrometeoroid and orbital debris (MMOD) shielding for spacecraft. Targets the satellite manufacturer and prime contractor market for protection against orbital debris.
lead_investors: U.S. Air Force / U.S. Space Force (SBIR)
robotnik_take: Government portion of combined $9.2M raise: $4.24M USAF/USSF SBIR grant. Companion equity tranche tracked as separate row.

company_description: Builds Yomi, the first and only FDA-cleared dental implant robot. Sells to dental practices for guided implant placement; NVIDIA is a strategic investor.
co_investors: NVentures (NVIDIA)
robotnik_take: First and only FDA-cleared dental implant robot (Yomi). NVIDIA participation flags continuing GPU-vendor strategic stakes in vertical surgical-robotics, beyond general-purpose humanoid bets.

company_description: Builds outdoor autonomous mobile robots for agriculture, originally as harvest-assist carts and now expanded to the pallet-scale Burro Grande for broader outdoor logistics. More than 300 units deployed commercially.
co_investors: Toyota Ventures, S2G Ventures, Cibus Capital, F-Prime Capital
robotnik_take: Pallet-scale Burro Grande launch underwrote the round, expanding from harvest-assist toward broader outdoor logistics. Among the more 'shipping' ag-robotics companies with 300+ units in commercial use.

company_description: Builds autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) for maritime intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions. Korean Hanwha is a strategic investor reflecting allied-nation defense interest in maritime ISR.
co_investors: MC2, AE Industrial, I Squared Capital, Yellow Sub Funding
robotnik_take: Korean Hanwha leading reflects rising allied-nation defense capital flowing into US AUV/maritime ISR. Extension to prior $30M Series C (Apr 2023).

company_description: Indian manufacturer of bin-to-person warehouse robots for e-commerce fulfillment automation.
co_investors: Roots Ventures, Unisync Angels, Daniel Fitzgerald
robotnik_take: Indian bin-to-person warehouse robot maker; small ticket but a useful data point for the underdeveloped Indian robotics-startup pipeline.

company_description: Singapore-based advanced packaging foundry specializing in chiplet integration and panel-level packaging. Operates a high-volume facility in Singapore and is planning a European facility for chiplet-based system integration.
co_investors: Maverick Capital
robotnik_take: Advanced chiplet packaging foundry. Singapore-based; rumored to be planning European $3B+ facility. OSAT plays attracting infrastructure-capital scale checks.

company_description: Swiss developer of the Sapien spine-surgery robotic platform, building on the Bern/Mazor surgical robotics lineage. Targets the spine-robotics segment competing with Globus Medical (NSE) and Medtronic.
robotnik_take: Sapien spine-surgery robotics platform readying FDA submission. Bern/Mazor-alumni founding team and CHF 22M raise position LEM as a credible challenger to Globus/Medtronic in spine-robotics.

company_description: Chinese supplier of 3D scanning cameras and structured-light cameras for AI-based industrial robots in welding, fire protection, and cleaning applications. State-LP-backed by Shenzhen Capital Group.
robotnik_take: 3D scanning cameras and surface-light cameras for AI-based industrial robots (welding, fire protection, cleaning). State-LP-led; Shenzhen Capital Group is a major government-affiliated VC.

company_description: Develops Hivemind, an AI autonomy stack for military aircraft and drones that enables operation in GPS- and communications-denied environments. Products include the V-BAT vertical-takeoff UAV and Hivemind-equipped fighter jet retrofits.
co_investors: Hercules Capital
robotnik_take: Series F expansion two months after the initial $200M close: $100M new equity at the existing F price plus $200M debt from Hercules Capital. Total Series F now $500M at $2.8B post — modest mark-up reflects the equity-debt mix. Defense-tech showing it can tap structured credit markets, not just dilutive equity.

company_description: Builds robotic homebuilding systems using industrial arms paired with computer vision to translate blueprints directly into framed walls and structures. Targets the offsite-construction labor-shortage opportunity in US residential building.
co_investors: Y Combinator, Owens Corning, Shadow Ventures, Ambassador Supply
robotnik_take: Robotic homebuilding using industrial arms + CV — algorithmic translation from blueprint to fabrication. $35M post-money seed. Already framing 2,000+ homes/units. Comp: Promise Robotics (Series A same quarter) tackling identical labor-shortage thesis from offsite-construction angle.

company_description: Chinese commercial launch company operating Zhuque-2, the world's first orbital methane-LOX rocket, and developing the larger Zhuque-3 reusable medium-lift launcher.
lead_investors: China National Manufacturing Transformation and Upgrading Fund
robotnik_take: CNY 900M state-backed funding for Zhuque-2/Zhuque-3 reusable methane-LOX launchers. Landspace launched first enhanced Zhuque-2 in November 2023 (4,000 kg to 500 km SSO). State-fund backing signals China's strategic launch capability priority. Falcon 9-class reusability ambition.

company_description: Japanese microsatellite operator and manufacturer. Runs the AxelGlobe earth observation constellation and offers the AxelLiner satellite manufacturing platform for customers building their own missions.
co_investors: Mitsui Fudosan, Yamato Holdings, Epson X Investment, Keio Innovation Initiative, Tokyo University of Science Innovation Capital, Nanto Bank, Seibu Shinkin Bank
robotnik_take: Microsatellite EO operator (AxelGlobe) and manufacturer (AxelLiner). JPY 6.24B Series D supports vertical integration strategy. Founded 2008; 9 microsats deployed. Strong Japanese banking syndicate suggests state interest in commercial EO capacity.

company_description: Lithuanian medtech building a teleoperated robotic system for endovascular interventions, eliminating X-ray exposure for surgeons during procedures. Backed by the EIC Fund.
co_investors: EIC Fund
robotnik_take: Teleoperated robotic system for endovascular interventions — eliminates X-ray exposure for surgeons. Lithuanian MedTech with EIC Fund backing — EU sovereign tech-fund model. Targeting clinical trials and international launch. Niche, regulated, but distinct from Stryker/Medtronic incumbents.

company_description: Builds AI-driven warehouse robotics — autonomous mobile robots and AS/RS solutions paired with the GreyMatter fulfillment operating system. Sells to retail, e-commerce, and 3PL operators globally.
co_investors: Mithril, 3State Ventures, Blume Ventures
robotnik_take: Extended Series D growth round at undisclosed valuation. Comp to public AMR/AS-RS players (Symbotic SYM at ~12-15x sales) — GreyOrange's $135M extension after a $110M 2022 round suggests flat-to-modest mark amid sector compression. Anthelion's lead and India-roots syndicate signal capability to bridge to a possible 2025-26 IPO.

company_description: Builds large industrial robots for painting infrastructure including bridges, water towers, and marine assets. Targets the painting labor shortage in industrial maintenance; competitor Apellix operates drone-painting equipment in the same niche.
co_investors: 53 Stations, Dynamo, Pathbreaker Ventures, MetaProp, VSC Ventures
robotnik_take: Robotic painting for industrial infrastructure (and stated marine ambitions). Total $14.75M raised. Relocating Nashville → Virginia for marine-base proximity. Niche application robotics; comp peer Apellix in same drone-painting niche.

company_description: Builds Ozmo, a window-cleaning robotic arm for high-rise building facades. Strategic backers include Standard Industries and Durst Ventures, anchoring landlord and REIT distribution.
co_investors: Durst Ventures
robotnik_take: Pre-Series-A-2 (incl. SAFE conversion) for window-cleaning robotic arm Ozmo — disrupting $40B facade-services market. Standard Skyline / Durst Ventures involvement is the tell — landlord/REIT-side strategic capital signaling building-services automation thesis.

company_description: Develops silicon photonic compute and interconnect products for AI and HPC workloads. Main products are Envise (photonic compute), Passage (optical interconnect for chiplets and racks), and Idiom (software stack). Targets the AI scale-up problem that NVIDIA NVLink and Broadcom Tomahawk address electronically.
co_investors: HPE Pathfinder, GlobalFoundries, Spark Capital, Matrix Partners, SIP Global Partners
robotnik_take: Photonic compute for AI training/inference at $1.2B valuation; positions Lightmatter alongside Celestial AI and Ayar Labs in optical I/O race against bandwidth bottlenecks dragging on NVDA/AMD scaling.

company_description: Operates the TeleFarmer platform, an autonomy retrofit kit that adds remote operation and automation to existing tractors and orchard equipment. Strategic investor Doosan Bobcat anchors industrial OEM distribution; targets specialty-crop and off-road customers.
co_investors: Doosan Bobcat North America, Toyota Ventures
robotnik_take: TeleFarmer platform retrofitting tractors/equipment with autonomy. Doosan Bobcat strategic on cap table is the tell — signals industrial OEM offtake over pure software TAM. Specialty crop / off-road niche where Tesla/Waymo aren't competing.

company_description: Chinese commercial launch company operating the Ceres-1 small solid-propellant rocket and developing the Pallas-1 reusable medium-lift methalox vehicle. Competes with iSpace, LandSpace, and Space Pioneer for state-backed commercial launch market share.
co_investors: Bengbu Investment Group, Langfang Linkong, Founder Hesheng, Jintuo Capital
robotnik_take: Chinese launch startup; CNY 1.1B Series C+C+ funds Pallas-1 reusable medium-lift rocket development. Operates Ceres-1 small launcher with growing flight cadence; competing with iSpace, Landspace, Space Pioneer for state-backed Chinese commercial launch market share.

company_description: Chinese developer of heavy-lift unmanned rotorcraft, including the FWH-1500 and FWH-3000 ('Chinese Chinook') platforms. Targets export markets for cargo and dual-use rotorcraft applications.
robotnik_take: Heavy-lift unmanned rotorcraft developer (FWH-1500 / FWH-3000 'Chinese Chinook') with Dubai Airshow 2023 international debut. Funding closes coincident with FWH-3000 final development testing. Targeting export market for cargo / dual-use rotorcraft.

company_description: Builds maritime autonomy software and retrofit kits for commercial vessels — tugs, harbor craft, and patrol boats — distinct from US Navy-aligned military USVs. Targets commercial maritime operators.
robotnik_take: Bridge financing to maritime autonomy player Sea Machines (later $12M Feb 2024 round). Less-funded peer to Saronic in commercial maritime autonomy. Distinct positioning: commercial vessels (tugs, harbor) vs Saronic's USN-aligned military USVs.

company_description: Chinese developer of autonomous mining trucks. BYD is a strategic investor providing vehicle platforms; competes with Eacon Mining in off-highway autonomous trucking.
co_investors: BYD Company
robotnik_take: Autonomous mining trucks; BYD strategic on cap table for vehicle platforms. Plays the same Eacon/Inceptio thesis at the off-highway level — autonomy off-highway is meaningfully more bankable than on-highway long-haul.

company_description: Swiss manufacturer of the Scewo BRO premium stair-climbing electric wheelchair. Targets the assistive mobility market through US FDA approval expansion.
robotnik_take: Stair-climbing electric wheelchair (Scewo BRO) — premium mobility device; CHF 9.2M Series A extension for FDA / US market entry. RSBG (Rheinbraun) lead represents a heavy industrial / family-office angle on assistive-robotics.
Korean social-robot maker funding round — Korea's social/companion robotics niche has been more bankable than humanoid platforms (vs Hyundai/Naver). Limited public detail.

company_description: Israeli arm of Skyline Robotics filing tied to the Ozmo robotic window-cleaning system. (Same parent as Skyline Robotics; this row may represent an Israeli regulatory filing or distinct tranche.)
robotnik_take: Listed in The Robot Report December 2023 dataset under Israel jurisdiction at $6.45M. May represent a separate Israeli regulatory filing or distinct tranche from the $9.8M Pre-A2 close. Flagged as judgment call given dual reporting.

company_description: Decentralized telecom and Wi-Fi network on Solana, where users monetize routers and earn the ROAM token. International-roaming-focused alternative to Helium Mobile.
co_investors: SNZ Holding, IoTeX, Stratified Capital, plus 8 additional investors
robotnik_take: Decentralized telecom/Wi-Fi network on Solana — users monetize routers and earn $ROAM. Physical-world DePIN with sensor and connectivity layer; complementary to Helium Mobile thesis but with international roaming focus. Borderline on $5M+ Token threshold (exactly $5M); flagship-level inclusion.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company founded by Peng Zhihui, formerly of Huawei's Genius Youth program. Targets mass-production-ready humanoid platforms for industrial work; Baidu is a strategic investor with integration to its ERNIE foundation models.
co_investors: Baidu Ventures, Miracle Plus
robotnik_take: First institutional round for the Peng Zhihui (ex-Huawei Genius Youth) humanoid platform. Baidu strategic at the cap table signals integration with Wenxin/ERNIE foundation models. China's domestic answer to Figure/1X — by 2024 AgiBot was claiming mass-production readiness. Comp: Figure's 2024 $675M at $2.6B post-money; AgiBot priced at a fraction.

company_description: Chinese supplier of smart batteries and chargers for drones, storage robots, and underwater robots. Shunwei (Lei Jun/Xiaomi-aligned) is a strategic investor anchoring the Xiaomi ecosystem.
co_investors: Qianhai Ark Asset Management
robotnik_take: Smart batteries/chargers for drones, storage robots, underwater robots. Shunwei (Lei Jun / Xiaomi-aligned) lead suggests Xiaomi ecosystem play around robotics power infrastructure ahead of Xiaomi's own 2024 humanoid push.

company_description: Chinese pulmonary surgical and laboratory robotics company, with applications in lung-cancer detection and biopsy.
robotnik_take: Pulmonary surgical & laboratory robots / lung-cancer detection. Series C continues to validate Chinese surgical-robotics consolidation path that produced public exits like MicroPort, Edge Medical pipeline.

company_description: German developer of powered exoskeletons for industrial workers reducing musculoskeletal strain on the lower back during lifting. Strategic partner Mubea anchored automotive Tier 1 deployments; filed for bankruptcy in 2025.
co_investors: Mubea (industrialization partner)
robotnik_take: Series A extension for powered exoskeletons; Mubea (auto-tier-1) deepening industrialization partnership. Total raise now $52M. Notable that the company filed bankruptcy by 2025 despite full order books — early warning signal for hardware-heavy human-augmentation thesis.

company_description: Builds metasurface-based optical AI inference chips spun out of Duke University. Uses metamaterial modulators much smaller than standard photonic foundry cells; competes with Lightmatter and Celestial AI in photonic compute.
co_investors: MetaVC, Mana Ventures, Silicon Catalyst Angels
robotnik_take: Metasurface-based optical AI inference chip spun out of Duke; metamaterial modulators are 1000x smaller than standard photonic foundry PDK cells, plays in the same lane as Lightmatter and Celestial AI.

company_description: French developer of endovascular navigation robotics for interventional radiology. US strategic capital from Forepont and NTI anchors pre-FDA commercialization path.
co_investors: NTI, MEDCO
robotnik_take: Endovascular-navigation robotics; €6M Series A bringing total to €13M. French MedTech with US (Forepont, NTI) cap-table — typical EU MedTech path of US strategic capital pre-FDA. Sentante (same quarter) is direct peer.

company_description: Solana-based bandwidth DePIN — users sell idle internet bandwidth that is used for AI training data scraping. Reached more than 2 million nodes by its 2024 token launch.
co_investors: No Limit Holdings (pre-seed), Bitscale, Big Brain, Advisors Anonymous, Typhon V, Mozaik
robotnik_take: Solana-based bandwidth DePIN - users sell idle internet bandwidth for AI training data scraping. Sub-$5M flagship inclusion: foundational physical-AI data layer with hard real-world ties. Reached >2M nodes by 2024 token launch.

company_description: Builds autonomous orbital vehicles (the Jackal AOV) and ground software for space domain awareness and rendezvous-proximity operations. Sells primarily to the US Space Force and Department of Defense for orbital security missions.
co_investors: Eclipse, ACME Capital, Menlo Ventures, Narya, 645 Ventures, Rocketship.vc, Champion Hill Ventures, FiveNine Ventures
robotnik_take: Space domain awareness / autonomous orbital vehicles (Jackal AOV). Series B precedes Transporter-10 launch debut. Pre-revenue defense-tech with strong USSF/DoD pipeline; positions as space security prime competing with Northrop / L3Harris in SDA layer.

company_description: Uses electro-extraction technology to refine nickel, cobalt, and rare earth elements from end-of-life batteries and low-grade ores. Competes with traditional pyromet and hydromet smelting at lower energy cost; targets US critical-minerals onshoring.
co_investors: MassMutual Ventures, Caterpillar Venture Capital, Equinor Ventures (Series B portion: $37M; non-dilutive: $7M)
robotnik_take: Electro-extraction technology for refining nickel, cobalt, and rare earths from end-of-life batteries and low-grade ores; competes with traditional pyromet/hydromet smelting at lower energy cost. Aligns with US critical minerals reshoring vs China's processing dominance.

company_description: Develops liquid-tin thermal energy storage for grid-scale long-duration applications. Stores heat at over 2,400 degC and converts it back to electricity via thermophotovoltaics; targets the same industrial decarbonization use case as Antora and Rondo.
co_investors: Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Black Venture Capital Consortium, Goldcrest Capital
robotnik_take: Liquid-tin thermal energy storage for grid-scale long-duration applications - stores heat at >2400°C, converts back via thermophotovoltaics. Adjacent to Antora's solid-carbon block approach. Materials angle: novel high-temperature ceramic and graphite block supply chain.

company_description: Dutch developer of nanoimprint lithography equipment for sub-EUV-cost patterning of AR optics, biosensors, and microLEDs. Philips Research spinout positioning as a niche alternative to ASML in selected applications.
co_investors: Invest-NL, RSBG Ventures, BOM (Brabantse Ontwikkelings Maatschappij)
robotnik_take: Nanoimprint lithography spinout from Philips Research; targets sub-EUV-cost patterning for AR optics, biosensors and microLEDs—an alternative to ASML's incumbency in advanced patterning.

company_description: Canadian operator of the Skylark space-based space situational awareness constellation. Sells SSA data to satellite operators and governments; went public via SPAC in 2024. Competes with LeoLabs and Slingshot Aerospace.
co_investors: Investissement Quebec, Luxembourg Future Fund - Co-Investments SA
robotnik_take: C$20M raise to support deployment of initial block of four SSA satellites and Montreal data processing center. Space situational awareness pure play competing with LeoLabs/Slingshot/COMSPOC.

company_description: Develops FlexICs, flexible thin-film transistor integrated circuits manufactured on a low-cost, low-energy process. Targets RFID, smart packaging, and IoT volumes outside the conventional silicon-CMOS curve. Operates fabs in Durham and Cambridge, UK.
co_investors: Northern Gritstone, Latitude, MVolution Partners, British Patient Capital, Cambridge Innovation Capital, Prosperity7
robotnik_take: FlexIC thin-film transistor IC pioneer; largest European semiconductor venture round on record at the time, targeting RFID/IoT volumes outside the silicon-CMOS curve dominated by TSM/INTC.

company_description: Builds wall-climbing inspection robots and operates an AI software platform for industrial asset integrity. Sells to energy, manufacturing, and the US Navy for fleet readiness and infrastructure inspection.
lead_investors: U.S. Innovative Technology Fund, Founders Fund
robotnik_take: Series C extension brings total Series C to $173M; pivots Gecko deeper into defense (USIT + Founders Fund / Trae Stephens of Anduril join board). Wall-climbing inspection robots for industrial assets are repositioning toward DoD/Navy fleet readiness. Same defense-tech VC syndicate also funded Shield AI in Q4.

company_description: Designs analog in-memory compute AI inference chips, targeting energy-efficient inference for edge and client devices. Differentiated from digital accelerators by reducing the data-movement penalty that constrains GPU power efficiency.
lead_investors: VentureTech Alliance, RTX Ventures, ACVC Partners
co_investors: Anzu Partners, S5V, AlleyCorp, Scout Ventures, Silicon Catalyst Angels
robotnik_take: Analog in-memory compute targeting energy-efficient AI inference; differentiates from digital accelerators by reducing the von Neumann data-movement penalty that constrains NVDA H100-class throughput per watt.

company_description: Builds a suction-based truck and container unloading robot. Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund is a strategic investor; founded by a former GreyOrange executive.
co_investors: SOSV, Entrepreneur First
robotnik_take: Suction-based truck/container unloading robot. Amazon IIF lead is the explicit signal: AMZN paying for capacity/options on the unloading-automation problem (one of the last unsolved logistics hard problems). Founder Warrier ex-GreyOrange.

company_description: Develops dry powder coating manufacturing technology for lithium-ion battery electrodes, eliminating the solvent-and-drying step. Claims 40% reduction in cell manufacturing energy and CO2; Toyota Ventures and Porsche are strategic investors.
co_investors: Porsche Ventures, Asahi Kasei, RA Capital - Planetary Health, Wilson Sonsini, Industry Ventures, Anzu Partners, TDK Ventures, Creative Ventures, Doral Energy-Tech Ventures, Foothill Ventures, Zeon Ventures
robotnik_take: Dry powder coating technology for lithium-ion battery electrodes - eliminates solvent step, claims 40% reduction in energy/CO2 in cell manufacturing. Adjacent to Sila/Group14 silicon anode thesis but on the manufacturing process layer. Toyota+Porsche dual-sided OEM validation.

company_description: Estonian developer of carbon-negative synthetic graphite anode material made from CO2 emissions via molten salt electrochemistry. Pilot reactor processes 100 tons CO2/year into 27 tons of carbon material.
co_investors: SmartCap (Estonia state fund), Sunly, Little Green Fund, Scottish Baltic Invest, UniTartu Ventures
robotnik_take: Carbon-negative graphite anode material from CO2 emissions via molten salt electrochemistry. Pilot reactor sized for 100t CO2/yr → 27t carbon material. Inclusion at sub-$5M flagship: only known scalable green graphite play in Europe vs Chinese synthetic graphite supply chain dominance.

company_description: Builds liquid rocket engines as an independent supplier, including the Hadley (small launch class) and Ripley (medium-lift) engines. Customers include ABL Space Systems, Stratolaunch, and Phantom Space; growing hypersonic and defense propulsion lines.
co_investors: RTX Ventures, BlackRock, Exor Ventures, Mack & Co., XN
robotnik_take: Rocket engine specialist's Series D-1 brings total Series D+D-1 to $138M. Funds Lynx solid rocket motor line and Hadley/Ripley/Arroway production scale-up. Hypersonic + space launch dual-use propulsion provider; key supplier to small launchers and Pentagon hypersonics.

company_description: Cross-chain messaging and bridging protocol enabling token and data transfers across more than 30 blockchains. Spun out of Jump Crypto; the native W token launched in 2024.
co_investors: Coinbase Ventures, Multicoin Capital, Jump Trading, ParaFi Capital, Borderless Capital, Dialectic, Arrington Capital
robotnik_take: Cross-chain interoperability protocol; spinout from Jump Crypto. Largest pure-crypto fundraise of 2023 at $2.5B FDV. Token classification: while Wormhole is messaging/bridging infrastructure (not classic DePIN), this round was structured around future $W token issuance. Included for completeness as 2023's flagship token round; arguably outside pure DePIN/AI scope.

company_description: Chinese service robotics subsidiary of state aerospace conglomerate AVIC. Develops humanoid and exoskeleton platforms with potential mil-civil fusion applications.
robotnik_take: Service robotics subsidiary of state aerospace conglomerate AVIC raises CNY 100M. State-aligned dual-use angle: humanoid/exoskeleton platforms with potential mil-civil fusion applications. Cowin lead reflects Chinese local-government LP networks now active in robotics.

company_description: UK-based superconducting quantum computing company offering its quantum systems through a hosted Quantum-Computing-as-a-Service model. Targets Japanese and European enterprise customers; competes with IBM and Rigetti.
co_investors: Oxford Science Enterprises, Lansdowne Partners, University of Tokyo Edge Capital, British Patient Capital, Oxford Investment Consultants
robotnik_take: Largest UK quantum Series B on record at the time; superconducting QPU vendor positioning against IBM and Rigetti with a hosted/QCaaS model targeting Japan-Europe deployments.

company_description: Builds neutral-atom quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped rubidium atoms. French headquarters with a manufacturing footprint in Quebec's DistriQ quantum innovation zone; commercial systems delivered to enterprise customers.
co_investors: Government of Quebec
robotnik_take: Government-backed expansion into Quebec's DistriQ quantum innovation zone, part of $90M CAD initiative over 5 years; CAD15M government loan plus subsidized infrastructure to anchor PASQAL's North American manufacturing footprint.

company_description: Chinese autonomous haulage truck developer for surface mines. Operates commercial deployments in Chinese mining operations and is expanding internationally with an Australia office.
co_investors: Shenyin & Wanguo Capital Management, ESTAR Capital
robotnik_take: Autonomous haulage trucks for surface mines — China's first commercial deployment. Going overseas with Perth office. Industrial autonomy in extractive industries is a more bankable beachhead than passenger AVs. Comp: Caterpillar's autonomous truck program; Plus, Embark, others struggling on highway logistics.

company_description: Chinese LiDAR developer for autonomous driving and industrial applications. Strategic investor DiDi Autonomous Driving integrates Benewake LiDAR into the DiDi robotaxi sensor stack.
robotnik_take: LiDAR developer takes strategic from Didi AV unit — vertical-integration play on Didi's robotaxi sensor stack. Aggregator press notes >RMB1B headline; The Robot Report reports the equity tranche at $13.87M which we use here. Tighter sensor-supplier tie-up signals where China's robotaxi stack is consolidating.

company_description: Designs silicon-photonic FMCW lidar systems-on-chip for ADAS, robotics, and industrial machine vision. Strategic investors include ROHM, Sony, UMC, and Epson for supply-chain integration.
lead_investors: Hokuyo Automatic, Hankook & Company, ROHM Semiconductor (strategic)
co_investors: Epson, Yamato, UMC, Sony, Dell Technologies Capital, Alter Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Silicon-photonic FMCW lidar SoC; strategic investor stack (ROHM, Sony, UMC, Epson) signals supply-chain integration for ADAS and robotics vision.

Surgical robotics Series B — part of the dense Chinese surgical-robot funding cycle in 2023 that included MicroPort Honghu, Edge Medical, etc. Single-source from sector tracker; details of investor and use of proceeds not publicly disclosed.

company_description: Chinese agricultural drone manufacturer specializing in mountain-terrain spraying drones. Backers include Temasek, CITIC, and Bits x Bites.
robotnik_take: Agricultural drone player (mountain-terrain specialist) raises Series D tranche per The Robot Report — broader full Series D was reported at over RMB 1B. Existing cap table includes Temasek/CITIC/Bits x Bites from earlier rounds.

company_description: Chinese autonomous-driving chip developer. Part of China's domestic AV chip self-sufficiency effort.
robotnik_take: Large seed for autonomous-driving chip developer — RMB-100M-equivalent Seed signals Chinese local-government / state-LP-fueled deep-tech funding model where 'seed' is closer to a $13M Series A elsewhere. Targeting domestic AV chip self-sufficiency.

company_description: Canadian developer of vision-guided autonomous mushroom-picking robots for commercial mushroom growers. Rebranded from TechBrew Robotics; backed primarily by Canadian government-affiliated capital.
lead_investors: BDC Capital Industrial Innovation Venture Fund, InBC
co_investors: Jim Richardson Family Office, Lex Capital, Emmertech
robotnik_take: Vision-guided autonomous mushroom-picking robot — niche, severe-labor-shortage agricultural automation. Rebranded from TechBrew Robotics. CAD $17.5M Series A, all primary, primarily Canadian government-affiliated capital (BDC + InBC).

company_description: Develops an adaptive battery management system that extends usable life by managing first- and second-life cells at the individual cell level. Sells software-and-hardware solutions for EV battery packs and stationary storage operators.
lead_investors: Cohort Ventures, undisclosed clean energy generation company (co-leads)
co_investors: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Drive Catalyst, FM Capital, AFW Partners, LG Technology Ventures, Edison International, Prelude Ventures, Radar Partners, Keyframe Capital (debt facility)
robotnik_take: Adaptive battery management system for first- and second-life cells; bridges hardware/software at the cell level. $73M Series B equity + $38M Keyframe debt facility. Sits adjacent to materials thesis - extracts more economic life from same molecules.

company_description: Singapore-based developer of no-code robotics programming software that compresses process automation setup from weeks to roughly 15 minutes. Deployed in welding, abrasive blasting, and polishing across aerospace, maritime, and automotive industries.
co_investors: Cocoon Capital
robotnik_take: No-code robotics programming software — reduces process automation time from weeks to ~15 minutes. Singapore-based; deployed in welding, abrasive blasting, polishing across aerospace/maritime/automotive verticals. Comp: similar thesis to Path Robotics but at the SW layer.

company_description: Polish-US developer of the Zeus bionic prosthetic hand, supporting 12 grip patterns and 77-pound lifting capacity. More than 200 patient deployments to date; the Ukraine wartime amputee market is a significant volume driver.
co_investors: Chiratae Ventures
robotnik_take: Bionic prosthetic hand (Zeus) capable of 77-lb lift with 12 grip patterns. 200+ patient deployments. J2 Ventures (defense/dual-use) lead is interesting — wartime amputee market in Ukraine drives adoption volume. Sub-$10M but flagship for upper-limb prosthetics segment.

company_description: French photonic quantum computing company that has delivered commercial photonic quantum machines, including one to OVHcloud. Competes with trapped-ion (IonQ) and superconducting (IBM, Rigetti) modalities with a photonic approach.
lead_investors: Serena, Credit Mutuel Innovation, European Innovation Council (EIC)
co_investors: Bpifrance, Omnes Capital, Quantonation
robotnik_take: Photonic quantum computing leader; concurrently delivered first commercial machine to OVHcloud, validating its photonic approach against trapped-ion (IonQ) and superconducting (IBM/Rigetti) modalities.

company_description: Builds the Element solar-powered autonomous weeding robot fleet for row crops, with no diesel power and no chemical herbicides. Sells subscription-based deployment to row-crop growers.
co_investors: NEA, Cleveland Avenue, Incite, Susquehanna Private Equity Investments
robotnik_take: Solar-powered autonomous weeding robot fleet for row crops; pre-orders for Element sold out in one day. Total raise $19M. NEA + ReGen split between climate impact and traditional VC. Comp: Carbon Robotics, FarmWise — Aigen's all-renewable, no-diesel architecture is the differentiator.

company_description: Develops a silicon spin-photon interface for fault-tolerant quantum networking, using silicon T-center qubits. Microsoft is a co-investor and partnered on a joint quantum networking program.
lead_investors: British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI), Microsoft
co_investors: NSSIF (UK), Inovia Capital, Amadeus Capital Partners, Yaletown Partners
robotnik_take: Silicon spin-photon interface for fault-tolerant quantum networking; Microsoft co-investment plus a sweeping partnership marks one of the largest non-public-cloud quantum bets to date.

company_description: Develops AI-accelerated LFP and LMFP cathode chemistries for lithium-ion batteries. Operates an 'atoms-to-tons' platform combining computational chemistry with a pilot plant; GM is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: IQT (In-Q-Tel), TechMet-Mercuria, Zeon Ventures, Social Capital, Fontinalis Partners, Earthshot Ventures, Boutique Venture Partners, GS Futures, Bricks Capital, Bonds Investment Group
robotnik_take: AI-accelerated discovery of LMFP and other iron-based cathode active materials for US-onshored EV batteries. Series B totaling $60M closed in stages between August and November 2023; IQT participation in Q4 close adds national-security signal alongside GM offtake/dev partnership for Ultium platform.

company_description: Builds iron-nitride permanent magnets as a rare-earth-free alternative to neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) magnets. Strategic investment from GM and Stellantis anchors EV motor offtake; targets the supply-chain de-risking play against Chinese REE dominance.
co_investors: Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community, University of Minnesota, Volvo Cars Tech Fund, FootPrint Coalition, Glencore
robotnik_take: Iron-nitride permanent magnet alternative to NdFeB rare earths; direct OEM strategic investment from GM and Stellantis signals supply-chain de-risking play vs Chinese REE dominance. Demand-side substitution thesis vs MP Materials' upstream NdPr strategy.

company_description: Decentralized AI infrastructure protocol building an incentive layer for distributed compute, model training, and inference, structured as an EVM-compatible inference oracle. Founded by former Polychain partners.
co_investors: Accomplice, Robot Ventures, Balaji Srinivasan, Naval Ravikant, Sandeep Nailwal, Ojas Mehta, Tarun Chitra, Jay Drain, others
robotnik_take: Decentralized AI infrastructure protocol building incentive layer for distributed compute, model training, and inference. Founded by ex-Polychain partners. Sits at AI x crypto crossover similar to Bittensor and Gensyn but with EVM-compatible inference oracle approach.

company_description: Operates autonomous fixed-route shuttle services in US cities, on partner-municipality contracts. Strategic partner NTT holds exclusive Japan distribution rights for the platform.
co_investors: Toyota Ventures, Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, State Farm Ventures, BMW i Ventures, Cyrus Capital, Millennium Technology Value Partners, Trucks Venture Capital
robotnik_take: Strategic-led Series D from NTT carries exclusive Japan distribution rights; reads more as offtake structuring than pure financial bet. Total funding now ~$300M. Comp: while Cruise (GM) was unwinding and Pony.ai SPAC, May is positioning fixed-route AV as the more capital-efficient niche.

company_description: Direct recycler of lithium-ion batteries using low-temperature plasma-assisted separation (LPAS), which preserves the cathode crystal structure rather than breaking it down to raw metals. OEM validation through Wistron and Honda.
co_investors: Honda Motor Co., GS Futures, Traxys North America, SCG, Helena, Shoei Chemical
robotnik_take: Direct lithium-ion battery recycling using low-temperature plasma-assisted separation (LPAS) to produce battery-grade cathode/anode materials. Differentiated vs Redwood/Ascend's hydrometallurgy by preserving cathode crystal structure. OEM validation via Wistron and Honda.

company_description: Chinese commercial launch company also known as Beijing Tianbing Technology. Builds Tianlong-2 (in production) and is developing Tianlong-3, a Falcon 9-class reusable medium-lift rocket targeting more than 30 launches per year.
robotnik_take: Chinese launch firm raises CNY 700M+ Series C+ for Tianlong-3 reusable rocket development and Tianlong-2 production scale-up. Targeting >30 launches/year. Falcon 9-class reusable competitor. 12th funding round; cumulative funding 3B+ yuan.

company_description: Chinese industrial automation supplier producing servo drives, motion controllers, and PLCs for smart factories. Bosch holds a 5% strategic stake, anchoring Bosch-Rexroth integration into the Chinese industrial automation channel.
robotnik_take: Bosch takes 5% strategic stake in Chinese industrial automation supplier — a Bosch-Rexroth integration play targeting Chinese smart-factory market. Reads as Bosch hedging China-specific exposure as global automation supply chains bifurcate. Cross-border industrial M&A under increased scrutiny.

company_description: Premium robot vacuum maker using on-device computer vision (NVIDIA Jetson Orin) with 5-6 cameras instead of LiDAR. Privacy-by-default architecture keeps mapping data local; targets the premium home-robotics segment.
co_investors: Nat Friedman, Patrick Collison, John Collison, Adam D'Angelo, Jack Dorsey
robotnik_take: Premium robot vacuum using on-device CV (NVIDIA Jetson Orin) + 5-6 cameras instead of LiDAR; privacy-by-default architecture. Angel-led by tech founders rather than traditional VC — reads more like a consumer hardware bet than enterprise robotics. Comp: iRobot (IRBT) trading distressed; Matic targeting the white space premium iRobot vacated.

company_description: French designer of the Tyr family of automotive ADAS and autonomous driving compute IP for L2+ to L5 vehicles. Competes with NVIDIA Drive Thor and Mobileye EyeQ in the AV silicon stack.
robotnik_take: EIC backing of a French generative AI inference accelerator; part of EU's push to seed sovereign alternatives to NVDA/AMD in datacenter compute.

company_description: UK Cambridge spinout building Quantum Networking Units (QNUs) to interconnect multiple QPUs across machines. Tackles the scaling bottleneck that limits single-machine qubit counts at IonQ, Rigetti, and IBM.
lead_investors: Amadeus Capital Partners, Expeditions Fund, IQ Capital
co_investors: Ahren Innovation Capital, Seraphim Capital, University of Cambridge, Martlet, Presidio Ventures (Sumitomo), NSSIF, Deeptech Labs
robotnik_take: Building Quantum Networking Units (QNUs) to interconnect multiple QPUs; tackles the scaling bottleneck that limits IonQ/Rigetti/IBM-class systems to single-machine qubit counts.

company_description: Japanese industrial drone-inspection SaaS company providing aerial inspection workflows for power, oil and gas, and infrastructure operators. Strategic partner ENEOS anchors energy-sector deployments.
co_investors: Nabtesco Technology Ventures, Eneos Innovation Partners, Mizuho Bank, MUFG Bank, V-cube
robotnik_take: Mixed debt + equity from Japanese strategics + banks for industrial drone-inspection SaaS. JPY 2.25B reflects Japan's appetite to fund drones via consortium-style financings rather than VC equity rounds. Eneos energy major + bank syndication is the local model.

company_description: Builds zero-knowledge machine learning (zkML) provers that produce cryptographic proofs of AI inference correctness. Targets verifiable on-chain agents in DeFi and DePIN.
co_investors: Inflection, Bankless, Blockchain Builders Fund; angels: Ethereum Foundation, Worldcoin, Polygon, Celestia, Solana ecosystem leaders
robotnik_take: zkML (zero-knowledge machine learning) prover - delivers cryptographic proofs that AI inference was honestly executed. Critical primitive for verifiable on-chain agents in DeFi and DePIN. Adjacent to RISC Zero and Giza in the 'compute integrity' segment of decentralized AI.

company_description: Develops Hivemind, an AI autonomy stack for military aircraft and drones that enables operation in GPS- and communications-denied environments. Products include the V-BAT vertical-takeoff UAV and Hivemind-equipped fighter jet retrofits.
lead_investors: U.S. Innovative Technology Fund, Riot Ventures
co_investors: ARK Invest, Disruptive, Snowpoint
robotnik_take: Defense-tech autonomy stack for military aircraft (Hivemind). Series F at $2.7B post — the dominant defense-AI valuation in the window before December's expansion. Lead is Tom Tull's USIT, telegraphing US sovereign-aligned defense-tech offtake. Compares against public defense primes (LMT, NOC) at 1-2x sales versus Shield AI at high-double-digit revenue multiples.

company_description: Indian private launch developer building the Vikram-1 small launcher after a successful suborbital Vikram-S flight in November 2022. India's most-funded space-tech startup; Temasek is a strategic investor.
co_investors: GIC, Sherpalo Ventures, Graph Ventures
robotnik_take: Indian private launch leader. Pre-Series C brings total to $95M, highest in Indian spacetech. Vikram-1 small launcher targeting orbital flight after Vikram-S sub-orbital success in Nov 2022. Temasek's first Indian space investment signals geopolitical alignment.

company_description: Canadian developer of an AI platform that turns standard industrial robots into homebuilding factories — offsite construction robotics-as-a-service. Strategic partnership with the United Brotherhood of Carpenters union.
co_investors: Radical Ventures, PSP Investments, United Brotherhood of Carpenters, Relay Ventures, Alate Partners
robotnik_take: AI platform turning standard industrial robots into homebuilding factories — robotics-as-a-service in offsite construction. Strategic from United Brotherhood of Carpenters union signals labor cooperation rather than substitution narrative. Comp: BotBuilt (December seed) attacking same housing-shortage thesis.

company_description: Israeli developer of drone safety parachutes and the DefendAir counter-drone system. Public on NASDAQ (PRZO); products target enterprise drone operators and military counter-UAS customers.
robotnik_take: Public-company (Nasdaq: PRZO) registered direct offering — drone safety parachutes + counter-drone systems (DefendAir). At $1.10/share strike + warrants this is a microcap recap rather than a venture round.

company_description: German developer of a modular robotic kitchen assistant capable of preparing around 3,000 meals per day. Targets European hospitality customers facing labor shortages.
robotnik_take: Modular robotic kitchen assistant capable of 3,000 meals/day — vertical-specific cobot for hospitality. EU labor-shortage thesis. Fragmented market positioning vs. broader Picnic/Miso peers in the food robotics segment.

company_description: Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer that also builds the country's first lithium-ion cell gigafactory in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu. Phase I targets 5 GWh capacity scaling to 100 GWh; vertically integrated EV and battery cell producer for the Indian market. Listed on Indian exchanges.
robotnik_take: Debt tranche of pre-IPO $384M structured deal: $240M project finance from SBI for first Indian lithium-ion cell gigafactory. Equity companion is $140M Temasek-led Strategic tranche.

company_description: Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer that also builds the country's first lithium-ion cell gigafactory in Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu. Phase I targets 5 GWh capacity scaling to 100 GWh; vertically integrated EV and battery cell producer for the Indian market. Listed on Indian exchanges.
robotnik_take: Equity tranche of pre-IPO $384M structured deal: $140M Temasek-led equity to fund first Indian lithium-ion cell gigafactory (5GWh phase I → 100GWh ultimate target). Pre-IPO; companion $240M SBI debt is project finance.

company_description: Builds AI-driven autonomous greenhouses producing premium strawberries and other specialty produce, with a robotics-first stack from cultivation through picking. Founded by alumni of MIT, Plenty, and Root AI.
robotnik_take: $20M seed (large for stage) for AI-driven autonomous greenhouses — strawberries first, scaling to other premium produce. Khosla solo-led suggests high conviction. Founders from MIT, Plenty, Root AI. Targeting an 80% labor reduction in indoor ag, a category where Plenty/AppHarvest peers stumbled on unit economics.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of indoor mobile platforms and automated guided vehicles (AGVs). Backed by Sinochem Capital as a state-aligned vertical-integration play.
robotnik_take: Indoor mobile platforms / AGV maker raises Series B from Sinochem Capital — chemical major's industrial-automation play. Reads as Chinese state-aligned vertical integration: SOE LP backing domestic logistics-robotics capacity to substitute imports.

company_description: Japanese in-orbit servicing and active debris removal company. Operates the ELSA series for end-of-life satellite removal and is developing JAXA-contracted active debris removal missions. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
robotnik_take: Series G closing extension brings total Series G to ~$83.6M, total raised to $383M. Leading on-orbit servicing / debris removal pure play; subsequently IPO'd on Tokyo Stock Exchange in June 2024.

company_description: Develops autonomous driving software for robotaxi services and self-driving trucks, operating in both China and the US. Listed on NASDAQ (PONY) and partners with NEOM in Saudi Arabia for MENA market deployment.
robotnik_take: Strategic equity tied to a JV: NEOM gets local AV manufacturing/R&D + MENA distribution. Tracking against the ~$8.5B 2022 Series D mark, this is a flat valuation — sovereign cap as bridge to public listing (Pony.ai filed 2024 IPO). Strategic-led, not a fresh price round.

company_description: Operates a 50-state drone services marketplace connecting independent pilots with construction, agriculture, insurance, and telecom buyers. Marketplace business model rather than aircraft OEM.
robotnik_take: Drone services marketplace — connecting ~50-state network of pilots with construction/agri/insurance/telecom buyers. Operator-services positioning rather than aircraft-OEM. Closer to a vertical Uber-for-drones than a hardware bet.

company_description: Builds three-wheeled driverless electric vehicles for urban goods delivery, with remote TeleAssist supervision. Targets the micro-EV last-mile delivery TAM with a smaller-vehicle approach versus full-size robotaxis.
co_investors: Y Combinator alumni base
robotnik_take: Three-wheeled driverless EV fleets for urban delivery — smaller-vehicle TAM with TeleAssist supervision. Bet that micro-EVs ship goods reliably while the L4 robotaxi consumer market remains uncertain post-Cruise wind-down.

company_description: Indian manufacturer of dual-use drones for agricultural spraying, mapping, and defense applications. MS Dhoni is a brand-ambassador investor; benefits from India's drone PLI scheme.
co_investors: Hems Angels, San Angels, Peaceful Progress Funds
robotnik_take: M.S. Dhoni-backed bridge financing pre-IPO. Indian drone leader filing for ₹750 Cr IPO. Sub-$5M but flagship for India drone ecosystem and named-founder marquee profile.

company_description: Canadian designer of gallium nitride (GaN) power transistors for EV, data center, and consumer power applications. Acquired by Infineon for $830M in cash, giving Infineon 350+ GaN patent families and 450 engineers.
robotnik_take: All-cash $830M close; Infineon gains 350+ GaN patent families and 450 engineers, accelerating EV and AI-PSU GaN positioning vs. Navitas, Power Integrations and STMicroelectronics.

company_description: Builds the Vector reconnaissance UAS — a fixed-wing vertical-takeoff drone for tactical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. Sells to European militaries including the German Bundeswehr; active in Ukraine in combat use.
co_investors: Project A, Thiel Capital, ScaleUp Fonds Bayern, Omnes Capital, Airbus Ventures
robotnik_take: First European dual-use drone company past €100M total raised. Vector reconnaissance UAS in active service in Ukraine + German Bundeswehr offtake. The HV/DTCP/Thiel/Airbus syndicate is the cleanest articulation of EU strategic autonomy / defense-tech thesis emerging from the Russia-Ukraine war. Comp: AeroVironment (AVAV) trades ~5x sales.

company_description: Korean operator of drone delivery and drone light-show platforms. Pursuing a KOSDAQ tech listing; appointed the former Intel Pyeongchang Olympics drone choreographer as US VP.
robotnik_take: Pre-IPO/bridge ahead of planned 2H 2024 KOSDAQ tech-listing. Korean drone delivery + light-show platform. Strategic move appointing former Intel-Pyeongchang-Olympics drone choreographer Kenny Kim as US VP. Korea's pre-IPO drone funding model contrasts with US SPAC fatigue.

company_description: Operates a constellation of RF signal-intelligence satellites that geolocate radio emitters for maritime, defense, and intelligence customers. Detects dark vessels, jamming, and other RF activity invisible to optical or SAR sensors.
co_investors: Company insiders
robotnik_take: RF geospatial intelligence leader; Lockheed Martin Ventures investment plus strategic agreement closes Series D-1 at $68M total ($58M July 2023 + $10M October). Total funding ~$378M. Subsequently filed S-1 for IPO. Categorized as EO due to remote-sensing data product (RF emissions).

company_description: Develops Mega-class high-power satellites — large, high-capability spacecraft designed for the heavy-lift launch era opened by Starship-class vehicles. Sells to constellation operators and government customers wanting more capability per spacecraft than current smallsat designs.
co_investors: First Round Capital, Altimeter Capital
robotnik_take: Large satellite bus startup (Mega 1-ton, Giga 15-ton). Brings total to $16M. Bet on launch-cost decline making bigger sats economical with heavy/super-heavy lift (Falcon Heavy, Starship). Founders are SpaceX veterans.

company_description: Indian small-launch startup developing the Agnibaan SOrTeD launcher with 3D-printed liquid rocket engines (Agnilet). Beneficiary of India's liberalized 2023 Space Policy; targets Indian commercial smallsat customers.
co_investors: Rocketship.vc, Artha Select Fund, Mayfield India, pi Ventures
robotnik_take: Indian small-launch startup developing Agnibaan SOrTeD with 3D-printed engines. Total raised ~$40M; flagship private launcher targeting Indian commercial smallsat market. Indian spacetech beneficiary of liberalized 2023 Space Policy.

company_description: Direct lithium extraction company using its LiTAS molecular-separation membrane technology to recover lithium from brines without evaporation ponds. GM is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: Helios Climate Ventures, others
robotnik_take: Direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology using LiTAS molecular separation membrane. Series B initiated April 2023 with GM lead, finalizing tranches through Q4 2023. Plays the same DLE thesis as Lilac Solutions, EnergySource, IBAT - offering 5-10x faster extraction vs evaporation ponds.

company_description: Develops humanoid and cognitive robots equipped with onboard AI software for industrial and service applications. Flagship product is the 4NE1 humanoid, a 5.9-foot bipedal robot designed to understand natural-language instructions and handle payloads up to 220 pounds.
robotnik_take: Bolt-on $16M from US firm InterAlpen following the larger July 2023 €55M round. Cognitive cobots positioning ahead of NEURA's eventual €120M Series B (Jan 2025) and Tether-led 2026 round at €4B. Q4 2023 was the cheap entry point to what became the EU humanoid champion.

company_description: Chinese supplier of indoor mobile platforms and automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS) for warehouse automation.
robotnik_take: Large pre-seed for indoor mobile platforms/AS-RS — unusually big stage for $13.7M, suggests this is a venture-builder spin-out or restructured larger round catalogued as 'pre-seed'. Indicative of Chinese capital concentration in warehouse robotics.
Sensors / sensing systems Series A. Part of the broader Chinese sensor stack buildout that accelerated alongside humanoid funding in late 2023.

company_description: Chinese developer of outdoor mobile robotic platforms and sensors for industrial and autonomous-systems applications.
robotnik_take: Outdoor mobile platforms / sensors developer raises Series C. Chinese local-LP-led round indicative of the broader autonomous-systems sensor-stack consolidation in China that accelerated through 2024-25.

company_description: Builds underwater robotics for subsea inspection, maintenance, and repair work, primarily in offshore energy. Previously listed on NASDAQ (KITT) before delisting; operated the Aquanaut autonomous underwater vehicle.
co_investors: Transocean, ATW Partners, Material Impact, RCB Equities
robotnik_take: Convertible term loan tranche of an up-to-$20M facility (announced Sept 21, $11.6M drawn into Q4). Public-traded (KITT) underwater robotics nearing distress signals — the convertible structure at $6 strike was effectively dilution-deferred rescue financing. Eventually de-listed.

company_description: BMW Group's autonomous mobile robot subsidiary, developing the iw.hub AMR for automotive manufacturing logistics. Agile Robots became majority shareholder via a strategic Series A round.
co_investors: BMW Group (existing)
robotnik_take: Strategic Series A from Agile Robots — DLR spin-out becomes majority shareholder of BMW Group's AMR subsidiary. Cross-shareholding M&A more than financial round; precursor to Agile Robots' acquisition close. Indicative of EU AMR / cobot consolidation. Amount undisclosed.

company_description: Develops MoveIt Studio, a commercial software stack for robotic arms based on the open-source MoveIt motion planning framework. Holds SBIR contracts with NASA Johnson, NASA Ames, and the US Space Force.
robotnik_take: MoveIt Studio software for robot arms — out-of-factory applications. Augments $5M existing SBIR contracts with NASA JSC, NASA Ames, Space Force. Below pre-seed cutoff but flagship for ROS/MoveIt commercial trajectory and unique gov-tech traction.

company_description: Autonomous driving arm of Chinese ride-hailing company DiDi. Partners with GAC for joint robotaxi vehicle production for the Chinese market; municipal SOE investors (GAC Capital, GDDIG) provide state-backing for L4 rollout.
lead_investors: GAC Capital, Guangzhou Development District Investment Group
robotnik_take: Strategic equity from Guangzhou-municipal-aligned investors (GAC Capital + GDDIG); Didi's AV unit is leveraging municipal SOE backing for L4 robotaxi rollout. Reads as China-state robotaxi consolidation play parallel to Pony.ai/WeRide. Lockup with GAC for joint vehicle production by 2025.

company_description: Canadian-listed nickel-copper-cobalt mining company developing the Tamarack Nickel Project in Minnesota. Holds an offtake agreement with Tesla for Class 1 nickel; planning a Battery Minerals Processing Facility in North Dakota.
co_investors: Various institutional investors via non-brokered private placement of 80.35M shares at C$0.27/share
robotnik_take: Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project (Minnesota); offtake agreement with Tesla. Public-listed but raising private placement to advance feasibility for Battery Minerals Processing Facility in North Dakota. Critical to US domestic Class 1 nickel supply.

company_description: Japanese designer of embedded non-volatile memory (NVM) IP cores licensed to MCU and power-IC vendors. Ultra-low-power write/erase profile differentiates Floadia in embedded flash memory IP.
co_investors: Japan Finance Corporation (venture debt)
robotnik_take: Embedded NVM IP cores licensed to MCU and power-IC vendors; ultra-low-power write/erase profile (1/1,000,000 of competitor energy) is a niche play vs. mainstream embedded flash from TSM/UMC/GF.

company_description: French manufacturer of compact 6-axis collaborative robotic arms for education and light-industrial use. The European 'democratized cobot' player; competes with Universal Robots at a lower price point.
co_investors: IRD, Finorpa, NFA, Go Capital
robotnik_take: Compact 6-axis cobot arms — the European 'democratized cobot' play. €6.4M equity + €3.6M debt — French regional fund-heavy syndicate (BPI/IRD/Finorpa) typical for FR deep-tech. Comp: Universal Robots (Teradyne TER) at scale; Niryo positioning at education/light-industrial price point.

company_description: Cloud robotics data ops platform — software that ingests, visualizes, and manages telemetry from robot fleets. Customers include Blue River Technology/John Deere, BP, and Knightscope.
co_investors: Intel Capital, GS Futures, SignalFire, Hillsven, Pelion Ventures, Holman, Ericsson, Goodyear Ventures, PICUS Capital, Thursday Ventures
robotnik_take: Cloud robotics data ops platform — picks-and-shovels for fleets. 500% YoY revenue growth with marquee logos (Blue River/Deere, BP, Knightscope). BMW iV + Intel + Ericsson + Goodyear strategics signal automotive/industrial fleet interest in robotics middleware. Comp: ROS-based / open-source competition vs. Formant's enterprise SaaS positioning.

company_description: Canadian designer of ultra-low-power Wi-Fi and multi-protocol radio SoCs for battery-less IoT edge devices. Murata is a strategic investor providing Japan supply-chain alignment.
co_investors: Stanford University, Mika, Ecofuel Fund, Chrysalix, TandemLaunch
robotnik_take: Ultra-low-power Wi-Fi/multi-protocol radio SoCs for IoT; Murata's strategic check signals Japan supply-chain alignment for battery-less IoT edge devices.

company_description: Builds a robotics platform combining drones and ground robots with AI analytics backend for autonomous utility and infrastructure inspection. Holds a US Air Force contract at Grand Forks AFB.
co_investors: Minnkota Power Cooperative, Generational Partners, Rosecliff Ventures, Excell Partners, Homegrown Capital, Wonder Fund North Dakota
robotnik_take: Robotics platform for autonomous utility/infrastructure inspection — drones + ground robots fed into AI analytics backend. Active US Air Force contract at Grand Forks AFB. Niche, application-specific autonomy that avoids competing with Skydio/Anduril at the platform layer.

company_description: Operates an open-source cloud chip design and tapeout marketplace. Strategic backing from GlobalFoundries and Synopsys; targets the high-NRE moat held by traditional EDA vendors.
co_investors: individual investors
robotnik_take: Open-source / cloud chip design + tapeout marketplace; foundry (GFS) and EDA (SNPS) co-investment is a tell for the open-IP push that targets the high-NRE moat held by SNPS/CDNS.

company_description: Builds autonomous surface vessels (Spyglass and Cutlass classes) for the US Navy. Founded by former Navy SEAL Dino Mavrookas; targets maritime unmanned systems as a follow-on category to aerial defense autonomy. (Same company as Saronic; this row covers earlier funding rounds.)
co_investors: 8VC, U.S. Innovative Technology Fund, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Point72 Ventures, Silent Ventures, Overmatch Ventures, Ensemble VC, Cubit Capital
robotnik_take: Founded by ex-Navy SEAL Dino Mavrookas; building autonomous surface vessels (Spyglass, Cutlass) for USN. Caffeinated/8VC/a16z/Lightspeed all in the same defense-tech round signals that maritime autonomy is the next frontier after aerial (Anduril, Shield AI). By Feb 2025 Saronic was a $4B unicorn — Q4 2023 was the entry point.

company_description: Develops Nova, a fully reusable two-stage medium-lift rocket. Both stages are designed to return and land for refurbishment. Targets US national security launch contracts (NSSL Phase 3 Lane 1) alongside commercial customers.
co_investors: University of Michigan, Sparta Group, Long Journey, Breakthrough Energy, Y Combinator, Point72 Ventures, NFX, MaC Ventures, Toyota Ventures, In-Q-Tel
robotnik_take: Reusable rocket developer; $100M Series B funds Nova rocket development and Cape Canaveral pad LC-14 infrastructure. Total to date $175M. Pursuing fully reusable architecture vs. RKLB Neutron's partial reusability.

company_description: Builds 'roboformer' cells — pairs of robot arms that shape sheet metal and composite parts incrementally without dies, using AI to plan toolpaths. Sells to aerospace and defense manufacturers as a flexible alternative to traditional metal forming.
robotnik_take: AI + robotics roboforming for aerospace/defense composite & metal parts. NVIDIA's NVentures co-leading — ties Machina to the Omniverse/Isaac stack and signals NVDA's strategic posture as the picks-and-shovels supplier across all robotics. Total raised $45M. Comp: traditional CNC players trading 1-2x sales versus Machina at high multiples on contract pipeline.

company_description: Builds a software-defined AI accelerator using the PAL log-number representation. Positions as a hardware-agnostic abstraction layer over GPUs and accelerators, targeting the CUDA-moat problem alongside MatX, Tenstorrent, and Modular.
co_investors: Good Growth Capital, Raptor Group, Alumni Ventures
robotnik_take: Software-defined accelerator using PAL log-number system; positioning as hardware-agnostic abstraction layer over GPUs—aimed at the same NVDA-CUDA moat MatX, Tenstorrent and Modular target.

company_description: Swiss developer of time-of-flight mass spectrometers for real-time process gas analysis in semiconductor fabs. Targets metrology applications at TSMC, Samsung, and Intel as a competitor to MKS Instruments.
co_investors: Spectrum Moonshot Fund, existing shareholders
robotnik_take: Time-of-flight mass spectrometers for real-time process gas analysis in semi fabs—metrology niche supplying TSM/Samsung/INTC fabs (compete adjacency to MKSI, FORM).

company_description: Builds a foundation model for mobility paired with a low-cost LiDAR-replacement sensor for last-mile delivery and factory robots. Founded by the former Velodyne CEO and former Apple/Lyft engineers.
co_investors: Lockheed Martin Ventures, ReMY Investors
robotnik_take: Stealth-exit seed: foundation model for mobility + low-cost LiDAR-replacing sensor. Founders are ex-Velodyne CEO + ex-Apple/Lyft. Khosla solo-led + LMV strategic: signals dual commercial (last-mile, factory) and defense readiness. Comp: Velodyne (VLDR) trading distressed when Vayu pitches a structurally cheaper sensor.

company_description: Swiss ETH Zurich spinout building force-torque sensors with built-in electronics and AI for collaborative robots. Supplies major research labs and industrial cobot integrators.
robotnik_take: Force-torque sensors with built-in electronics + AI for cobots — gives robots a sense of touch. Below normal seed-cutoff but flagship for Swiss / EU robot-sensor stack and supplies major research labs. ETH spin-out lineage.

company_description: Builds vision-based autonomy retrofits for orchard equipment that operates without GPS in dusty and debris-filled environments. Targets nut-orchard labor shortages; later renamed farm-ng.
co_investors: E14, Congruent, Serra Ventures, Fall Line Capital, SNR Ventures, Andros
robotnik_take: Vision-based autonomy for orchard equipment — operates without GPS in dust/debris. Total raised $13.5M. Targeting nut-orchard labor shortage. Concrete OEM-retrofit business model rather than full-stack robot. (Later renamed farm-ng.)

company_description: Shenzhen-based developer of bipedal and quadrupedal humanoid robots for general-purpose legged locomotion. Lenovo Capital is a strategic investor connecting to Lenovo's broader robotics ecosystem.
co_investors: FreeS Fund, Stalagnate Capital, Future Capital, Kinzon Capital, Lenovo Capital and Incubator Group
robotnik_take: Combined angel + pre-A round (CNY 200M) for Shenzhen-based bipedal/quadrupedal humanoid play. Lenovo Capital lead in pre-A connects to broader Lenovo robotics ecosystem ambitions. Together with Zhiyuan Robotics, signals concentrated Chinese humanoid funding wave bridging into 2024.

company_description: Ecuadorian operator of drone-based urban aerial logistics services across Latin America. Contracts with the region's largest parcel delivery company; positioned as LatAm's regional drone-delivery champion.
co_investors: GENIUS NY (grant)
robotnik_take: Drone-based urban aerial logistics for LATAM; carries contracts from Latam's largest parcel company. Sub-$5M Series A makes the cut on flagship-coverage exception (LatAm regional drone-delivery champion).

company_description: Multi-orbit satellite operator formed by the 2023 merger of GEO operator Eutelsat and LEO operator OneWeb. Targets multi-orbit broadband and connectivity services as a European Starlink challenger.
co_investors: Eutelsat shareholders / OneWeb (Bharti, UK Government, SoftBank, Hanwha)
robotnik_take: Major satellite-comms M&A: Eutelsat (GEO) + OneWeb (LEO) combine into multi-orbit group valued at $3.4B at deal close. Key Starlink challenger structure for Europe. Closed via Eutelsat shareholder vote 28 Sep 2023; OneWeb retains UK ops as Eutelsat OneWeb. Targeting EUR 2B 2027 revenue.

company_description: Chinese developer of Autoware-aligned automotive system software — the operating system layer for L4 vehicles. Foxconn is a strategic investor anchoring integrator reach.
co_investors: Forebright Capital, Redbanyan Venture
robotnik_take: B2 round for Autoware-aligned automotive system software stack. Smaller China deal at the operating-system layer of L4 vehicles — Foxconn earlier strategic backer signals integrator reach.

company_description: Builds the OptiX software-defined imaging product and the CorteX edge-AI compute platform for inline visual defect detection in semiconductor wafer dicing, wirebond, and packaging.
robotnik_take: Software-defined imaging (OptiX) + edge-AI compute (CorteX) for inline visual defect detection across wafer dicing, IC wirebond, packaging. Schneider lead extends industrial AI playbook into semi-back-end inspection; capacity-add for 3D-IC/chiplet QC.

company_description: Builds the Dream Chaser reusable spaceplane for cargo missions to the International Space Station, and develops satellites and orbital infrastructure including the LIFE inflatable habitat for commercial space stations. Increasingly focused on national-security space contracts.
lead_investors: MUFG Bank / Kanematsu / Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance (Japanese strategic consortium)
co_investors: General Atlantic, Coatue, Moore Strategic Ventures, Sierra Holding Company, BlackRock Private Equity Partners, AE Industrial Partners, Vice Family Trust
robotnik_take: Massive Series B at $5.3B valuation with $3.4B in active contracts. Funds Dream Chaser spaceplane and commercial space station; key in-orbit services / commercial LEO destination play. One of the largest private space rounds of 2023.

company_description: Develops 3D microLED display technology manufactured on 8-inch silicon wafers, spun out of CEA-Leti. Targets AR, VR, and smartphone display markets, competing with Korean OLED and other microLED entrants.
co_investors: CEA Investissement, Supernova Invest, Braemar Energy Ventures, French State
robotnik_take: €120M from existing investors plus French sovereign capital to industrialize 3D microLED on 8-inch silicon (CEA-Leti spinout). Total raised exceeds €360M; positions France in the AR/VR/smartphone display race vs. Korean/US incumbents. Display-semis substrate adjacency rather than pure logic semis.

company_description: Designs edge AI inference chips capable of running compact LLMs on-device. Foxconn is a strategic investor anchoring automotive and Taiwanese ODM ecosystem distribution.
lead_investors: Foxconn, HH-CTBC Partnership (Foxconn Co-GP Fund), Alltek
co_investors: Liteon Technology Corporation, Adata (existing investors)
robotnik_take: Edge AI chip extension brings total Series B to $97M and total funding to ~$190M. Foxconn lead foreshadows the auto + Taiwanese ODM ecosystem path; deploys nano-GPT models on edge silicon—the on-device inference comp for what cloud GPT-4 needs in NVDA H100s.

company_description: Nagoya University spinout — sole supplier of semiconductor photocathode electron-beam systems for sub-3nm defect inspection. Targets e-beam wafer pattern inspection economics with USHIO as exclusive distributor.
robotnik_take: Nagoya University spinout, sole supplier of semiconductor photocathode e-beam systems (>10x brighter than thermal field emission, world-first DSeB switching). 730M JPY strategic raise + sole-distribution deal with USHIO targets e-beam wafer pattern inspection — critical for sub-3nm defect inspection economics.

company_description: Builds Moxi, a service robot for hospitals that handles non-clinical errands like supply delivery. Customers include Northwestern Medicine, with 100+ Moxi units deployed across more than 30 hospitals.
co_investors: True Ventures, DNX Ventures, Next Coast Ventures, Northwestern Medicine Innovation
robotnik_take: Health-system buyer expansion round — Northwestern Medicine joins as strategic + customer. Targets 100+ Moxi units across 30 hospitals by year-end 2023; rare healthcare-robotics scale signal.

company_description: Builds underwater robotics for subsea inspection, maintenance, and repair work, primarily in offshore energy. Previously listed on NASDAQ (KITT) before delisting; operated the Aquanaut autonomous underwater vehicle.
lead_investors: Transocean, ATW Partners, Material Impact, RCB Equities
robotnik_take: Senior secured term loan ($11.6M funded immediately). Convertible at $6/share; 12.5% coupon. Funds Aquanaut underwater autonomous robot commercialization with Transocean offshore offtake.

company_description: Develops the Versius surgical robotic system for soft-tissue laparoscopic surgery. The platform is modular — separate arms on independent carts instead of a single bulky tower — and competes with Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci across more than 15,000 procedures globally.
lead_investors: SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Ally Bridge Group
co_investors: Cambridge Innovation Capital, Escala Capital, LGT, Lightrock, RPMI Railpen, Tencent, Watrium
robotnik_take: Inside round at flat-to-down valuation amid surgical robotics correction (cf. ISRG, RBOT). Versius platform crossed 15K procedures globally; capital extends commercial runway against entrenched Intuitive da Vinci competition.

company_description: Builds human-assisted autonomy software for yard trucking at ports, factories, and intermodal terminals. Partnerships with Volkswagen, DB Schenker, and HHLA anchor commercial deployments in industrial logistics.
co_investors: Munich Re Ventures, Bayern Kapital, Klaus Kleinfeld
robotnik_take: Brought FERNRIDE Series A to $50M total (initial $31M + $19M extension). Human-assisted autonomy approach for yard trucking — partnerships with Volkswagen, DB Schenker, HHLA validate port/factory deployment thesis vs pure-L4 trucking peers.

company_description: Builds MIRA, a 2-pound miniature robot-assisted surgery device that fits inside a surgical tray. Received FDA de novo authorization for colectomy in 2024; conducted an ISS demonstration with NASA targeting telesurgery applications.
robotnik_take: Series C extension brings total raised to >$137M. MIRA mini-RAS (2lb robot in surgical tray) — won FDA de novo for colectomy in 2024. Pre-clearance financing; ISS demo with NASA underscores telesurgery thesis.

company_description: Dutch TNO spinout building high-throughput scanning probe metrology tools — QUADRA for surface metrology and AUDIRA for subsurface — for advanced-node semiconductor manufacturing. Targets 3D NAND and gate-all-around metrology bottlenecks.
co_investors: Invest-NL, Innovation Industries, TNO (existing)
robotnik_take: TNO spinout, leader in high-throughput non-destructive scanning probe metrology (QUADRA surface, AUDIRA subsurface). €16M extension ($17.1M) closes round at €27M total. Critical capacity-add as advanced node metrology bottlenecks (3D NAND, gate-all-around) intensify.

company_description: Builds an autonomous space traffic coordination and collision-avoidance platform for satellite operators and the US Space Force. The Pathfinder product provides automated conjunction screening and maneuver recommendations.
robotnik_take: Autonomous space traffic coordination / collision avoidance platform; brings cumulative VC raise to $10.7M. Boulder-area startup serving commercial satellite operators and Space Force. Pathfinder 3.0 product launch alongside funding. Comparable to LeoLabs / Privateer in space situational awareness niche.

company_description: Develops the RAMP/AML100 analog ML core for always-on edge sensing at near-zero power. Targets battery-powered always-on audio and sensor-fusion applications including automotive dashcams.
co_investors: Birchmere Ventures, Mountain State Capital, Riverfront Ventures, Unitrontech (new)
robotnik_take: Analog ML core (RAMP/AML100) for always-on edge sensing at near-zero power. Total funding now >$19M. Unitrontech (Korean automotive distributor) entry signals automotive OEM pull for analog AI; addresses always-on dashcam/sensor-fusion use cases.

company_description: Manufactures the Switchblade loitering munition, Puma and Raven small UAS, and other military unmanned systems. Public on NASDAQ (AVAV); a primary US tactical UAS supplier to the Department of Defense and allied militaries.
robotnik_take: DoD Switchblade-class loitering munitions contracts — early validation of NASDAQ:AVAV's UAS platform pre-Ukraine ramp. Pre-cursor to $990M Switchblade contract Aug 2024. Defense-tech autonomy budget surge.

company_description: Chinese L4 autonomous driving software supplier for robotaxi stacks. Targets the domestic Chinese AV market alongside Pony.ai and WeRide.
robotnik_take: L4 / robotaxi-stack supplier — small Series B but indicative of continued China AV-tier financing despite sector-wide global pullback (cf. Cruise, Argo wind-downs).
Chinese surgical robotics provider continuing series-funding amid sector-specific capital availability — notable that surgical/medical was largest share of September 2023 China robotics financings.

company_description: Chinese industrial robotics integrator based in Hunan province. Targets domestic Chinese factory automation, backed by local-government industrial guidance funds.
robotnik_take: Industrial robotics integrator — Hunan-province automation play. Mid-tier industrial-robot deals continued as Chinese local-government industrial guidance funds doubled down.

company_description: Korean KAIST spinout building CXL 3.0 hardware for disaggregated memory architectures. Only company to publicly demonstrate CXL 3.0 hardware; targets AMD, Meta, and other hyperscalers exploring CXL fabrics for HBM and AI inference disaggregation.
co_investors: SL Investment, Smilegate Investment, GNTech Venture Capital, Time Works Investment, Yuanta Investment, Quantum Ventures Korea
