robotnik_take: KAIST spinout led by Prof. Myoungsoo Jung; only enterprise to publicly demo CXL 3.0 hardware. $12.5M (KRW 16B) seed at $81.4M post-money. Validates rising disaggregated-memory thesis as AMD/Meta study CXL fabrics for HBM/AI inference disaggregation.

company_description: Builds driverless last-mile parcel sortation kiosks for carriers and 3PLs — depot-level robotic platforms that automate the package-to-route sorting step. Niche between full ASRS systems and human-driven hubs.
robotnik_take: Last-mile parcel sortation kiosks (driver-less depot platform). Carrier/3PL automation — niche between full ASRS and human-driven hubs.

company_description: Korean industrial and service robot systems integrator. Provides robotic cell deployment and integration services to manufacturing and service customers.
robotnik_take: Korean industrial/service robot integrator — pre-IPO style financing common in Korea ahead of Doosan Robotics Oct 2023 IPO that anchored regional sentiment.

company_description: UPenn GRASP Lab spinout building autonomous drone fleets for forestry and timber inventorying. Targets carbon-credit verification and private-timberland inventory management.
robotnik_take: Autonomous drone fleet for forestry/timber inventorying — UPenn GRASP Lab spin-out. Niche aerial-robotics play in carbon-credits + private-timberland market.

company_description: UK developer of robotic spray-foam under-floor insulation systems for residential retrofit applications. Targets the UK home energy retrofit market.
robotnik_take: Robotic spray-foam under-floor insulation — niche construction-robotics play. UK climate-tech intersect; tied to UK retrofit market policy.

company_description: Designs and licenses CPU architectures (the ARM instruction set) used in nearly every smartphone and increasingly in PCs, automotive, and data center applications. Public on NASDAQ (ARM); SoftBank holds a controlling stake.
lead_investors: Barclays, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Mizuho (lead bookrunners)
co_investors: SoftBank (selling shareholder, retained 90.6%); cornerstone investors: Apple, Google, NVIDIA, Samsung, AMD, Intel, TSMC, Cadence, Synopsys
robotnik_take: Largest IPO of 2023; SoftBank-controlled IP licensor priced at $51/share, jumped 24.7% on Nasdaq debut. Anchor investors filled ~10% of float. Set the AI-cycle benchmark valuation north of 100x earnings, dwarfing pre-IPO public comps (AVGO, INTC).

company_description: Builds the Dunkirk lithium-ion battery gigafactory in northern France, with Renault as anchor offtake customer for high-performance NMC cells. Positioned alongside Northvolt and ACC in the European battery sovereignty effort.
co_investors: Renault Group, EQT Ventures, EIT InnoEnergy, Sibanye-Stillwater, Credit Agricole Assurances, Pulse, Arkema
robotnik_take: Series C of €850M ($916M) plus €600M EIB debt and €650M French subsidies = €2.1B total package for Dunkirk gigafactory. Renault offtake is anchor demand. Europe's bid for battery sovereignty alongside Northvolt and ACC.

company_description: Develops Hivemind, an AI autonomy stack for military aircraft and drones that enables operation in GPS- and communications-denied environments. Products include the V-BAT vertical-takeoff UAV and Hivemind-equipped fighter jet retrofits.
lead_investors: U.S. Innovative Technology Fund, Riot Ventures
co_investors: ARK Invest
robotnik_take: Initial Series F close at $2.5B post-money for V-BAT autonomous aircraft maker. Round later expanded to ~$500M total by Dec 2023 at $2.8B valuation — defense-tech autonomy thesis durable through ZIRP unwind (cf. Anduril, Saronic).

company_description: Develops lithium-sulfur EV battery cells using its 3D Graphene supermaterial platform. Cobalt- and nickel-free chemistry positioned as an alternative to Asian NMC and LFP cell incumbents; Stellantis is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: Stellantis, FedEx, Honeywell, Walbridge Aldinger Company
robotnik_take: Lithium-sulfur cells using 3D graphene from methane; cobalt/nickel/manganese/graphite-free. Total equity now >$410M. Strategic Stellantis tie-in signals OEM appetite for non-China supply chain even at lower energy density.

company_description: Designs the Accelerated Compute Fabric Switch (ACF-S), a networking chip that disaggregates and scales memory and bandwidth across AI clusters. Targets hyperscale AI training and inference infrastructure, complementing rather than replacing networking silicon from Broadcom and NVIDIA.
co_investors: Sutter Hill Ventures, IAG Capital, Liberty Global, NVIDIA, Valor Equity Partners, Infinitum, Alumni Ventures
robotnik_take: Accelerated Compute Fabric Switch (ACF-S) silicon for AI clusters; oversubscribed Series B priced at 5x Series A post-money. NVIDIA participation underscores complementary positioning vs. AVGO Tomahawk/Jericho networking ASICs. Reports of 50% lower compute cost and 50x memory expansion.

company_description: Develops autonomous driving software for Class 8 freight trucks and for off-road and defense ground vehicles. Went public via SPAC merger with AACT in 2025 at approximately $2.5B.
robotnik_take: Convertible note bridge financing during AV trucking down-cycle (cf. Embark shutdown, TuSimple delistings). Kodiak ultimately did SPAC merger via AACT in 2025 at $2.5B, demonstrating staying power.

company_description: French developer of Processing-in-Memory (PIM) accelerator chips that put compute inside DRAM. Claims up to 10x energy reduction on AI and big-data workloads versus CPU baselines.
co_investors: Partech, Western Digital Capital, C4 Ventures
robotnik_take: Processing-in-Memory (PIM) accelerator pioneer; €7M = €4.1M equity + €2.5M EIC grant. WD Capital re-up signals storage-vendor interest in DRAM-side compute as memory wall persists. Up to 10x energy reduction on AI/big-data workloads vs CPU baseline.

company_description: Recycles lithium-ion batteries and produces cathode active materials (CAM) and precursor (pCAM) using its Hydro-to-Cathode process, which synthesizes new cathode directly from recovered black mass. Operates plants in Massachusetts, Georgia, and Kentucky as a domestic alternative to Chinese cathode supply.
lead_investors: Decarbonization Partners, Temasek, Qatar Investment Authority
co_investors: Tenaska, Alliance Resource Partners, PULSE - CMA CGM Energy Fund, BHP Ventures, Fifth Wall, Hitachi Ventures, Mirae Asset, At One Ventures, Agave Partners, Alumni Ventures
robotnik_take: $460M Series D + $82M earlier 2023 equity. Hydro-to-Cathode direct precursor synthesis for pCAM/CAM from recycled black mass. Complements $480M DoE grants for Hopkinsville, KY plant. Domestic alternative to Chinese cathode supply.

company_description: UK satellite startup providing turnkey smallsat missions and operating the OpenConstellation virtual satellite-sharing platform. Targets governments and commercial operators wanting end-to-end mission delivery.
co_investors: Accenture Ventures, Banco Santander InnoEnergy Climate Tech Fund, Claret Capital Partners, Taavet Hinrikus, Kheng Nam Lee
robotnik_take: UK satellite startup providing end-to-end smallsat missions and OpenConstellation virtual sharing platform. Capital lifts company beyond cubesats into larger spacecraft and constellations. Compares with Planet/Spire as integrator-operator EO play.

company_description: Specialty-process foundry in Shanghai producing analog and power ICs for the Chinese automotive chip market. Targets the same product categories as Onsemi and STMicroelectronics fabs, with output focused on domestic auto-chip self-sufficiency.
co_investors: Institutional investors (state-backed)
robotnik_take: 13.5B yuan ($1.85B) state-aligned cap injection — the largest single semis financing in Shanghai of 2023. GTA is the auto-IC analog/specialty-process foundry for China's auto-chip self-sufficiency push, the closest analog to Onsemi/STMicro power-IC fabs. Total funding ~$2.7B over two years.

company_description: Builds green steel using hydrogen-based direct reduced iron (H-DRI) instead of coal-fired blast furnaces. Targets 95% emissions reduction with a planned 2.5 Mt/year output from a new plant in Boden, Sweden. Renamed Stegra after the initial H2 Green Steel build phase.
co_investors: Andra AP-fonden, Temasek, AMF, Cristina Stenbeck, Hitachi Energy, IMAS Foundation, Kinnevik, Schaeffler, Vargas, Wallenberg Investments (FAM)
robotnik_take: Largest European private placement of 2023. Hydrogen-DRI green steel for the Boden, Sweden plant. Targets 95% emissions reduction vs blast furnace; 2.5Mt/yr production by 2026. The European answer to Boston Metal's MOE approach, validated by sovereign-tier capital.

company_description: Builds self-driving software for Class 8 freight trucks. Founded by former Argo AI leadership after Argo's 2022 shutdown; SoftBank is the sole investor and strategic backer.
robotnik_take: Sole-investor SoftBank Group bet on the founding team that built Argo AI (shut down by Ford/VW in 2022). Largest autonomous trucking financing of the year — signals SoftBank's continued AV thesis post-Cruise/Aurora exits.

company_description: Dutch developer of Cri/oFlex multi-layer flexible superconducting cables for cryogenic quantum I/O. Critical picks-and-shovels infrastructure for superconducting and spin-qubit quantum systems.
co_investors: High-Tech Gründerfonds (existing)
robotnik_take: Cri/oFlex multi-layer flexible superconducting cables for cryogenic quantum I/O. Backed by Brainport Eindhoven ecosystem (ASML, Philips LPs in DTXL). Critical infrastructure pick-and-shovel for any qubit modality (super-conducting, semi-spin) requiring sub-Kelvin scaling.

company_description: Commercializes molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for producing primary steel and high-value metals directly by electrochemistry, eliminating blast furnace coal consumption. MIT spinout; ships high-value metals as first revenue product, with full MOE green steel targeted for later commercialization.
co_investors: Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, SiteGround Capital, IFC (World Bank), Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BHP Ventures, Prelude Ventures, M&G Investments, Goehring & Rozencwajg, Baillie Gifford
robotnik_take: Final close of Series C ($120M earlier + $140M Sept). Molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for green steel — MIT spinout commercializing direct-electrolyte primary steel production. High-value metals first revenue 2024; full MOE steel by 2026. Aramco joining is meaningful for Saudi Vision 2030 industrial linkage.

company_description: Designs Corsair, a digital in-memory compute (DIMC) chiplet inference platform for generative AI workloads. Targets inference cost economics that GPU-based systems struggle with at scale; Microsoft M12 is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Playground Global, M12 (Microsoft), Nautilus Venture Partners, Entrada Ventures, Industry Ventures, Ericsson Ventures, Marlan Holding, Mirae Asset, Cortes Capital, Archerman Capital, TGC Square, Lam Capital, Samsung Ventures
robotnik_take: Series B for digital in-memory compute (DIMC) chiplet inference platform 'Corsair'; total funding to $154M. Microsoft M12 participation signals hyperscaler interest in non-GPU inference economics, positioning d-Matrix vs. NVDA H100 inference dominance.

company_description: Italian open-source microcontroller platform serving developers, students, and increasingly enterprise embedded-AI customers. Strategic investors include Bosch, Renesas, and ARM; expanding into enterprise cloud-managed IoT through US operations.
co_investors: Arm, Bosch Ventures (existing), Renesas Electronics (existing)
robotnik_take: $22M follow-on extension takes Series B to $54M (initial $32M led by Bosch/Renesas in 2022). Arm joins to back enterprise/embedded-AI push and US expansion (Austin, Chicago). Open-source MCU platform's pivot to commercial cloud/EdgeAI is structurally important — every long-tail IoT/robotics/PhysAI product passes through Arduino dev cycles.

company_description: Develops TrueTwin, a cloud platform that digitally simulates and operates satellites end-to-end — effectively a 'satellite OS' product. Lockheed Martin Ventures is a strategic investor.
co_investors: HCVC, E2MC, Acequia Capital, Possible Ventures, Lockheed Martin Ventures, Ananth Technologies, Antaris founders
robotnik_take: Preferred seed extension brings cumulative seed-stage raise to nearly $10M. Antaris's TrueTwin cloud platform digitally simulates and operates satellites end-to-end - a 'satellite OS' wedge. Lockheed Martin Ventures participation signals defense pull-through. Compares with Loft Federal/Quindar.

company_description: Develops the MujinController platform — a robot-agnostic control system that orchestrates warehouse and factory automation. Powers more than 1,000 warehouse systems globally, with deployments at Japanese distributor Paltac showing ~90% labor reduction in palletizing.
co_investors: Pegasus Tech Ventures, Accenture
robotnik_take: MujinController platform powers >1,000 warehouse systems globally; Paltac case showed ~90% labor reduction in palletizing. Capital funds U.S./EU expansion vs. Symbotic, AutoStore, GreyOrange.

company_description: Korean fabless designer of AI inference accelerators (X220, X330). Spinout of SK Telecom, SK Hynix, and SK Square; merged with Rebellions in 2024 to consolidate Korea's sovereign AI silicon effort.
co_investors: GS Group affiliates, Daebo Communication & Systems, Hana Financial Group, Mirae Asset Venture Investment, We Ventures, E1 Corporation
robotnik_take: SK Telecom/SK Hynix/SK Square spinout's first external Series A at 60B KRW ($45.4M), valued $378M. Builds Korean-sovereign AI inference accelerator (X220/X330) ecosystem; precursor to 2024 merger with Rebellions to consolidate Korean fabless AI silicon.

company_description: Recycles end-of-life lithium-ion batteries and manufactures battery materials, including anode copper foil and cathode active materials, from the recovered metals. Operating plants in Nevada and South Carolina supply both EV battery makers and grid storage customers, positioned as a domestic alternative to Chinese cathode/anode supply chains.
lead_investors: Goldman Sachs Asset Management, Capricorn's Technology Impact Fund, T. Rowe Price
co_investors: OMERS, Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, Deepwater Asset Management
robotnik_take: JB Straubel's vertically-integrated battery recycler hits $5B post; total equity at $2B. Building anode copper foil and cathode active materials in Nevada/South Carolina. The closest US analog to a domestic ALB+LAC play through circular economy.

company_description: Israeli developer of ElliQ, a tabletop social companion robot for older adults. Deployed under contracts with the New York State Office for the Aging; Toyota's Woven Capital is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Toyota Ventures, OurCrowd, Western Technology Investment
robotnik_take: $20M equity + $5M venture debt — Woven Capital (Toyota's growth fund) doubling down post-NY State of Aging contract. ElliQ daily engagement >30 interactions/user; 95% reduced-loneliness reports. Pre-LLM social-robotics moat.

company_description: Builds space robotics for satellite servicing and lunar surface operations — robotic arms and rovers for in-orbit assembly and lunar exploration. Japanese-founded with US operations expanding for lunar demonstrations.
co_investors: Green Co-Invest Investment, Pacific Bays Capital, Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital, MUFG Bank
robotnik_take: Extension closes total Series B at $45M. Space robotics for satellite servicing, lunar surface — competing with U.S. Astrobotic and ispace incumbents. Capital primarily for U.S. expansion + lunar demo.

company_description: Indian earth-observation and AI analytics platform serving agriculture and financial institution credit risk assessment. Developing four high-resolution optical and multispectral satellites for its own constellation.
lead_investors: Baring Private Equity Partners India, Promus Ventures
co_investors: Omidyar Network India, xto10X, Force Ventures, Luckbox Ventures, IndigoEdge Advisors
robotnik_take: Indian EO + AI platform serving agriculture / financial-institution credit risk. Series A funds four high-resolution optical/multispectral satellites planned for Q4 2025 plus Americas/APAC expansion. Closely tied to India's Chandrayaan-3 lunar success driving investor interest in India space stack.

company_description: Swiss designer of Chord-signaling SerDes IP, chiplet die-to-die retimers, and USB4/PCIe Gen 5 silicon. Licenses interconnect IP to chip designers as a Synopsys/Cadence-adjacent supplier in the chiplet era.
co_investors: Total round target $100M; existing investor base
robotnik_take: First close of Series E for Chord-signaling SerDes IP and chiplet/USB4/PCIe Gen 5 retimer silicon. Kandou's signaling IP positions it as a Synopsys/Cadence-adjacent IP supplier in the chiplet era; secondary close planned for remaining $27.7M.

company_description: Chinese surgical robotics company developing the Carina robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) modular system. Founded by veterans of Intuitive Surgical and Auris Health, targeting the Chinese market against Versius, Toumai, and Edge.
co_investors: Kington Capital, Lilly Asia Ventures, Vivo Capital, Matrix Partners, GGV Capital, LongRiver Investments
robotnik_take: Pre-B+ round for Carina RAS modular surgical robot. Founded by ex-Intuitive (J. Ma) + ex-Auris (Y. Mao) execs — recreates the J&J Auris playbook for the Chinese market against Versius/Toumai/Edge.

company_description: Vertically integrated lithium-ion battery cell manufacturer for European automotive and grid storage markets. Operated gigafactories in Sweden and Germany; held battery recycling capacity through subsidiaries Revolt and lithium-metal IP through Cuberg before filing for bankruptcy in November 2024.
co_investors: Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO), Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments), OMERS
robotnik_take: Convertible note extension funds gigafactory ramp; Northvolt is Europe's flagship vertically-integrated battery champion. Total equity+debt now over $9B against $55B in offtake commitments. Compares to Western pure-plays like CATL but with Western governance.

company_description: Wolfspeed's former GaN-on-SiC RF business, acquired by MACOM in 2023. Produces RF semiconductors for aerospace, defense, and telecom applications; consolidates GaN RF capability within MACOM (NASDAQ: MTSI).
robotnik_take: MACOM acquires Wolfspeed's GaN-on-SiC RF business (~$150M annualized revenue, ~280 employees) for $75M cash + $50M MACOM stock. Strategic divestiture lets Wolfspeed focus on EV/industrial SiC power; MACOM consolidates GaN RF for aerospace, defense, telecom. RTP fab transfers later under structured timeline.

company_description: Builds commercial space station modules that will initially attach to the International Space Station and later separate as a free-flying successor station. Also develops a next-generation spacesuit for NASA's Artemis lunar program and operates private crewed missions to the ISS.
co_investors: Various venture capital funds and strategic brand partners
robotnik_take: Series C at $505M total raised. Building first commercial modules for ISS by 2026, leading to standalone Axiom Station. Won NASA EVA spacesuit contract ($1.26B max value). Core infrastructure for post-ISS LEO economy.

company_description: Israeli specialty foundry producing analog, RF, mixed-signal, and silicon photonic chips. Public on NASDAQ (TSEM); Intel's planned $5.4B acquisition was terminated after failing to clear Chinese regulators.
robotnik_take: Termination of Intel's $5.4B Tower acquisition after Chinese regulators failed to clear deal by 18-month deadline. Intel paid $353M reverse termination fee to Tower. Marks first major chip-M&A casualty of US-China geopolitical chokepoint, eliminating Intel's planned specialty-foundry vertical. Comp damage absorbed entirely by INTC.

company_description: Develops AI-accelerated LFP and LMFP cathode chemistries for lithium-ion batteries. Operates an 'atoms-to-tons' platform combining computational chemistry with a pilot plant; GM is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: Social Capital, Fontinalis Partners, Earthshot Ventures, The Keffi Group, Boutique Venture Partners, GS Futures, Bricks Capital Management, Zeon Ventures, Scribble VC, WovenEarth Ventures, Bonds Investment Group
robotnik_take: AI-driven LFP/LMFP cathode developer. GM strategic anchor signals serious OEM commitment to non-China cathode chemistry development. $40M first close of $60M target. Atoms-to-tons platform for cell-design iteration. Compares to Mitra's role as a Western alternative to Chinese cathode majors like Yuneng/Dynanonic.

company_description: Builds refractory-brick thermal energy storage — heat batteries charged by renewable electricity that discharge process heat up to 1,500 degC for industrial customers. First commercial unit operating at the Calgren biofuels plant.
lead_investors: Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, Aramco Ventures, Rio Tinto, SABIC
co_investors: Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, SCG, TITAN, SDCL Energy Efficiency Income Trust (SEEIT), John Doerr
robotnik_take: Refractory-brick thermal energy storage (heat battery) charged by renewables, discharging up to 1500°C industrial heat. First commercial unit live at Calgren biofuel plant. Strategic stack of cement (TITAN, SCG), petrochem (SABIC, Aramco), and mining (Rio Tinto) signals demand for industrial decarbonization. Adjacent to Antora and Kraftblock in TES category.

company_description: Develops self-supervised learning software for autonomous vehicle perception and planning. Trained on unsupervised data rather than HD maps; strategic partners include Honda and Goodyear Ventures for OEM and Tier-1 integration.
co_investors: ACVC Partners, Amplo, Honda Motor, Goodyear Ventures, Sungwoo Hitech
robotnik_take: Self-supervised learning approach for AV perception — Honda strategic + Goodyear Ventures align with Tier-1/OEM ecosystem. Helm.ai's 'unsupervised' training thesis sits between Wayve's E2E and traditional HD-map stacks. Total raised $102M.

company_description: Uses engineered protein molecular assemblers to extract lithium and other critical metals from low-concentration brines, including oilfield wastewater. Targets capped wells in Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Texas as a biology-based DLE approach.
co_investors: Helena, Goldcrest Capital, Tapestry VC, Civilization Ventures, Plug and Play, Climate Capital, Yamaha Motor Ventures, BoxGroup, Sam Altman (angel)
robotnik_take: Engineered-protein molecular assemblers extracting lithium and other critical metals from low-concentration brines. Targets oilfield wastewater and capped wells in OK/AR/TX — claims 30x domestic lithium production potential vs evaporative South American methods. Adjacent to Lilac, EnergyX in DLE category but biology-based vs ion-exchange.

company_description: Chinese humanoid robot company founded by Peng Zhihui, formerly of Huawei's Genius Youth program. Targets mass-production-ready humanoid platforms for industrial work; Baidu is a strategic investor with integration to its ERNIE foundation models.
co_investors: Baidu, Miracle Plus
robotnik_take: Founded Feb 2023 by ex-Huawei 'Genius' Peng Zhihui + Deng Taihua. Initial Series A tranches (~$50M reported across rounds in 2023) before $85M expansion late 2023. RAISE A1 humanoid debut Aug 2023; later $1B+ valuation.

company_description: Builds a handheld robotic device for ultrasound-guided needle placement, FDA 510(k)-cleared for commercial use. Targets a much larger procedure TAM than capital-intensive surgical robot platforms; chaired by Fred Moll of Intuitive Surgical.
co_investors: Founders Fund, Operator Partners, Allen & Company, Intuitive Surgical, Fred Moll, Bob Kerrey
robotnik_take: Fred Moll (Auris/Intuitive founder) + Intuitive strategic capital — pedigreed surgical robotics deal. Real-time imaging + AI handheld interventional platform. Butterfly Network ultrasound-on-chip partnership for precision needle guidance.

company_description: Chinese developer of soft grippers and compliant manipulators for food handling, e-commerce picking, and other applications where rigid grippers fail. Targets the same use cases as Soft Robotics (acquired by Ocado/Cloostermans).
robotnik_take: Soft-gripper / compliant manipulation play — emerging Chinese alternative to U.S. Soft Robotics (acquired by Cloostermans/Ocado). Targets food, e-commerce pick-and-place where rigid grippers fail.

company_description: Chinese supplier of GNSS/INS positioning systems for ADAS and autonomous vehicle programs. Sells to Chinese automotive OEMs and Tier 2 suppliers for sensor-fusion positioning.
robotnik_take: GNSS/INS positioning provider for Chinese ADAS programs — mid-stack sensor-fusion play. Chinese auto-tier consolidation vehicle as OEMs in-source compute (cf. NIO, XPeng platform tier-2 stacks).

company_description: Israeli developer of an HD-map-free autonomous driving stack. Won Israel's first national permit for autonomous electric buses, deployed at the Sheba Tel HaShomer hospital campus.
robotnik_take: Convertible note for HD-mapless autonomous driving stack. Won Israel's first national permit for autonomous electric buses (Sheba Tel HaShomer) — niche-route commercialization vs higher-burn passenger AV peers.

company_description: Chinese industrial-inspection and smart-factory robotics integrator. Serves Chinese state-owned enterprise manufacturers as part of the country's '14th Five-Year Plan' robotics expansion.
robotnik_take: Industrial inspection / smart-factory robot integrator — niche-mid-cap Chinese deal. Reflects broader push to automate Chinese SOE manufacturing under '14th Five-Year Plan' robotics quotas.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of indoor commercial autonomous mobile robots for restaurant and hotel delivery applications. Competes with Pudu Robotics and Keenon in service-AMR delivery.
robotnik_take: Indoor commercial AMR maker — competes with Pudu Robotics, Keenon for restaurant/hotel delivery. Mid-market China robotics financing typical of state-fund-backed scale-up rounds.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of quadruped (canine-form-factor) robots known as AlphaDog. Targets security and entertainment markets; competes with Unitree and Deep Robotics.
robotnik_take: Quadruped robot maker (canine-form factor) competing with Unitree, Deep Robotics. Series A tier; Chinese AlphaDog platform commercializes for security + entertainment markets.

company_description: Korean developer of a flexible endoscopic robotic surgical platform. Holds a distribution agreement with Olympus; targets the flexible endoscopy and NOTES (natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery) market.
robotnik_take: Endoscopic flexible robotic platform — Korean entrant in flexible-endoscopy field with Olympus distribution agreement. Sector still bifurcated (rigid laparoscopy vs flexible NOTES); Endorobotics is a Korean Auris-style approach.

company_description: 12-inch analog and specialty-process foundry in Shenzhen, focused on 40nm-and-above analog production. Subsidiary of China Resources Microelectronics, part of China's mature-node capacity expansion.
lead_investors: Big Fund (China IC Industry Investment Fund) - 25% stake CNY 3.7B; China State-Owned Enterprise Structural Reform Fund - 10% stake CNY 1.5B
co_investors: Multiple state-backed investors; parent China Resources Microelectronics
robotnik_take: CR Micro subsidiary scaled registered capital from CNY 2.4B to CNY 12.6B for 12-inch analog/specialty fab in Shenzhen, focused on 40nm-and-above analog. Big Fund's largest single 2023 semis bet. Mirrors GTA dynamics — China's policy-driven mature-node consolidation comparable to TSMC's earlier 200mm legacy fab spend curves.

company_description: Building the BlueBird LEO constellation that delivers broadband cellular service directly to standard unmodified smartphones, partnering with mobile network operators for spectrum. Public on NASDAQ (ASTS).
co_investors: Equipment-backed lender (undisclosed) for $15M tranche
robotnik_take: Comprehensive financing package with up to $100M Senior Secured Credit Facility from Atlas Credit Partners (~$50M funded at closing) plus $15M Equipment-Backed Loan. Together with prior $57M June equity offering and $7M Q2 ATM, total Q2-Q3 raise hit ~$179M. Funds first five BlueBird commercial satellites for direct-to-cell broadband. Public company (NASDAQ: ASTS).

company_description: Canadian developer of the Spool Welding Robot (SWR), an AI-powered welding robot for pipe and pressure-vessel fabrication. Caterpillar is a strategic investor; competes with Path Robotics in skilled-welder shortage automation.
co_investors: Caterpillar Venture Capital, Export Development Canada
robotnik_take: Caterpillar strategic capital + Graham Partners growth equity into AI-welding robot maker. Spool Welding Robot (SWR) addresses skilled-welder shortage — comp: Path Robotics, Lincoln Electric.

company_description: Operates sidewalk delivery robots for food and retail, primarily through an Uber Eats partnership with a commitment of up to 2,000 robots. Public on NASDAQ (SERV); Uber and NVIDIA are significant shareholders.
co_investors: Wavemaker Partners, Mark Tompkins, Republic Deal Room
robotnik_take: Pre-IPO bridge funding ahead of reverse-merger with Patricia Acquisition Corp; total raised $56M. Uber 16.2% / NVIDIA 11% post-merger. Up to 2,000 robots Uber Eats commitment validates sidewalk-delivery unit economics.

company_description: German thermal energy storage company building heat batteries from recycled steel-slag composite that store up to 1,300 degC for multi-week duration. ArcelorMittal-linked Finindus and Techint are strategic investors.
co_investors: Finindus, A&G Energy Transition Tech Fund, TechEnergy Ventures (Techint), Future Industry Ventures (Redstone, SBI Holdings)
robotnik_take: €20M (~$22M) Series B for thermal storage built from recycled steel-slag composite. Stores up to 1300°C, multi-week duration. ArcelorMittal-linked Finindus and Techint involvement signals heavy-industry pull for high-temp electrification. Direct peer to Rondo, Antora; differentiated by use of waste-stream feedstock.

company_description: German developer of modular battery energy storage systems (BESS) using second-life EV batteries. Multi-level inverter topology removes the weakest-cell limitation that has historically hampered second-life applications.
co_investors: European Innovation Council, UVC Partners, Bayern Kapital, BMW i Ventures, BayBG
robotnik_take: €15M (~$16.5M) round to scale modular BESS using second-life EV batteries. Multi-level inverter topology removes weakest-cell limitation that has hampered second-life applications. Sits at intersection of battery materials/recycling and grid storage — capital-light vs Hithium/Northvolt new-cell scale plays.

company_description: Joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon, and NXP building a 12-inch wafer fab in Dresden, Germany. Targets 28/22nm and 16/12nm FinFET production for automotive and industrial chip customers, with output reserved for the partners' supply chains.
co_investors: Bosch (10%), Infineon (10%), NXP (10%); German government to provide €5B in subsidies
robotnik_take: TSMC board approved €3.49B equity for European Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. JV — total fab cost >€10B with German state subsidy. 22/28nm and 12/16nm capacity for European auto/industrial demand. Major comp event for Intel's Magdeburg ambitions and a 5-year overhang for European chip independence narrative.

company_description: German small-launch developer building the RFA ONE launcher, with a planned first orbital flight from SaxaVord Spaceport. Majority owned by OHB; demonstrated a first-of-kind European upper-stage hot fire test.
co_investors: OHB SE (existing majority strategic investor)
robotnik_take: EUR 30M (~$33M) convertible bond from KKR following RFA's first-of-kind European upper-stage hot fire test in May 2023. Capital advances RFA ONE small launcher toward first orbital flight from SaxaVord. KKR's first space deal; OHB remains majority owner. Pairs with separate EUR 11M DLR grant in 2023.

company_description: Chinese mature-node specialty foundry — China's second-largest after SMIC. Public on HKEX and Shanghai STAR Market; produces analog, power, and embedded chips on DUV processes.
lead_investors: China International Capital Corporation, Haitong Securities (lead bookrunners)
co_investors: State-affiliated cornerstone investors
robotnik_take: Largest mainland China IPO of 2023; second-largest foundry after SMIC. Listed on Star Market at 13% premium. The entity is China's mature-node DUV champion—closest comp to UMC/GlobalFoundries. Shanghai listing supplements existing Hong Kong listing as China seeks domestic capital pools amid US sanctions.

company_description: Develops autonomous driving software for robotaxi services and self-driving trucks, operating in both China and the US. Listed on NASDAQ (PONY) and partners with NEOM in Saudi Arabia for MENA market deployment.
co_investors: GAC
robotnik_take: Toyota/GAC-Pony JV for Chinese robotaxi mass production — strategic equity into the JV vehicle, not Pony parent. Validates Toyota's L4 strategy outside North America after Cruise/Argo retrenchment. Pony later IPO'd on NASDAQ Nov 2024.

company_description: Provides industrial IoT sensors paired with AI software for predictive maintenance, deployed at more than 1,000 plants. Dual-HQ in Atlanta and Sao Paulo; competes with Samsara and Augury in industrial condition monitoring.
co_investors: Next47
robotnik_take: Industrial IoT/maintenance prediction — sensors + AI for >1,000 plants. Atlanta + São Paulo dual-HQ play with Brazilian roots; comp: Samsara (IOT), Augury. Modest down-round vs 2022 markups still healthy at $205M post.

company: Orienspace (Dongfang Space / Yantai Dongfang Space Technology)
company_description: Chinese commercial launch company developing the Gravity-1 medium-lift solid rocket and the Gravity-2 medium-lift liquid launch vehicle. Competes with Space Pioneer, iSpace, and Galactic Energy.
co_investors: Multiple Chinese state-linked and private investors (consortium)
robotnik_take: Chinese launch startup raised 'hundreds of millions of yuan' (~$27-124M range) in B+ round. Funds Gravity-2 medium-lift liquid launch vehicle development and mass production. Cumulative ~$150M raised across rounds. Subsequent ~$84M reported January 2024. Stage uncertain due to translation ambiguity around B/B+. Compares with Space Pioneer / iSpace as Chinese commercial launch entrant.

company_description: Launch company that pivoted from small launch vehicles to spacecraft engines in 2023. Previously public on NASDAQ (ASTR) before defaulting on senior secured notes in late 2023 and going private in mid-2024.
lead_investors: High Trail Investments ON LLC (institutional investor)
robotnik_take: Senior Secured Notes financing of $12.5M aggregate principal amount; ~$10.8M net proceeds. 9.0% notes due Nov 2024, secured by all Astra assets. Coincides with August 2023 25% workforce reduction and pivot from launch to spacecraft engines. Astra later defaulted on these notes in November 2023 (eventually went private in mid-2024). Public co at time (Nasdaq: ASTR).

company_description: Designs RISC-V CPUs and AI processors and licenses the underlying IP, led by chip architect Jim Keller. Strategic investors include Hyundai/Kia (for automotive silicon) and Samsung Catalyst (foundry alignment). Targets a licensable AI-IP model comparable to ARM's CPU IP playbook.
lead_investors: Hyundai Motor Group, Samsung Catalyst Fund
co_investors: Fidelity Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, Epiq Capital, Maverick Capital, Kia
robotnik_take: Up-round: Hyundai/Kia ($50M) targeting RISC-V silicon for vehicles, Samsung Catalyst ($50M) bridging foundry alignment. Total funding to $334.5M. Signals mainstream AI-IP ecosystem traction comparable to early ARM licensing model.

company_description: Chinese surgical robotics company — the first Chinese-developed surgical robot to win FDA clearance, granted in June 2023 for neurosurgery applications.
co_investors: DNV Capital
robotnik_take: First Chinese-developed surgical robot to win FDA clearance (June 2023, neurosurgery). D+ round leverages regulatory milestone for cross-border commercial expansion.

company_description: Chinese developer of phase-change-material and silicon photonics for in-memory optical compute, targeting data-center AI training and inference. Sister thesis to Lightmatter and Celestial AI.
co_investors: Xiaomiao Longcheng, Miracleplus
robotnik_take: Founded 2022; phase-change-material + silicon photonics for in-memory optical compute on data-center AI training/inference. Angel-level Chinese photonic-AI bet at the frontier of post-Moore alternatives; sister thesis to Lightmatter/Celestial AI.

company_description: Israeli designer of quasi-CMOS logic technology that reduces transistor count by up to 3x with significant power and area savings. Targets data center CPU IP licensing at the ARM/x86 cost-performance inflection.
co_investors: lool Ventures, M Ventures (Merck KGaA)
robotnik_take: Quasi-CMOS logic technique reduces transistor count up to ~3x with up to 50% power and 40% area savings. Targeting datacenter CPU IP at Arm/x86 cost-perf inflection. Founders Avi Messica/Ziv Leshem ex-Apple/Marvell.

company_description: Builds a collaborative robot platform (Proxie) for healthcare and logistics environments. Founded by Brad Porter, former VP of Amazon Robotics; partnered with Mayo Clinic on hospital deployments.
co_investors: Khosla Ventures, Mayo Clinic, Calibrate, Neo, 1984.vc, Jeff Wilke, Fuel Capital, MVP Ventures
robotnik_take: Founded 2022 by ex-Amazon Robotics VP Brad Porter. Sequoia-led Series A on a still-undisclosed cobot platform; Mayo Clinic strategic partnership signals healthcare-adjacent humanoid use case. Total raised >$40M.

company_description: Spanish developer of wavefront-phase imaging metrology tools for advanced-node semiconductor wafers, an alternative to traditional interferometry. Intel Capital is a strategic investor; launching the Phemet fab metrology tool from a new Tenerife cleanroom.
co_investors: Intel Capital, CDTI, Danobatgroup, EIC Fund, Fagor Automation, Mondragón Promotion (€2.5M EIC grant in addition)
robotnik_take: Wavefront-phase imaging metrology for advanced-node wafer surfaces — alternative to interferometry. Intel Capital's third tranche signals fab-side validation. €10M Series B + €2.5M EIC funds new Tenerife clean-room and Phemet fab tool launch.

company_description: Operates a global commercial telescope network and provides space domain awareness and satellite-tracking products to the US Space Force and commercial constellation operators.
robotnik_take: Slingshot draws on Trinity Capital venture-debt facility. Slingshot is a leading commercial space domain awareness / satellite tracking platform with a global telescope network used by Space Force and commercial operators. Debt complements 2022 $40.85M Series A-2.

company_description: Australian quantum control software company providing calibration, error suppression, and pulse-level control software used across qubit modalities — superconducting, trapped-ion, neutral-atom. Sits at the middleware layer between qubit hardware vendors.
lead_investors: Airbus Ventures (lead, original); Morpheus Ventures (new entrant July 2023)
co_investors: Square Peg, Sierra Ventures, Salus Ventures, In-Q-Tel, Main Sequence Ventures, Investible, Sequoia Capital China, Ridgeline Partners, Lockheed Martin, Verizon Ventures, Macquarie Bank
robotnik_take: Quantum control infrastructure software; Series B extension brought total round to $54M with Morpheus Ventures' July 2023 entry. Q-CTRL sits at the indispensable middleware layer (calibration/error suppression) between qubit hardware vendors—best comp is a quantum-era ASML services play.

company_description: Builds commercial lunar landers (the Peregrine and Griffin platforms) and the CubeRover lunar rover. NASA CLPS contractor; developing the LunaGrid-Lite lunar power demonstration mission.
robotnik_take: NASA Tipping Point partnership for LunaGrid-Lite lunar power demo — 6U CubeRover with 1km tether. Pre-cursor to broader CLPS / Artemis-aligned lunar surface robotics commercialization.

company_description: Italian ground-segment-as-a-service operator supporting around 80 satellites with more than 10,000 satellite passes per month across its global ground-station network. Competes with Atlas Space Operations and Viasat Real-Time Earth.
lead_investors: CDP Venture Capital Sgr (Fondo Evoluzione), Neva Sgr
co_investors: RedSeed Ventures, Primo Space, Whysol Investments; plus EUR 15M EIB venture debt
robotnik_take: Italian ground-segment-as-a-service operator. EUR 20M Series B equity (~$22M) plus EUR 15M EIB venture debt funds expansion of its global ground-station network supporting ~80 satellites; 10,000+ satellite passes per month. Pure-play ground systems play comparable with Leaf vs Atlas Space / Viasat RTE.

company_description: Manufactures the Roomba robotic vacuum and other consumer home robots. Public on NASDAQ (IRBT); pursued an acquisition by Amazon that was terminated in Q1 2024 over EU antitrust concerns, leaving the company to fund operations independently.
robotnik_take: Bridge debt financing announced alongside revised Amazon merger terms (price cut from $61 to $51.75/share). Highlights cash burn at consumer robotics — Amazon eventually walked from acquisition (Q1 2024) on EU antitrust concerns.

company_description: Builds AI-powered automated warehouse systems combining high-density storage, robotic bots, and software. Public on NASDAQ (SYM); operates the GreenBox warehouse-as-a-service joint venture with SoftBank under a $7.5B six-year contract.
robotnik_take: GreenBox JV launches with $100M (SoftBank 65% / Symbotic 35%) — SoftBank's $65M commitment indirectly funds Symbotic platform expansion via $7.5B 6-year contract. SYM stock +20% on news; warrants struck at $41.97/share.

company_description: Builds in-space transportation vehicles — the Mira orbital tug for last-mile satellite delivery and Helios kick stage for direct-to-GEO transfers. Founded by former SpaceX propulsion lead Tom Mueller; targets commercial and national security in-space mobility.
co_investors: Founders Fund, Lux Capital, Airbus Ventures, Space Capital
robotnik_take: Tom Mueller's (ex-SpaceX) in-space mobility startup. Series A funds Helios kick stage (direct-to-GEO) and Mira tug. Strong strategic backer (RTX) signals defense / national security pull-through. Compares with Momentus / D-Orbit but with better engineering pedigree.

company_description: Builds robotic AI-powered fulfillment systems for warehouses and parcel sortation. Taken private by SoftBank in 2023 after a difficult de-SPAC period; competes with Symbotic and AutoStore.
robotnik_take: SoftBank go-private at $1.40/share — 24% premium but ~95% below $9 de-SPAC peak. Down-round / forced exit emblematic of warehouse-robotics public-market collapse (cf. Symbotic recovery from same vintage).

company_description: German thermal-infrared earth observation startup operating satellites that measure land-surface temperature for agriculture, water-stress monitoring, and infrastructure. Selected as a contractor on the EU Copernicus thermal-imaging mission.
co_investors: Einstein Industries Ventures, FTTF, Lakestar, Vsquared, Amathaon Capital, Natural Ventures, OHB Ventures, EIT Food
robotnik_take: German thermal-IR EO data startup; Copernicus thermal-imaging contract winner. Seed extension brings total to ~$32M. Thermal infrared is a less-crowded wedge than optical/SAR - comparable to SatVu (UK) but more advanced commercial trajectory.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs) and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for warehouse and factory applications. Local-government-backed AMR provider.
robotnik_take: Local-government-aligned funding for AGV provider. Indicative of micro-AMR financings continuing in China's middle-tier industrial cities while late-stage rounds slowed globally.

company_description: Designs wafer-scale AI processors and the systems that ship around them, including the CS-3 supercomputer and on-premises and cloud inference offerings. The wafer-scale approach packages an entire silicon wafer into a single chip with 900,000+ cores, targeting large-model training and inference workloads.
robotnik_take: G42's first $100M tranche of a planned 9-system Condor Galaxy supercomputer build (potential >$900M total) anchored Cerebras' 2023 revenue (G42 = 83% of FY23 sales). De facto pre-IPO strategic financing via wafer-scale CS-2 hardware orders, demonstrating sovereign-AI demand.

company_description: Develops humanoid and cognitive robots equipped with onboard AI software for industrial and service applications. Flagship product is the 4NE1 humanoid, a 5.9-foot bipedal robot designed to understand natural-language instructions and handle payloads up to 220 pounds.
co_investors: Vsquared Ventures, Primepulse, HV Capital
robotnik_take: Lingotto (Exor's investment vehicle) anchors round, signaling Agnelli family interest in industrial automation. Pre-Series B financing at order book >$450M for cognitive cobot MAiRA — German answer to U.S./Chinese humanoid race.

company_description: Modular zero-knowledge blockchain ecosystem operating Manta Pacific (an Ethereum L2 for ZK applications). Native MANTA token launched in January 2024; targets the ZK proving market.
co_investors: Alliance, CoinFund, SevenX Ventures, EigenTrust, Hashed
robotnik_take: Modular zero-knowledge ecosystem; round funded launch of Manta Pacific L2 testnet for ZK applications and Asia expansion. Token (MANTA) launched Jan 2024. ZK as a primitive sits adjacent to AI/data privacy compute infra rather than physical DePIN, but tagged DePIN-adjacent given hardware ZK proving market emergence.

company_description: MIT spinout commercializing silicon-photonic immunoassay chips for at-home blood diagnostics. Targets the consumer health and chronic-disease monitoring markets; Intel Capital is an investor.
co_investors: Khosla Ventures, Y Combinator (seed continuation), Alumni Ventures
robotnik_take: MIT spinout commercializing silicon-photonic immunoassay chips for at-home blood diagnostics. Total $27M raised ($10M seed + $17M Series A). Showcase of silicon photonics' breakout into life sciences beyond traditional datacom; Intel Capital's lead reinforces SiPh foundry strategy.

company_description: Chinese autonomous driving software supplier focused on L2+ ADAS for the OEM market. State-backed (Guangdong Technology) with GAC as a strategic investor; supplies the Chinese automotive industry.
lead_investors: GAC Capital, Guangdong Technology Financial Group
robotnik_take: C3 tranche extends total Series C to ~$140M. State-backed (Guangdong Technology) co-leads with GAC's investment arm — clear OEM-aligned funding pattern for Chinese L2+ autonomy stacks.

company_description: Builds the Figure 01 humanoid robot for commercial and industrial work. Strategic add-on investment from Intel Capital pre-dated Figure's later mega-rounds with OpenAI collaboration. (Same parent as Figure AI; this row represents an earlier round.)
robotnik_take: Strategic add-on from Intel Capital to Figure's Series A vehicle. Figure 01 took first steps May 2023; capital pre-cursor to subsequent $675M Series B (Feb 2024) at $2.6B valuation. Now widely-used humanoid leader.

company_description: Korean developer of autonomous mobile robots that bring EV chargers to vehicles in parking lots, eliminating fixed charging-station infrastructure. Niche EV infrastructure approach for parking-heavy environments.
robotnik_take: Mobile robot EV-charging (autonomous robot brings charger to vehicle) — niche EV infrastructure play. Korean industrial commercialization vs U.S./EU charging-infra peers (ChargePoint).

company_description: Chinese developer of a robotic image-guided needle and biopsy interventional platform for interventional radiology. Competes with Perfint and Insight Medical in image-guided needle placement.
robotnik_take: Robotic image-guided needle/biopsy interventional platform. Niche-procedure play in interventional radiology; comps include Perfint (India), Insight Medical.

company_description: Chinese cooking robot manufacturer for restaurant and food-service applications. Competes with Miso Robotics and Karakuri in the QSR autonomous-kitchen segment.
robotnik_take: Restaurant/cooking-robot vendor — Chinese auto-cooking ecosystem play. Competing with Miso Robotics (US), Karakuri (UK) in QSR autonomous-kitchen TAM.

company_description: University of Iowa spinout building the iotaSOFT robotic cochlear-implant insertion system, FDA-cleared for ear surgery. Provides precision motion control for ENT procedures.
robotnik_take: Robotic cochlear-implant insertion system — University of Iowa spin-out. Niche surgical-robotics play with FDA-cleared iotaSOFT system; precision motion control for ENT procedures.

company_description: Italian developer of the RoBee humanoid platform for industrial inspection and service market applications. Italy's first commercial humanoid demonstrator; state-backed by CDP Venture Capital.
robotnik_take: RoBee humanoid platform — small Italian humanoid entrant in industrial inspection/service market. Italy's first humanoid commercial demo; CDP Venture Capital state-backed angle into European hardware.

company_description: Builds Tally, an autonomous shelf-audit robot that scans retail store shelves for inventory accuracy, planogram compliance, and pricing. Sells to grocery and big-box retailers as a vertical-specific complement to general-purpose AMRs.
robotnik_take: Tally autonomous shelf-audit robot scales globally — 10x ARR growth since 2020. Total raised $54M. Vertical-specific play vs general AMRs (Locus, Symbotic) for retail price/inventory accuracy.

company_description: French silicon spin-qubit quantum computing company building qubits on standard CMOS processes. Targets a foundry-friendly scaling path comparable to the TSMC and Intel 300mm wafer curve, distinct from trapped-ion and neutral-atom peers.
lead_investors: Quantonation, Bpifrance (Deep Tech 2030), Supernova Invest, Innovacom
co_investors: Crédit Agricole Alpes Development, CEA Investment, Caisse d'Epargne Rhone Alpes, BNP Paribas; plus €2.5M EIC Transition grant
robotnik_take: Largest seed in European quantum history. Silicon spin qubits leveraging existing CMOS lines, structurally positioning Quobly to ride the same 300mm wafer scale curve TSMC/Intel use—a foundry-friendly path competitor vs. trapped-ion/neutral-atom specialists.

company_description: Only Western indium phosphide (InP) photonic integrated circuit pure-play foundry, spun out of TU Eindhoven. Targets AI optical interconnect, datacom transceivers, and photonic sensing. State-backed by the Dutch government.
co_investors: ASML, NXP, VDL Groep, ING Nederland, BOP Impact Ventures, Invest-NL, Innovation Industries, BOM, PhotonDelta, KPN Ventures
robotnik_take: TU/e spinout, only Western InP photonic IC pure-play foundry. €100M debt round (€60M Dutch state + €40M industry consortium) is the largest 2023 European photonics raise; effectively Dutch sovereign-photonics strategy as alternative to TSMC for AI optical interconnect, datacom, sensing.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of vision-guided autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for warehouses and factories. State-backed by Hefei municipal capital; targets domestic and international warehouse automation markets.
robotnik_take: C-II extension brings ForwardX Series C total to $61M; total raised $140M since 2016. State-fund-led (Hefei) at the cap-table reflects Chinese local-government strategic capital flowing into AMR/vision-robotics.

company_description: Operates autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and a data platform for ocean mapping, primarily offshore wind site surveys. Sells survey-as-a-service to offshore renewables developers as an alternative to ship-based hydrography.
co_investors: Valor Equity Partners, Eniac, Quiet Capital, R7
robotnik_take: AUV + data platform play targeting offshore wind site surveys — alternative to ship-based hydrography. Riding offshore-wind capex wave; cf. competitive AUVs from Saildrone, Anduril Dive-LD.

company_description: Swiss ETH Zurich spinout building autonomous indoor inventory-tracking drones for warehouses. UPS Velocity is the anchor customer at its Shepherdsville, Kentucky facility; competes with Corvus Robotics and Skydio enterprise drones.
robotnik_take: Series B extension to $43M total. ETH Zurich spin-out for inventory-tracking warehouse drones — UPS Velocity (Shepherdsville KY) launched July 2023 as anchor customer. Competes with Corvus Robotics, Skydio enterprise drones.

company_description: Builds remote-operable and AI-controlled robotic arms deployed in Japanese convenience stores for shelf-stocking. Operates the GHOST platform with manufacturing partner Foxconn; deployed in over 300 FamilyMart stores.
co_investors: Monoful Venture Partners, KDDI Open Innovation Fund, Airbus Ventures, Foxconn
robotnik_take: Tokyo-based maker of remote-operable + AI restock robotic arms (deployed in 300 FamilyMart stores). SoftBank as lead pairs with Foxconn manufacturing partnership for next-gen GHOST platform — clear retail-robotics offtake path.

company_description: Chinese cloud robotics company that links service and humanoid robots to centralized AI 'brains' via secure networks. State-backed by Shanghai Guosheng and Knowledge City after Entity List complications.
co_investors: China-Singapore Guangzhou Knowledge City, Shanghai Guosheng Group, Watere Capital
robotnik_take: State-backed funding (Shanghai Guosheng, Knowledge City) into formerly U.S.-listed cloud robotics maker. Reflects China's industrial-policy push to recapture domestic robotics players post-2019 Entity List complications.

company_description: Manufactures LFP cells and stationary battery energy storage systems (BESS) for grid-scale applications. Shipped 5 GWh in 2022; expanding through subsidiaries in Munich and the US. State-backed Chinese player competing with Form Energy, ESS, and Eos on the export side.
lead_investors: Beijing Financial Street Capital Operation Group (BFS Capital), China Life Private Equity Investment
co_investors: BOC Financial Asset Investment, Goldstone Investment, CS Capital, China Venture Capital Fund (CVC), CICC Capital, CDH Investments, BOC Asset Management, Dinghui Baifu, CMG-SDIC Capital, China-US Green Fund, Matrix Partners China, Hefei Industry Investment Holding Group, CDI New Energy
robotnik_take: RMB 4.5B (~$622M) Series C ahead of expected IPO. LFP-focused stationary BESS player; delivered 5GWh in 2022. Expanding into European (Munich subsidiary) and US markets. State-tied capital stack underscores Chinese BESS dominance vs western pure-plays like Form, ESS, Eos.

company_description: Chinese autonomous mobile robot manufacturer for warehouse and logistics applications. JD Logistics partner with offices in Shenzhen, Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong as part of an export-oriented AMR strategy.
robotnik_take: JD Logistics partner — Series C from Tongling state capital. Multi-region office footprint (Shenzhen, Tokyo, Singapore, HK) signals export-oriented AMR ambition vs. domestic-only Aijiwei/Geek+ peers.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of LiDAR sensors for autonomous vehicles, robotics, and smart infrastructure. Public on HKEX following a 2024 IPO; the largest Chinese automotive LiDAR maker by volume.
robotnik_take: Hong Kong IPO filing by largest Chinese automotive LiDAR maker by volume. Filing came amid global LiDAR sector pain (cf. Luminar, Innoviz public-market multiples). Listed January 2024 at HK$19.3B valuation.

company_description: Chinese reusable launch startup — the first private Chinese company to reach orbit with a liquid-propellant rocket (Tianlong-2, April 2023). Developing the Tianlong-3 Falcon 9-class reusable rocket.
co_investors: Disclosed multiple Chinese state-linked and private investors (consortium); cumulative raised ~US$414M
robotnik_take: Chinese reusable-launch startup, first private Chinese co. to reach orbit with a liquid rocket (Tianlong-2, Apr 2023). C-round 'hundreds of millions of yuan' brings cumulative raised to ~$414M; funding for Tianlong-3 (SpaceX Falcon 9 analog). Stage_uncertain reflects translation ambiguity around C/C+. Tracxn-only specifics; primary source SpaceNews.

company_description: India's leading unmanned aircraft systems manufacturer with about 50% of the domestic UAS market share. Public on Indian exchanges; primary supplier to the Indian Army and security forces.
robotnik_take: India's leading UAS manufacturer with 50% domestic share — IPO oversubscribed 106x at BSE/NSE. Defense procurement tailwind from India's indigenization push.

company_description: Builds autonomous indoor inventory drones for warehouses with infrastructure-free deployment and automatic battery swap. Partnered with Kenco; competes with Verity and Gather AI in inventory drones.
co_investors: Ignite Innovation Fund, Krossroad Partners, SoftBank Ventures Asia
robotnik_take: Autonomous inventory drones with infrastructure-free, mapping-free deployment and auto battery-swap. Kenco partnership — direct comp to Verity, Gather AI in inventory drones. Total raised $30M.

company_description: Vertically integrated silicon carbide (SiC) manufacturer covering epitaxy, device fabrication, and module assembly for EV power applications. Subsidiary of Chinese optical fiber maker YOFC; competes with Wolfspeed, onsemi, and STMicroelectronics in third-generation power semiconductors.
robotnik_take: Largest 2023 China semi private deal. SiC IDM with full vertical integration from epi to module assembly; targets EV power applications competing with WOLF, ON, STM in third-gen semiconductors.

company_description: Develops the Photonic Fabric optical interconnect — silicon photonic chiplets that disaggregate memory from compute for AI clusters at higher bandwidth than electrical NVLink or Tomahawk-class switching. Targets hyperscalers building exascale AI systems.
lead_investors: IAG Capital Partners, Koch Disruptive Technologies, Temasek's Xora Innovation
co_investors: Samsung Catalyst, Smart Global Holdings, Porsche Automobil Holding SE, The Engine Fund, imec.xpand, M Ventures, Tyche Partners
robotnik_take: Photonic Fabric optical interconnect for disaggregated exascale compute. Claims 25x bandwidth advantage vs co-packaged optics, attacking NVDA NVLink/AVGO Tomahawk paradigm with photonic memory disaggregation.

company_description: Develops RapidPlan motion planning software for industrial robots — fast collision-free path planning for multi-robot work cells. Sells to automotive and industrial customers as software infrastructure for robotic arm deployments.
robotnik_take: RapidPlan motion planning for industrial robots; Boston-based extension brings total raised to $54M. Picks-and-shovels for robotic-arm motion control deployments.

company_description: Solid rocket motor (SRM) manufacturer using proprietary aluminum-lithium ALITEC fuel. Acquired by Anduril in 2023 to enter the SRM supply market for hypersonics, missiles, and space launch.
robotnik_take: Anduril's entry into solid rocket motor (SRM) supply for hypersonics, missiles, and space launch. Adranos's proprietary aluminum-lithium ALITEC fuel; Mississippi production complex. Deal terms undisclosed. Strategic move to break SRM duopoly (Northrop/L3-Aerojet). Signals defense-tech roll-up wave - similar to Anduril's Adranos + Numerica strategy.

company_description: Manufactures productized 100 kg-class Aries satellite buses on a serial production line in Los Angeles. Customers include Orbit Fab, Ubotica, and defense primes; competes with York Space Systems and Loft Orbital in standardized smallsat platforms.
co_investors: Shield Capital, J2 Ventures, XYZ Venture Capital, CRV, Toyota Ventures, Robinhood co-founder Baiju Bhatt
robotnik_take: Productized 100kg Aries satellite-bus manufacturer. Customer roster: Orbit Fab, Ubotica, defense prime. Total raised $27M post round. Direct competitor: York Space Systems, Loft Orbital. New 50,000 sq ft LA factory targets cycle-time/cost reductions on a productized SKU.

company_description: Vertically integrated lithium-ion battery cell manufacturer for European automotive and grid storage markets. Operated gigafactories in Sweden and Germany; held battery recycling capacity through subsidiaries Revolt and lithium-metal IP through Cuberg before filing for bankruptcy in November 2024.
robotnik_take: Convertible notes from Ontario pension giant IMCO; capital earmarked for North American expansion ahead of Aug 2023 $1.2B convertible. Pre-bankruptcy peak; would later be eclipsed by collapse in Nov 2024. Massive vertically-integrated EU gigafactory play; battery materials adjacency through Cuberg/Revolt recycling assets.

company_description: Uses machine-learning models to identify and develop deposits of copper, lithium, nickel, and cobalt globally. Flagship project is the Mingomba copper deposit in Zambia; the company exists at the intersection of AI-driven exploration software and traditional mining operations.
co_investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND, Standard Investments, Equinor Ventures, BHP Ventures, Mitsubishi Corporation, Earthshot Ventures, July Fund
robotnik_take: AI-powered mineral exploration for cobalt/copper/nickel/lithium. Crossed unicorn status. Direct play on rare earth/critical minerals discovery for EV battery supply chain. Primary public comps: MP Materials, USAR. AI/ML applied to physical exploration is differentiated thesis.

company_description: German space situational awareness company building a 12-satellite constellation with optical sensors for in-orbit object detection in LEO. Safran is a strategic investor; competes with LeoLabs, NorthStar, and Aldoria.
co_investors: Happiness Capital, Atlantic Labs, Faber Ventures
robotnik_take: Space-based SSA - building 12-satellite constellation for object detection in LEO with optical sensors. Safran (defense prime) strategic involvement signals defense angle. EUR 8.5M tranche topped up earlier seed; total >EUR 10M post round. Comps: LeoLabs, NorthStar, Aldoria.

company_description: Chinese commercial UAV manufacturer backed by the Heilongjiang government to anchor a regional UAV manufacturing base. Targets state procurement for unmanned systems alongside DJI in the broader Chinese commercial drone market.
co_investors: SenGong Investments, Keli Investments, Harbin Venture Capital Group
robotnik_take: Heilongjiang government-led UAV investment to anchor China's largest UAV base; Chinese state procurement for unmanned systems is a key thematic. Domestic competitor to DJI in commercial UAV.

company_description: Chinese designer of SSDs, BMC chips, and military-grade storage and computing products. Targets the Chinese defense and state IT segment; competes with Phison and Marvell at the commodity end.
co_investors: Xuchang Weidu, QingSong Fund, QF Capital
robotnik_take: Designs SSDs, BMC chips, and military-grade storage and computing products. Plays in defense/state IT segment isolated from US export controls; competes with Phison/Marvell on commodity end.

company_description: Developed the SC1 autonomous eVTOL crop-spraying drone, the first commercially authorized electric VTOL aircraft in the US for agricultural spraying. Wound down in 2024 after failing to secure follow-on capital.
robotnik_take: SC1 autonomous eVTOL crop-spraying drone — first commercially authorized electric VTOL in US for ag spraying. Fully wound down 2024 after failing to secure follow-on.

company_description: Chinese designer of ARM-based intelligent CPU SoCs for performance and efficiency applications. Part of China's effort to build domestic ARM-server chip alternatives to Ampere and AWS Graviton.
co_investors: Cathay Ventures, Cherami Investment Group, Nio Capital, Qiming Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Develops Arm-based intelligent CPU SoCs for performance/efficiency markets. Part of China's effort to build domestic Arm-server chip alternatives to AMPR/AVGO Nitro/Graviton.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of IC chip carriers and substrates for advanced packaging. Domestic supply-chain play addressing the packaging-substrate gap currently filled by Japanese and Taiwanese suppliers.
co_investors: GF Xinde Investment
robotnik_take: Chinese chip carrier/substrate company addressing domestic packaging supply gap. Smaller bet alongside SJSemi/AaltoSemi to localize advanced packaging supply chain.

company_description: Builds an AI plus teleoperation hybrid system for trailer and container unloading. Competes with Pickle Robot in the truck-unloading robotics segment; backed by Korean strategic investors.
co_investors: Kakao Ventures, Bass Investment, Future Play, UT Austin Seed Fund
robotnik_take: AI + teleoperation hybrid for trailer/container unloading. Korean strategic LP set (Kakao, SV, Bass) — bridges teleop to autonomy. Direct competitor to Pickle Robot (priv).

company_description: Chinese developer of the SHURUI single-port endoscopic surgical robot with snake-like instruments. NMPA-approved in 2023; competes directly with Intuitive Surgical's SP platform.
robotnik_take: SHURUI single-port endoscopic surgical robot — China NMPA approval June 2023, world's first commercially available single-port system with snake-like instruments. Direct competitor to Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) SP system.

company_description: Builds human-assisted autonomy software for yard trucking at ports, factories, and intermodal terminals. Partnerships with Volkswagen, DB Schenker, and HHLA anchor commercial deployments in industrial logistics.
co_investors: Fly Ventures, Speedinvest, Push Ventures, HHLA Next, DB Schenker (Schenker Ventures), Krone
robotnik_take: Teleoperated electric yard trucks for ports/terminals — human-in-the-loop teleop addresses 400K-2M EU truck-driver shortage. Comp to Outrider (priv), Plus.ai in yard automation.

company_description: Operates a proprietary weather satellite constellation and provides hyper-local weather prediction and analytics to enterprise customers. Targets aviation, logistics, energy, and government users with AI-native forecasts.
co_investors: RTX Ventures, Seraphim Space, Chemonics, SquarePeg Capital, Canaan Partners, ClearVision, JetBlue Ventures, Pitango Growth
robotnik_take: Weather-radar smallsat constellation + AI weather forecasting. Closed in tandem with Tomorrow-R2 satellite launch from Vandenberg. RTX Ventures (Lockheed) participation. Vertical integration play - own data via own birds. Adjacent to Spire (also weather/RO).

company_description: Israeli industrial drone-in-a-box company providing autonomous aerial inspection for utilities, refineries, and mines. Holds an FAA nationwide BVLOS waiver for autonomous industrial drone operations in the US.
co_investors: Zimmer Partners, U.S. Venture Partners, Delek US Holdings, Atento Capital, Spider Capital, Arkin Holdings
robotnik_take: Industrial drone-in-a-box for inspection at utilities, refineries, mines — combined $50M equity + $16M debt. FAA nationwide BVLOS waiver is sector-defining; comp to Skydio (priv) in industrial inspection.

company_description: Decentralized GPU compute marketplace for machine learning training, structured as a protocol with token-incentivized capacity providers. Targets the same use case as Akash, Render, and io.net in the AI-compute DePIN segment.
co_investors: Protocol Labs, CoinFund, Canonical Crypto, Eden Block, Maven 11
robotnik_take: Decentralized GPU/compute marketplace for ML training; protocol-native pay-on-demand for distributed training. Pure compute-infra Frontier Compute thesis fit — token-incentivized hardware utilization beats centralized cloud economics. a16z lead validates as flagship of the AI-x-crypto compute layer alongside Akash, Render, io.net.

company_description: Singapore NTU spinout designing radiation-hardened ICs for satellites, deep space, and high-reliability power management. Competes with Microchip and BAE in the niche rad-hard market.
co_investors: Dart Family Office
robotnik_take: Radiation-hardened ICs spun out of NTU for satellites, deep space, and high-reliability power management. Niche play in growing rad-hard market dominated by Microchip, BAE.

company_description: Slovak developer of the Prodigy Universal Processor, which combines CPU, GPGPU, and TPU functions on a single chip. Backed by EU IPCEI grants under European sovereign AI/HPC silicon plans.
robotnik_take: EU IPCEI grant to accelerate Prodigy 2 Universal Processor combining CPU/GPGPU/TPU functions. Part of EU's bid for sovereign AI/HPC silicon, akin to SiPearl but with broader workload ambitions.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of industrial robot bodies for welding, stamping, hardware grinding, 3C assembly, and material handling. Domestic competitor to KUKA, FANUC, and ABB in mid-tier articulated arms.
robotnik_take: Industrial robot bodies for welding, stamping, hardware grinding, 3C, handling. Domestic Chinese competitor to KUKA, Fanuc, ABB in mid-tier articulated arms.

company_description: Provides VLSI, embedded systems, and FPGA chip design services. Acquired by Indian-listed MosChip in 2023 to consolidate India-based ASIC design services.
robotnik_take: VLSI/embedded/FPGA design services firm acquired by Indian-listed MosChip via 52.6% share-swap, 47.4% cash. Consolidates India-based ASIC services scale rivaling Tata Elxsi and HCLTech in chip design outsourcing.

company_description: Uses atomic layer deposition (ALD) to coat battery cathode and anode materials for higher performance and longer life. Operates a 1 GWh pilot battery line for premium aerospace, defense, and consumer applications; supply agreement with 6K's PlusCAM.
co_investors: Orion Infrastructure Capital (OIC), Catalus Capital, Ascent Funds, plus existing investors
robotnik_take: Atomic layer deposition (ALD) coating for battery materials; 1 GWh pilot battery line in Q2 2023 for premium aerospace/defense/CE applications. Hanwha lead reflects Korean cell-maker pipeline (Forge has supply agreement with 6K's PlusCAM). Process-tech enabler rather than active material — sits closer to materials equipment vs. ALB/MP comp set.

company_description: Indian space company operating the Firefly hyperspectral satellite constellation. Sells hyperspectral imagery to agriculture, mining, energy, and government customers as the highest-funded hyperspectral pure-play globally.
co_investors: Google, Lightspeed, Blume Ventures, growX, Sparta, Athera
robotnik_take: Hyperspectral EO play; Google's first Indian space investment. Differentiated from MAXR/Planet (multispectral) on spectral resolution. Funds Aurora analytics platform plus Firefly constellation buildout.

company_description: Chinese vascular interventional surgical robotics company. Founder Guo Shuxiang previously led the Japan team that built the world's first neurointerventional surgical robot in 2008.
co_investors: Changan Private Capital, Changling Capital
robotnik_take: Vascular interventional surgical robot. Founder Guo Shuxiang led Japan team that built world's first neurointerventional surgical robot in 2008. Domestic Chinese surgical-robot competitor to Microport (HKG:0853).

company_description: Develops silicon photonic compute and interconnect products for AI and HPC workloads. Main products are Envise (photonic compute), Passage (optical interconnect for chiplets and racks), and Idiom (software stack). Targets the AI scale-up problem that NVIDIA NVLink and Broadcom Tomahawk address electronically.
lead_investors: SIP Global, Fidelity Management & Research Company
co_investors: Viking Global Investors, GV (Google Ventures), HPE Pathfinder
robotnik_take: Photonic compute platform delivering Envise, Passage, Idiom for AI/HPC workloads. Direct challenger to NVDA's interconnect dominance in dense AI clusters via silicon photonics; Fidelity participation suggests pre-IPO posture.

company_description: Provides Bluetooth-to-satellite connectivity for IoT and asset tracking — operates a constellation that lets standard Bluetooth Low Energy devices communicate directly with satellites. Targets massive low-bandwidth tracking use cases.
co_investors: Y Combinator, Yes.VC, Convective Capital, Seraphim Space, Type One Ventures, Soma Capital, AVCF5, Space.VC, 11.2 Capital
robotnik_take: Bluetooth-to-satellite for IoT/asset tracking - direct-to-device pure-play targeting massive low-bandwidth use cases. Adjacent to Lynk/AST SpaceMobile but at the BLE physical layer; novel low-power approach.

company_description: Norwegian developer of Genius autonomous robotic wheels — modular drive wheels that convert conventional carts and equipment into autonomous mobile robots without redesign. Targets warehouse retrofit deployments.
robotnik_take: Genius autonomous robotic wheels — converts conventional carts/equipment into AMRs without redesign. Picks-and-shovels for warehouse retrofits.

company_description: Builds a biometric proof-of-personhood network combining the Orb iris-scanning device, the World ID identity credential, and the WLD token. Co-founded by Sam Altman; targets identity verification for the AI era.
co_investors: a16z crypto, Bain Capital Crypto, Distributed Global, Khosla Ventures
robotnik_take: Sam Altman-cofounded biometric ID + WLD token network. Hardware-anchored DePIN play (Orb iris-scan device) — unique among AI/identity tokens for its physical infrastructure layer. Capital deployed pre-WLD TGE in July 2023. Core thesis: proof-of-personhood for AI age. Robotnik fit: physical sensor network grafted onto crypto incentives.

company_description: Builds space robotics for satellite servicing and lunar surface operations — robotic arms and rovers for in-orbit assembly and lunar exploration. Japanese-founded with US operations expanding for lunar demonstrations.
robotnik_take: Lunar rover and inchworm robotic arm for in-space servicing/construction — TRL push and US engineering-model facility expansion. Comp to Astrobotic, Intuitive Machines (NASDAQ:LUNR) in space robotics.

company_description: German developer of driver-assistance software and cloud analytics for construction machinery. Customers include Sennebogen, MTS, and Kiesel.
robotnik_take: Construction-machine driver-assistance software and cloud analytics — digitalization of construction equipment. Customers include Sennebogen, MTS, Kiesel.

company_description: Develops lithium-sulfur EV battery cells using its 3D Graphene supermaterial platform. Cobalt- and nickel-free chemistry positioned as an alternative to Asian NMC and LFP cell incumbents; Stellantis is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
robotnik_take: Lithium-sulfur EV battery startup; Stellantis Ventures strategic investment to advance Lyten's 3D Graphene supermaterial platform. Anchor placement in what later closed as $200M Series B in Sept 2023; cobalt/nickel-free chemistry positions Lyten as differentiated alternative to Asian cell incumbents.

company_description: Builds general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and industrial work. Develops both the hardware platform and AI models in-house, with a collaboration agreement with OpenAI for frontier model integration.
co_investors: Aliya Capital, Bold Ventures, Tamarack Global, FJ Labs, Till Reuter
robotnik_take: Brett Adcock's general-purpose humanoid play closes Series A on top of $100M founder seed. Early bet on Figure 01 humanoid; early-mover positioning before sector heated up in 2024. NVDA-led Apptronik comp came later at $5B+.

company_description: Develops co-packaged optics (CPO) — silicon photonic chiplets integrated directly with compute and switch ASICs to replace copper interconnects in AI data centers. Strategic investors include AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, and MediaTek; manufactures at TSMC and GlobalFoundries.
co_investors: VentureTech Alliance, Boardman Bay Capital Management, IAG Capital Partners, NVIDIA, Tyche Partners
robotnik_take: In-package optical I/O for chip-to-chip connectivity. Up-round extends Series C to $155M total; NVDA participating signals strategic interest in optical interconnects to overcome HBM/copper power walls.

company_description: UK developer of the HotSat-1 thermal-infrared earth observation constellation. Sells thermal imagery for energy efficiency, climate monitoring, and industrial applications; competes with Constellr in the thermal-only EO segment.
co_investors: Seraphim Space, Lockheed Martin, A/O Proptech, Earth Sciences Foundation, Stellar Ventures, Ridgeline Partners
robotnik_take: Thermal-IR EO startup ('HotSat-1' constellation). Series A2 extension brought total to GBP 30.5M. GBP 128M of pre-launch customer commitments. Comp to Constellr (DE) thermal-only play; addresses energy/climate monitoring vs broad EO of MAXR/Planet.

company_description: Mobile-first satellite imagery marketplace aggregating tasking and archive imagery from over 50 EO satellite operators. Downstream data-distribution play rather than constellation owner.
co_investors: J2 Ventures, Moving Capital, Bill Perkins
robotnik_take: Mobile-first satellite imagery marketplace - 'Uber for satellite tasking.' Aggregates 50+ EO partners. Total raised $17M post round. Differentiated downstream play - data aggregation/distribution layer rather than constellation owner. Comp: SkyWatch (CA), UP42 (Airbus).

company_description: Industrial water treatment and resource recovery company with a growing critical-minerals practice. The CFRO and CFRO+ processes are used for lithium concentration from brines and oilfield wastewater. Sells to mining, semiconductor, and refining customers globally.
co_investors: Schlumberger, Warburg Pincus
robotnik_take: Industrial water treatment with growing lithium / critical minerals extraction practice (CFRO/CFRO+ for brines). Crossed unicorn status; capital deployed to MENA/EU expansion and lithium DLE production tooling. Adjacent to ALB and LAC brine processing economics; differentiated water-side stack vs. EnergyX's membranes.

company_description: French developer of the Maestro laparoscopic surgical assistant, a cart-based robot designed to assist with camera and instrument holding during minimally invasive surgery. Fred Moll chairs the board; NVIDIA is an investor.
co_investors: Johnson & Johnson Innovation, Sofinnova MD Start, GT Healthcare Capital, Cathay Health
robotnik_take: Maestro laparoscopic surgical assistant; Fred Moll (Intuitive Surgical co-founder) as Board Chair signals strategic positioning vs. ISRG. NVIDIA participation underscores AI/robotics convergence in surgical robotics.

company_description: Develops the SuperQ silicon power MOSFET technology, claiming 6x lower on-resistance than legacy silicon and 1.6x lower than GaN. Targets commodity power MOSFET volumes against Infineon, onsemi, and STMicroelectronics.
co_investors: Applied Ventures
robotnik_take: Silicon power devices using SuperQ technology delivering 6x lower resistance than legacy silicon and 1.6x lower than GaN. Threatens INFY/ON/STM commodity power MOSFET volumes if production scales.
