company_description: Designs energy-efficient ASICs for Bitcoin mining and zero-knowledge proof acceleration. Founded by alumni of Cavium and Palo Alto Networks; competes with Bitmain and MicroBT in mining hardware with a US-based design house.
co_investors: Marathon Digital Holdings, Cota Capital, DCVC, Stanford University
robotnik_take: Energy-efficient silicon for Bitcoin mining ASICs and zero-knowledge proof acceleration; Cavium/Palo Alto Networks alumni founders. Plays in Bitmain/MicroBT-dominated ASIC mining hardware market with US-based design.

company_description: ETH Zurich spinout building the ANYmal quadruped robot, including the explosion-proof ANYmal X. Customers include oil and gas operators (Petronas, Shell, SLB) and chemical producers using the robot for autonomous inspection.
co_investors: Bessemer Venture Partners, Aramco Ventures, Swisscom Ventures, Swisscanto Private Equity
robotnik_take: ETH spinout building ANYmal X explosion-proof quadruped — over $150M in pre-orders from Petronas, Shell, SLB, BASF. Direct competitor to Boston Dynamics Spot in oil/gas inspection.

company_description: Canadian humanoid robot company building Phoenix, a general-purpose humanoid for industrial and enterprise work. Accenture is a strategic investor anchoring enterprise integration; known for advanced dexterous-hand work.
robotnik_take: Phoenix gen-6 humanoid + Carbon AI control system. Strategic Innovation Fund grant supports general-purpose humanoid R&D — direct comp to Figure (priv), Apptronik (priv).

company_description: Dutch fabless designer of edge AI inference chips for computer vision and LLM workloads in automotive ADAS, robotics, and industrial applications. Competes with Qualcomm, Hailo, and Intel Movidius at the edge.
co_investors: CDP Venture Capital, Verve Ventures, Fractionelera
robotnik_take: Edge AI inference chip imec spinout. Metis platform competes with Hailo/EdgeQ in vision/edge AI segment; round took total Series A to ~$50M positioning as European edge AI champion.

company_description: Builds the Vesper nano-drone for the US Army's Soldier Borne Sensor program. Targets the defense small-UAS segment alongside Skydio and AeroVironment.
robotnik_take: Nano-drone for US Army Soldier Borne Sensor program; defense procurement tailwind alongside Skydio (priv) and AeroVironment (NASDAQ:AVAV).

company_description: Builds the Vector reconnaissance UAS — a fixed-wing vertical-takeoff drone for tactical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. Sells to European militaries including the German Bundeswehr; active in Ukraine in combat use.
robotnik_take: Vector reconnaissance VTOL drones for German Armed Forces, partnership with Airbus Defence. Bridge into bigger €63.6M Series B in October 2023; defense-tech tailwind from Ukraine demand.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of servo drives, servo motors, industrial controllers, HMIs, and linear motors. Targets the domestic motion-control market against Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, and Delta.
robotnik_take: Servo drives, servo motors, industrial controllers, HMIs, linear motors. Domestic substitute play vs. Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, Delta in China motion control.

company_description: Canadian SFU spinout building the XoMotion exoskeleton, which enables independent walking for mobility-impaired users. Holds Health Canada approval; competes with Ekso Bionics in the powered exoskeleton segment.
robotnik_take: XoMotion exoskeleton enables independent walking for mobility-impaired users — SFU spinout; Health Canada approval Sept 2024. Competitor to Ekso Bionics (NASDAQ:EKSO).

company_description: Indian RISC-V processor IP startup incubated at IIT Madras. Targets Indian domestic chip design ambition under the DigiIndia program; comparable to Andes Technology in Taiwan.
robotnik_take: RISC-V processor IP startup incubated at IIT-Madras. India's domestic chip design ambition akin to Andes Tech in Taiwan; modest size but flagship Indian semiconductor venture deal under DigiIndia.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of the Yarbo modular yard robot, with interchangeable snow-blower and lawnmower attachments. Targets cold-climate North American consumers as a competitor to Husqvarna and Worx.
robotnik_take: Intelligent service-robot R&D; Shenzhen-based competitor in China's crowded service-robot stack vs. Pudu, Keenon.

company_description: Chinese supplier of auto-parking, ADAS, and regional autonomous driving software, deployed in hundreds of thousands of vehicles for Volkswagen, Toyota, Lexus, Chery, and Great Wall.
robotnik_take: Auto-parking, ADAS, regional autonomy software embedded in hundreds of thousands of vehicles for VW, Toyota, Lexus, Chery, Great Wall. Series B1 financing ahead of overseas expansion.

company_description: Bulgarian satellite platform provider offering modular smallsat buses, in-orbit services, and turnkey mission delivery. Competes with York Space Systems and other commercial smallsat manufacturers.
co_investors: Freigeist Capital
robotnik_take: Smallsat/CubeSat platform builder; pivoting to constellation-as-a-service. 2,500+ systems flown. Bulgarian space tech with EU venture backing - rare CEE space exit candidate.

company_description: German manufacturer of the Wingcopter 198 eVTOL delivery drone for medical, grocery, and parcel last-mile delivery. Partnerships and customers include REWE Group and ITOCHU.
robotnik_take: Quasi-equity venture loan from EIB to scale Wingcopter 198 eVTOL delivery drone for medical/groceries. Total raised >€100M across REWE, ITOCHU, Expa.

company_description: Turkish manufacturer of indoor delivery robots for warehouse applications. Targets the emerging-market last-mile and intralogistics robot segment.
robotnik_take: Indoor delivery robots for Turkish warehouses; emerging-market last-mile play.

company_description: Builds the ARA precision-spraying tractor implement, which uses plant-by-plant computer vision to spot-spray herbicides, pesticides, and fertilizers, claiming 70-95% reduction in agrochemical use. Sells to specialty-crop growers.
co_investors: Swisscanto Invest, Yara Growth Ventures, Flexstone Partners
robotnik_take: ARA precision spraying reduces herbicide/pesticide/fertilizer use 70-95% via plant-by-plant computer vision. AgTech robotics adjacent to Carbon Robotics' laser-weeding play.

company_description: Korean custom silicon design house leveraging Samsung Foundry SAFE Design Solution Partner status to deliver fabless ASIC services. Targets AI accelerator and SoC customers; comparable business model to Alchip and Global Unichip.
lead_investors: Korea Development Bank, Korea Investment Partners, SV Investment, Zephyrus Lab
co_investors: Shinhan Securities, Doosan
robotnik_take: Custom silicon design platform leveraging Samsung Foundry SAFE Design Solution Partner status. Korean equivalent of Alchip/GUC business model serving fabless ASIC market growing on AI demand.

company_description: Builds AI-powered sorting robots for municipal solid waste recycling and also operates AMP ONE, its own end-to-end automated sortation facilities. Shifting from selling hardware to operating waste-sortation infrastructure.
co_investors: Congruent Ventures, Wellington Management
robotnik_take: AI-powered recycling sortation; Microsoft Climate fund participation aligns with circular-economy thesis. Total Series C reaches >$99M; bigger 2024 round followed.

company_description: Builds Robotics-as-a-Service truck-loading systems that reduce 30-60 minute trailer loads to about 5 minutes. Customers include John Deere, GE Appliances, Valeo, and Nissan; deployable without facility modification.
robotnik_take: SlipBot 5-min truck loading/unloading RaaS for trailer docks; commercial launch 2023. Direct competitor to Pickle Robot, Boston Dynamics Stretch in dock automation.

company_description: Israeli developer of the Foretify safety verification and validation platform for ADAS and autonomous vehicle software. Customers include Volvo and Daimler Truck/Torc; NVIDIA and Toyota are strategic investors.
co_investors: Woven Capital (Toyota), NVIDIA, Artofin VC, MoreTech, Nationwide, Volvo Group VC, Jump Capital
robotnik_take: Foretify safety verification/validation platform for ADAS/AV — Volvo, Daimler/Torc as reference customers. NVIDIA + Toyota validates AV simulation infrastructure thesis. Series C topped up to $85M by Dec 2023.

company_description: Israeli developer of long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal cameras for ADAS pedestrian-safety applications and industrial monitoring. Gentex is a strategic investor anchoring automotive OEM distribution.
robotnik_take: LWIR thermal sensors for ADAS pedestrian-safety applications; Gentex strategic anchor brings auto-OEM channel. Comp to NASDAQ:LAZR / NASDAQ:OUST in sensing stack but thermal niche.

company_description: Operates an autonomous drone delivery network for medical supplies, retail goods, and food. Started with blood and vaccine delivery in Rwanda and Ghana; now expanding US operations to Houston, Phoenix, and Seattle. Builds both the fixed-wing delivery drones and the operating software stack.
robotnik_take: Largest robotics round of April 2023 — $4.2B post-money makes Zipline the highest-valued US drone co at the time. P2 tethered-droid system rollout for medical/logistics drives valuation; eVTOL comps include NYSE:JOBY.

company_description: Hefei-based Chinese manufacturer of autonomous mobile robots and outdoor unmanned forklifts for industrial logistics applications.
robotnik_take: Hefei-based AMR/unmanned forklift OEM, launched 4th-gen outdoor unmanned forklift in 2023. Amount undisclosed; estimated meaningful given investor stage.

company_description: Spanish manufacturer of the Keyper quadruped robot for industrial inspection. Acquired by Helsing in January 2026 as part of defense robotics build-out; competes with Boston Dynamics Spot in EU industrial verticals.
robotnik_take: Quadruped Keyper robot for industrial inspection — Boston Dynamics Spot competitor in EU industrial verticals. Acquired by Helsing in Jan 2026 as part of defense robotics build-out.

company_description: Software-defined-vehicle and autonomous driving software arm of the Hyundai Motor Group. Builds the unified software stack and autonomous mobility platform across Hyundai and Kia vehicles.
robotnik_take: Hyundai/Kia inject KRW 1.05T to entrench 42dot as their global software center for autonomous mobility. Effectively a captive subsidiary cap raise — comparable to GM/Cruise dynamic, but with higher integration to OEM software stack.

company_description: Built remote-driving teleoperation software for forklifts and yard trucks after pivoting from passenger AVs. Shut down operations in March 2024; certain assets (Voysys) were acquired by Serve Robotics.
robotnik_take: Remote-driving teleop for forklifts and yard trucks — pivot from passenger AVs proved insufficient and company shut down March 2024. Foreshadowed teleop consolidation; Voysys later acquired by Serve Robotics (NASDAQ:SERV).

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of telepresence robots for business and healthcare remote-presence applications.
robotnik_take: Telepresence robots for business/healthcare. Round size undisclosed. Service-robot segment competing with Bear Robotics, Pudu.

company_description: Builds liquid rocket engines as an independent supplier, including the Hadley (small launch class) and Ripley (medium-lift) engines. Customers include ABL Space Systems, Stratolaunch, and Phantom Space; growing hypersonic and defense propulsion lines.
co_investors: Space Capital, Explorer 1 Fund, Eclipse
robotnik_take: Independent rocket engine maker - Hadley (small launch) and Ripley (medium-lift) propulsion. Customers include ABL, Stratolaunch, Phantom Space. ~$400M pre-money valuation. Hypersonic/defense exposure adds to commercial launch story; comparable to Aerojet Rocketdyne's commercial offering, but newspace-style.

company_description: Recycles rare-earth permanent magnets from end-of-life EV motors, wind turbines, and hard drives using its Mag-Cycle process. Operates Hub100, a first commercial demonstration facility, as a circular alternative to primary rare earth mining.
lead_investors: BMW i Ventures, Energy Impact Partners
co_investors: Fifth Wall, Bioindustrial Innovation Canada (BIC), Planetary Technologies
robotnik_take: Rare earth element recycling (Mag-Cycle process) for permanent magnets in EV motors and wind turbines. BMW i Ventures co-lead is an OEM supply-chain signal; first commercial demo facility (Hub100). Direct alternative to MP Materials' primary mining model — circular recovery from end-of-life motors and HDDs.

company_description: Operates a thermal-infrared earth observation constellation for agriculture, water management, and climate monitoring. Competes with Constellr and Satellite Vu in commercial thermal EO; commodities trader Hartree Partners is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Blue Bear Capital, Hartree Partners, OTB Ventures, Freeflow Ventures, Cultivation Capital, Techstars, Santa Barbara Venture Partners, Expon Capital, Hemisphere Ventures
robotnik_take: Thermal-IR EO for ag/water/climate. $20M total announcement included $5M non-dilutive grants. Direct comp to Constellr (DE) and Satellite Vu (UK) - thermal-only EO category is consolidating around 3-4 players globally. Strategic Hartree Partners (commodities trader) anchor signals ag-fintech use case.

company_description: Built FreeMove, a 3D safeguarding system that turns industrial robots into collaborative robots through machine-vision safety perception. Acquired by Symbotic (NASDAQ: SYM) in 2024.
co_investors: Safar Partners, Yamaha Motor Ventures
robotnik_take: FreeMove 3D safeguarding turns industrial robots into cobots — Amazon's strategic check signals automation roadmap. Veo subsequently acquired by Symbotic (NASDAQ:SYM) in 2024.

company_description: Israeli developer of GPS anti-jamming systems for UAVs operating in contested electromagnetic environments. Hanwha is a strategic investor anchoring Korean defense customer access.
co_investors: Honeywell Ventures, Next Gear Ventures
robotnik_take: GPS anti-jamming for UAVs in contested EM environments. Defense procurement tailwind from US/Israeli/Korean armed forces; Hanwha lead aligns with Korean defense build-out.

company_description: Chinese cathode active material manufacturer producing LFP and NCM cathodes for the lithium-ion battery industry. Supplies major Chinese cell makers including CATL and BYD; anchored strategically by automaker GAC ahead of Hong Kong/mainland IPO.
co_investors: GAC Capital (GAC Group), Yibin Development Holdings Group, GEM, China Capital Management, Royal-Power Asset Management, +13 others
robotnik_take: Cathode materials manufacturer scaling LFP and NCM capacity ahead of HK/Mainland IPO process. ¥2.6B Series B is one of largest battery materials raises of 2023, anchored by GAC's strategic capital. Sits in same value-chain pocket as ALB-type cathode-active-material producers serving CATL/BYD.

company_description: Chinese designer of automotive power semiconductors including MOSFETs, IGBTs, GaN HEMTs, and SiC diodes. Targets EV charging and inverter applications competing with Infineon and STMicroelectronics.
robotnik_take: Power semiconductor designer making automotive MOSFETs, IGBTs, GaN HEMTs, SiC diodes. Targets EV charging/inverters where INFY and STM dominate globally.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of autonomous mobile robots and unmanned forklifts for warehouse logistics. Competes with Geek+ and Quicktron in the Chinese domestic AMR market.
co_investors: China Merchants Venture Capital
robotnik_take: AMR + unmanned forklift combo for warehouse logistics; fifth-gen multi-modal flexible AMR launched late 2023. Part of China's intense domestic AMR competition vs. Geek+, Quicktron.

company_description: Korean developer of wearable exoskeletons including the WIBS industrial back-support and the WIM mobility-assist products. Founded by former Samsung robotics engineers.
robotnik_take: WIM wearable exoskeleton for walking-mobility assistance, targeting aging populations. Sold 600 units in first 6 months in Korea before US/CES 2025 push.

company_description: Builds the Carter cargo cart and Grace fleet-orchestration software for warehouses. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics); competes with Locus Robotics and Symbotic in the warehouse AMR segment.
co_investors: Future Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, JAZZ Ventures, Playground Global
robotnik_take: Rodney Brooks' (iRobot/Rethink) third act — Carter cart + Grace software for warehouses. RaaS model competes directly with Locus and Symbotic (NASDAQ:SYM) ecosystem.

company_description: Dutch developer of a nano-porous silicon anode material for lithium-ion batteries, produced through a low-cost casting process. Norsk Hydro is a strategic investor integrating its aluminum value chain into European battery supply.
co_investors: Invest-NL, Rubio, SHIFT Invest, PDENH (with €5.5M Dutch National Growth Fund subsidy)
robotnik_take: Nano-porous silicon anode material; differentiated from Sila/Group14 by casting-based process for lower cost. Norsk Hydro strategic to integrate aluminum value chain into European battery supply. €15M equity Series A; thesis fit is European-onshored anode capacity vs. Asian incumbents.

company_description: Builds Dexter, a smaller, mobile surgical robot for ambulatory surgery centers, designed to compete with Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci on cost and footprint. FDA-cleared for gallbladder removal, hysterectomy, and hernia repair.
robotnik_take: Dexter robot targets ASC market — direct shot at Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG)'s da Vinci dominance with smaller, mobile platform. FDA-cleared for gallbladder, hysterectomy, and hernia repair.

company_description: Builds in-space refueling infrastructure — propellant depots and shuttle vehicles for refueling satellites in GEO, LEO, and VLEO. Lockheed Martin Ventures is a strategic investor anchoring defense prime interest.
co_investors: Stride Capital, Industrious Ventures, Lockheed Martin Ventures, Tribe Capital, Good Growth Capital, Massive Capital Partners
robotnik_take: On-orbit refueling; fuel depots in GEO/LEO/VLEO. Lockheed Martin Ventures participation signals primes' interest in in-orbit servicing. Adjacent to Astroscale's debris/servicing, but Orbit Fab focuses purely on propellant/fuel.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of high-end IC packaging substrates, addressing the domestic gap in advanced packaging materials currently dominated by Japanese (Ibiden, Shinko) and Taiwanese (Unimicron) suppliers.
co_investors: SL Capital, Lanhor Capital, Teda Venture Capital, Summitview Capital, Gaorong Capital, Jiangbei New Area Development Fund, Xingrui Capital, KQ Capital
robotnik_take: Produces high-end IC packaging substrates, addressing China's strategic gap in advanced packaging materials currently dominated by Japanese (Ibiden, Shinko) and Taiwanese (Unimicron) suppliers.

company_description: Builds a modular outdoor yard care robot with interchangeable mowing, snow-blowing, and leaf-blowing attachments. Sells direct to consumers with strong Kickstarter origins; targets cold-climate North American homeowners.
robotnik_take: Modular outdoor yard care robot (mowing, snow blowing, leaf blowing). Highest-funded consumer robotics Kickstarter ($3.45M, 2022); now scaling DTC consumer hardware.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of servo drives, servo motors, and motion control products for industrial automation. Domestic-substitute play against Yaskawa and Mitsubishi.
co_investors: Feitu Venture Capital
robotnik_take: Servo drives, servo motors, and motion control for industrial automation. Domestic substitute play vs. Yaskawa, Mitsubishi.

company_description: Chinese designer of GPU chips and graphics cards for embedded, industrial control, PC, and server applications. Part of China's domestic GPU effort to substitute NVIDIA and AMD imports under US export controls.
co_investors: Yantai Finance Development Investment Group, Shandong Provincial Guidance Fund
robotnik_take: Designs GPU chips and cards for embedded, industrial control, PC, server applications. Part of China's domestic GPU push to substitute NVDA/AMD imports under tightening export controls.

company_description: Chinese designer of power management chips for high-reliability aerospace and defense applications. Operates in the niche addressed in the West by Vicor and rad-hard Microchip products.
robotnik_take: Power management chips for high-reliability aerospace/defense applications. Niche position similar to Vicor/Microchip rad-hard products in Western market; insulated from export controls.

company_description: Chinese construction robotics company addressing labor-shortage automation in the Chinese construction sector.
robotnik_take: Construction robotics — labor-shortage automation for Chinese construction sector.

company_description: Korean manufacturer of articulated, orthogonal (gantry), and SCARA industrial robots. Pivoting toward logistics automation; pursuing a KOSDAQ IPO.
co_investors: Devsisters Ventures, Hana Securities
robotnik_take: Articulated, orthogonal, and SCARA industrial robots; pivot toward logistics automation. First VC round since 2021 credit guarantee fund — KOSDAQ IPO planned.

company_description: Operates an optical inter-satellite data relay constellation that provides bandwidth backhaul for other LEO operators. Differentiated from voice/IoT comms providers; partnered with the US Space Development Agency on Tranche 0/1 missions.
co_investors: Costanoa Ventures, Canaan Partners, Tribe Capital, BDC Capital Industrial Innovation Venture Fund
robotnik_take: Optical inter-satellite data relay constellation - bandwidth backhaul for other LEO operators. Differentiated from Iridium-style voice/IoT comms; more like 'space-internet plumbing'. Total raised >$200M post round. Ties to SDA Tranche 0/1 ecosystem.

company_description: Japanese lunar exploration company developing the HAKUTO-R lunar lander and Series 3 lander for cislunar cargo missions. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (9348). Not to be confused with the Chinese launch company iSpace / Beijing Interstellar Glory.
robotnik_take: Lunar lander developer; first Japanese lunar startup to IPO (Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market). Raised JPY 6.7B on debut, traded ~4x offering price. Hakuto-R Mission 1 lander failed at touchdown weeks later. Comp: Intuitive Machines (LUNR-Nasdaq) post-SPAC, Astrobotic.

company_description: Builds small geostationary communications satellites — roughly the size of a mini-fridge — that deliver dedicated broadband to specific regions at lower cost than traditional GEO sats. Operates the Omega program targeting 100+ Block 1 satellites in orbit by 2030.
co_investors: Bam Elevate, BlackRock, Fidelity, Baillie Gifford
robotnik_take: Mega-round at $1.6B post-money to fully fund Omega program (small GEO comms sats). Comparable to ASTS satellite-direct play at MEO/LEO; Astranis goes GEO with smaller, cheaper birds. Equity + debt structure; plans 100+ Block 1 satellites in orbit by 2030.

company_description: Direct lithium extraction company using its LiTAS molecular-separation membrane technology to recover lithium from brines without evaporation ponds. GM is a strategic investor and offtake partner.
co_investors: POSCO Holdings, University of Texas Horizon Fund, Helios Capital
robotnik_take: Direct lithium extraction (DLE) using LiTAS membranes; claims 90%+ recovery vs. 30-40% conventional. GM strategic to lock in domestic lithium supply for Ultium platform. Positions against ALB and LAC traditional brine players via process tech rather than orebody quality.

company_description: Builds the LaserWeeder, an autonomous farm implement that uses computer vision and high-powered lasers to kill weeds in row crops without herbicides. Sells to specialty-crop growers; claims significant cost reduction versus chemical weed control.
co_investors: Anthos Capital, Fuse Venture Capital, Ignition Partners, Liquid2, Voyager Capital
robotnik_take: LaserWeeder uses computer vision and lasers for chemical-free weed control — labor-shortage thesis applied to row crops. Total raised ~$67M; 80% reduction in weed-control costs vs. herbicide.

company_description: Builds autonomous orbital vehicles (the Jackal AOV) and ground software for space domain awareness and rendezvous-proximity operations. Sells primarily to the US Space Force and Department of Defense for orbital security missions.
co_investors: Riot Ventures, Champion Hill Ventures, Space.VC, Narya
robotnik_take: Space domain awareness / RPO startup - Jackal autonomous orbital pursuit vehicle. Defense-focused; founded by ex-Space Force operators. Total raised $30M post round. Direct comp: Rocket Lab's space surveillance services and Slingshot Aerospace.

company_description: Designs Rhea, an Arm Neoverse V1-based HPC microprocessor anchoring European supercomputing sovereignty under the France 2030 plan. State-backed; targets the European High-Performance Computing Joint Undertaking.
lead_investors: Arm, Atos Group (Eviden), French Tech Souveraineté
co_investors: European Innovation Council Fund, European Investment Bank
robotnik_take: Building Rhea HPC microprocessor based on Arm Neoverse V1 to anchor European supercomputing sovereignty. Targets Arm-based HPC niche similar to AMPR's Ampere Altra play but state-backed via France 2030 plan.

company_description: Allen Institute (AI2) spinout building a copilot and data platform for robotics engineers — enabling natural-language search and debugging of petabyte-scale robot sensor data.
co_investors: Allen Institute for AI (AI2), FUSE Ventures
robotnik_take: AI2 spinout building a copilot/data platform for robotics engineers — search/debug petabyte-scale sensor data via natural language. Picks-and-shovels for the robotics foundation-model wave.

company_description: Built the Covariant Brain, a foundation model for warehouse-picking robotic arms. Co-founded by Pieter Abbeel; reverse-acquihired by Amazon in 2024, with much of the team and IP joining Amazon's robotics organization.
co_investors: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board, Amplify Partners, Gates Frontier Holdings, AIX Ventures, Northgate Capital
robotnik_take: Covariant Brain warehouse-picking foundation model; total raised $222M. Pieter Abbeel's foundation-model thesis preceded the 2024 reverse-acquihire by Amazon — pre-AGI infrastructure for robotics manipulation.

company_description: 12-inch middle-end-of-line foundry in Jiangyin, China specializing in advanced packaging services — wafer bumping, redistribution layer (RDL), and interposer fabrication. Positions as a domestic alternative to TSMC CoWoS and the OSAT majors ASE and Amkor.
lead_investors: Legend Capital, Goldstone Investment, INCE Capital
co_investors: Jade Stone Venture, Shang Qi Capital, Leafoison Capital, TCL Capital, China Fortune-Innovation Capital, GLP-C&D Capital, Oriza Rivertown, Oriza Hua Capital
robotnik_take: Pioneer 12-inch MEOL foundry with bumping/RDL capabilities for advanced packaging. China's answer to TSM CoWoS bottleneck and ASE/AMKR's OSAT dominance amid US export controls.

company_description: Builds lunar data centers for disaster recovery storage and edge computing. Speculative space-based data infrastructure play targeting commercial and government data sovereignty.
co_investors: Seldor Capital, 2 Future Holding, The Veteran Fund, Irongate Capital, Atypical Ventures, KittyHawk Ventures
robotnik_take: Lunar data center / disaster recovery storage thesis. Quintessential 'crazy space idea' that closed funding right after SVB shock. Niche but interesting — physical AI/data infrastructure tail risk play.

company_description: Canadian developer of the Inverse3 haptic-control device for surgical training, medical simulation, and VR applications. Sells haptic feedback hardware to medsim and physical AI developers.
lead_investors: BDC Capital Deep Tech Venture Fund
robotnik_take: Haptic-control devices for surgical training and physical AI. Inverse3 device targeting medical-sim and VR markets. Canadian deep-tech fund signals public-LP interest in haptics middleware.

company_description: Develops Spectrum, a small-to-medium-lift launch vehicle for European institutional and commercial payloads. Targets sovereign European launch capacity from Andoya Spaceport in Norway.
co_investors: Bayern Kapital (Scale Up Fund Bavaria), Earlybird Venture Capital, HV Capital, Lakestar, Lombard Odier Investment Managers, Porsche SE, UVC Partners, Vsquared Ventures
robotnik_take: Largest SpaceTech round of Q1 2023 globally; total raised >$330M. Funds Spectrum SLV development for sovereign EU launch. Comp to RFA, Latitude, Skyrora — leading European challenger to SpaceX.

company_description: MIT spinout building autonomous driving software for ports, warehouses, and yards. Demonstrated 1-inch parking precision for 45-foot tractor-trailers; LG is a strategic investor anchoring Korean industrial conglomerate interest.
co_investors: Safar Partners, UOB Venture Management, Alpha JWC, LDV Partners
robotnik_take: MIT spinout for autonomy in ports/warehouses/yards — 1-inch parking precision for 45ft tractor-trailers. LG-led signals Korean industrial conglomerate interest in logistics autonomy.

company_description: Operates in-space manufacturing satellites that produce pharmaceutical and materials products in microgravity and return them to Earth in reentry capsules. The same reentry capsules also serve as hypersonic test beds for the US Air Force and NASA.
co_investors: Varda existing VC investors
robotnik_take: STRATFI deal: $30M government ($15M USAF + $15M NASA + $15M AFWERX) + $30M VC matching from existing investors. Hypersonic test bed using Varda reentry capsules. Dual-use defense play; pioneered govt+VC matched financing model for space hypersonic testing.

company_description: Chinese autonomous logistics vehicle developer focused on industrial and port deployments. Strategic partner Dongfeng provides OEM integration; targets Chinese ports, airports, and industrial complexes.
co_investors: Dongfeng Asset Management, Chongqing High-tech Holdings
robotnik_take: Autonomous logistics vehicles — total raised $154M. Dongfeng strategic positions UISEE for OEM deployments in Chinese ports and industrial complexes amid AV downturn for passenger cars.

company_description: Norwegian humanoid robot company building NEO, a consumer-oriented bipedal android designed for the home. Strategic and product collaboration with OpenAI; competes with Figure and Tesla Optimus on consumer humanoid form factors.
co_investors: Tiger Global, Sandwater, Alliance Ventures, Skagerak Capital
robotnik_take: OpenAI's first robotics bet — funding goes to NEO bipedal humanoid development and EVE manufacturing scale-up. Marks the start of OpenAI's strategic interest in physical AI hardware.

company_description: Swiss manufacturer of VTOL commercial mapping drones. WingtraOne survey UAV is the flagship product; targets surveying, mining, and construction users wanting fixed-wing range with vertical takeoff.
co_investors: EquityPitcher Ventures, Verve Ventures, EIC Fund, Ace & Company, John L. Steffens
robotnik_take: VTOL mapping drones in 96 countries — 100k+ flights, 18M acres mapped. Customers include NASA, US Army Corps. Survey-grade enterprise drone segment is a separate pool from defense.

company_description: Operates a robotic third-party logistics (3PL) fulfillment stack — AI-powered pick robots running inside its own warehouses for e-commerce customers. Strategic partner with FedEx, which has integrated Nimble into FedEx Fulfillment.
co_investors: DNS Capital, GSR Ventures, Breyer Capital
robotnik_take: Pivot from picking-as-a-service to fully autonomous 3PL with $115M total raised. Shrinks warehouse footprint 75%. Direct attack on Stord, ShipBob, Flexport's traditional 3PL economics.

company_description: French developer of satellite hyper-geolocation middleware providing centimeter-level GPS corrections for autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, and construction.
co_investors: Bouygues Telecom, Colas, Bouygues Construction, Stellantis, Thales
robotnik_take: Satellite hyper-geolocation (cm-level) middleware for AVs and industrial automation. Strategic investor lineup spans AV/auto, telecom, construction — broad horizontal applicability.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of industrial autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and AGVs for warehouse and factory applications. Competes with Geek+ and Quicktron in the domestic Chinese AMR market.
robotnik_take: Largest reported Chinese AMR/AGV round in March 2023 — Standard's industrial-AMR fleet competes with Geek+ and Quicktron in China. Shows continued domestic VC appetite despite global slowdown.

company_description: Swiss manufacturer of the Elios indoor inspection drone, designed with a collision-tolerant cage for navigation inside confined industrial spaces. Sells to oil and gas, power, mining, and food industry inspection customers.
co_investors: Cargill, Verve Ventures, Dow, ETF Partners, Swisscom, Future Industry Ventures
robotnik_take: Indoor inspection drone leader (Elios 3 with LiDAR) — 500+ customers, 100 employees, 50+ resellers. Cargill strategic backing reflects industrial-inspection demand from food/agri sector.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of the Yarbo modular yard robot, with interchangeable snow-blower and lawnmower attachments. Targets cold-climate North American consumers as a competitor to Husqvarna and Worx.
robotnik_take: Yarbo modular yard-robot maker (snow blower + lawnmower attachments) targeting cold-climate North American consumers. Pre-A of 100M yuan funds US distribution as competitor to Husqvarna/Worx.

company_description: Designs Sohu, a transformer-specific AI ASIC. Hardwires the transformer architecture into silicon, with the bet that transformer dominance makes specialization economical against general-purpose NVIDIA GPUs.
co_investors: Two Sigma Ventures, MAX Ventures, Earl Grey Capital
robotnik_take: Transformer-only ASIC bet by Harvard-dropout founders. Pre-product seed; would later raise $120M Series A in mid-2024 against the Sohu chip. Compares unfavorably (per founder claim) to NVDA's general-purpose H100.

company_description: Swiss ETH Zurich spinout building autonomous indoor inventory-tracking drones for warehouses. UPS Velocity is the anchor customer at its Shepherdsville, Kentucky facility; competes with Corvus Robotics and Skydio enterprise drones.
co_investors: Exor Ventures
robotnik_take: Autonomous indoor inventory drones — IKEA, Maersk, DSV deployments across 30 sites in 13 countries. Founded by Raffaello D'Andrea (Kiva Systems co-founder). Direct play on warehouse cycle counts.

company_description: Japanese manufacturer of hybrid AGV/AMR robots for warehouse and factory applications. Targets 1,500 units per year of production capacity with US market expansion; founded by Bosch alumni.
co_investors: Drone Fund, SBI Investment, DBJ Capital, Mitsubishi UFJ Capital, Mizuho Lease, Incubate Fund, Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Capital, SMBC Venture Capital, SOSV
robotnik_take: Hybrid AGV/AMR maker entering US market with 1,500 units/year planned capacity. Bosch alum-led; Japanese megabank LP base reflects domestic robotics push as labor shortage worsens.

company_description: Develops Mega-class high-power satellites — large, high-capability spacecraft designed for the heavy-lift launch era opened by Starship-class vehicles. Sells to constellation operators and government customers wanting more capability per spacecraft than current smallsat designs.
co_investors: Countdown Capital, Boost VC, Also Capital, Side Door Ventures, Earthrise Ventures, Spacecadet VC, Pathbreaker Ventures
robotnik_take: Founded by ex-SpaceX engineers; 'Mega Class' high-power satellite buses leveraging Starship payload class. Bigger-is-better thesis vs. small-sat trend; comp to Apex Space.

company_description: Designs analog in-memory compute AI inference chips that perform matrix multiplications directly in flash-memory cells rather than digital MAC units. Targets edge AI workloads in industrial, IoT, and automotive applications.
co_investors: DCVC, Lux Capital, Catapult Ventures, Hermann Hauser Investment
robotnik_take: Bridge round following Mythic's late-2022 capital crisis and CEO change. Analog compute-in-memory architecture remains commercially unproven vs. NVDA's CUDA moat; M2000 product ramp now underwritten.

company_description: Builds AI-vision software for parcel handling — robotic pick-and-place systems integrated with logistics partners like Honeywell and Daifuku. Operates over 1 million picks per day in production at parcel and e-commerce customers.
co_investors: Top Tier Capital Partners, Tyche Partners, ROBO Global Ventures, Translink, McRock, Pritzker Group Venture Capital
robotnik_take: AI-vision software for parcel handling — 1M+ picks/day in production. Total raised $94M. 3x YoY growth on parcel-induct vision systems for logistics integrators (Honeywell, Daifuku).

company_description: Italian large-format additive manufacturing company using robotic arms with proprietary extrusion to 3D-print industrial components in metal and composite. Targets aerospace, energy, and automotive customers as an alternative to CNC and casting.
co_investors: Neva SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo), Primo Space Fund, EUREKA! Venture SGR
robotnik_take: Robotic-arm large-format additive manufacturing (LFAM) — €10.6M Series A targets US/Middle East expansion. Italy's industrial-AM ecosystem expanding into robotic-controlled deposition.

company_description: Develops a fault-tolerant photonic quantum computer using silicon photonics manufactured on standard CMOS processes. Operates a cryogenic R&D facility in Daresbury, UK developing the high-power dilution refrigeration systems needed to scale to million-qubit machines.
lead_investors: UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT)
robotnik_take: GBP 9M UK government grant funded a Daresbury cryogenic R&D site for high-power dilution refrigeration scaling - a quiet underwriting of UK industrial policy ahead of the much larger 2024 Australian commitment. Photonic quantum compute approach contrasts with NVDA-aligned silicon roadmaps.

company_description: Developed highway autonomous driving software intended for consumer vehicle OEMs. Shut down operations in October 2024 amid the broader L4 consumer-AV pullback.
robotnik_take: Consumer-AV software player pivot — focused on highway autonomy for OEMs. Total raised $240M. Would shut down operations Oct 2024 amid broader L4 consumer-AV winter.

company_description: Builds a winch-based gantry robot that installs roof shingles. Targets the solar installation and asphalt roofing contractor markets through construction labor automation.
co_investors: SOSV (HAX), Newlab, Uphonest Capital, Climate Capital
robotnik_take: Roof-shingle installation robot — winch-based gantry system targeting solar/asphalt roofing contractors. Construction labor shortage and solar tailwind = a $5B+ TAM wedge.

company_description: Designs and manufactures 3D NAND flash memory as an integrated device manufacturer. China's flagship NAND producer, restructured and recapitalized after US Entity List inclusion in late 2022. Competes with Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, and Kioxia in the NAND market.
lead_investors: China Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund (Big Fund II)
co_investors: China National Reform & Development Commission affiliated funds, Hubei provincial entities
robotnik_take: RMB 12.9B (US$1.9B) Big Fund II tranche of larger US$7B+ recap as YMTC restructured registered capital from RMB 56.3B to RMB 105.3B. Restoration of China's flagship 3D NAND IDM after Entity List inclusion in late 2022. Western competitor: Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung.

company_description: Manufactures autonomous drones for public safety, defense, and industrial inspection, with onboard AI for obstacle avoidance and tracking. Sunset its consumer drone line in 2023 to focus on enterprise and government customers; more than half of its pipeline is defense-related.
co_investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Next47, IVP, DoCoMo, NVIDIA, UP.Partners, Hercules Capital, Axon
robotnik_take: Largest US drone maker raised at $2.2B post-money — total funding now $562M. The Axon investment signals deeper public-safety penetration as Skydio leans into enterprise/DoD over consumer.

company_description: Japanese in-orbit servicing and active debris removal company. Operates the ELSA series for end-of-life satellite removal and is developing JAXA-contracted active debris removal missions. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
co_investors: Mitsubishi Electric ($25M), Yusaku Maezawa ($23M), Mitsubishi UFJ Bank, Mitsubishi Corporation, Development Bank of Japan, FEL Corporation
robotnik_take: Leading on-orbit servicing/debris-removal pure play; total $376M raised since 2012. Pre-IPO; Astroscale later listed on TSE in 2024. Multiple strategic Japanese corporates.

company_description: Develops grocery micro-fulfillment robotics including refrigerated and frozen-capable robotic picking systems. First deployment with Save Mart in California; differentiated from Symbotic and AutoStore on temperature-controlled handling.
co_investors: Khosla Ventures, DCVC
robotnik_take: Stealth-emergence Series B for grocery micro-fulfillment robotics — first deployment with Save Mart in California. Refrigerated/frozen-capable picking is the differentiator vs Symbotic/AutoStore.

company_description: Operates a sidewalk delivery robot fleet, primarily for food delivery on college campuses and urban routes. Asset-financing model with Kineo allowing capital-light fleet expansion.
robotnik_take: First-of-its-kind asset-financing deal for sidewalk delivery robots — kineo purchases bots and leases back to Kiwibot. Operating-lease model is gaining adoption to manage RaaS unit economics.

company_description: Omani Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM) platform-as-a-service for low-altitude airspace coordination. Targets MENA market under Saudi Vision 2030 drone integration plans.
robotnik_take: Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM) platform-as-a-service — first major Oman drone-software exit. Saudi expansion driven by Vision 2030 demand for low-altitude airspace management.

company_description: Chinese satellite communications company building China's leading commercial satcom challenger to Starlink. State-aligned bank backing including China Construction Bank.
co_investors: Anhui Sanzhongyichuang Industry Development Fund, Hefei Industry Investment, Sincere Fund
robotnik_take: Round size undisclosed; valuation now $1.58B. China's leading satcom challenger to Starlink; backed by state-aligned banks (CCB).

company_description: Korean developer of the Alpha Grill burger-cooking robot for quick-service restaurants. Has booked around 500 pre-orders; targets the Korean QSR ecosystem with a vertical-service robotics approach.
robotnik_take: Largest-ever single-round seed in Korean food-tech robotics — Alpha Grill cooks 200 patties/hour. Targets US burger chains as commercial-kitchen robotics gains traction.

company_description: Builds the DroneHunter kinetic counter-drone interceptor and the SkyDome radar system. Strategic backers Lockheed Martin and Hanwha provide defense channel access; sells counter-UAS systems to militaries and critical infrastructure operators.
lead_investors: Lockheed Martin Ventures, Hanwha Aerospace, AIM13|Crumpton Venture Partners
co_investors: DCVC, Signia Venture Partners
robotnik_take: Counter-UAS systems play (DroneHunter kinetic interceptor) gets Lockheed and Hanwha as strategic backers. Defense-tech tailwind amid Ukraine drone war is bringing strategic capital into C-UAS.

company_description: Bulgarian developer of the Black Swan cargo drone, which carries 350 kg over 2,500 km — operating as the first licensed cargo-drone airline in Europe. Targets middle-mile logistics for time-sensitive cargo.
co_investors: Founders Factory, Speedinvest, SeedBlink, Eleven Capital, Strategic Development Fund (Tawazun)
robotnik_take: First licensed cargo-drone airline in Europe — Black Swan UAV carries 350kg over 2,500km. UAE Tawazun investment plus EIC commitment positions Dronamics for European middle-mile logistics.

company_description: Australian developer of autonomous farm robots covering more than 1.3 million acres of farmland to date. The SwarmConnect OS supports third-party app developers; competes with John Deere See & Spray on weed control.
co_investors: Tribe Global Ventures, Access Capital, Tenacious Ventures, GrainInnovate
robotnik_take: Autonomous farm-platform play — 1.3M acres covered, 780 tons of pesticide saved. SwarmConnect OS for third-party app developers is the long-term moat. Comp: John Deere See & Spray.

company_description: Indian manufacturer of dual-use drones for agricultural spraying, mapping, and defense applications. MS Dhoni is a brand-ambassador investor; benefits from India's drone PLI scheme.
robotnik_take: Largest-ever Series A in Indian drone space — MS Dhoni-backed dual-use drone maker. India's drone PLI scheme is creating real domestic VC enthusiasm for defense/agriculture UAVs.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of service robots for delivery and cleaning applications, with more than 56,000 units shipped across 60+ countries. (Same parent organization as Pudu Robotics; this row covers an earlier funding round.)
robotnik_take: Service-robot maker (delivery + cleaning) C3 round funds new production base. >56,000 units shipped in 60+ countries — leading Chinese commercial service-robot vendor.

company_description: Builds shared-autonomy forklifts — robotic forklifts that combine automation with remote human supervision. Strategic backing from Qualcomm and Zebra Technologies; targets warehouse and distribution-center customers.
robotnik_take: Strategic from Qualcomm + Zebra brings total to $70M for shared-autonomy forklifts. Zebra investment signals warehouse-automation channel partnership; companion to ABB and Honeywell-Symbotic strategy.

company_description: Wyss Zurich spinout building a magnetically controlled medical soft-robotic platform for stroke thrombectomy. Uses a mobile electromagnetic field generator to steer guidewires endovascularly.
co_investors: Kinled Holding, Mountain Labs
robotnik_take: Magnetically controlled medical soft-robotics for stroke thrombectomy — FDA submission planned for Q3 2023. Wyss Zurich spinout targeting endovascular intervention with mobile EM field generator.

company_description: Builds Apollo, a general-purpose humanoid robot for warehouse and manufacturing work. Partnered with Mercedes-Benz for factory pilot deployments; targets logistics and automotive industrial customers.
robotnik_take: Pre-Apollo funding for the UT Austin spinout (Series A would not close until 2025 at $1.75B val). Early signal of mounting commercial humanoid interest before Figure/1X dominated headlines.

company_description: Israeli developer of battery-free wireless power systems for autonomous mobile robot fleets. Eliminates charging downtime for AMRs in logistics and industrial facilities.
co_investors: Mobilion VC, Payton Planar Magnetics, Doral Energy-Tech Ventures, Mobilitech Capital
robotnik_take: Battery-free wireless power for AMR fleets — eliminates charging downtime in logistics centers. Former Amazon Robotics execs as advisors validate the product-market fit for warehouse OEMs.

company_description: Develops silicon-based anode materials for high-energy-density lithium-ion cells. Holds a Department of Defense supply contract for military batteries; scaling North American silicon anode production.
co_investors: Emerald Technology Ventures, Material Impact, Arosa Capital, Nabtesco Technology Ventures, TechNexus, Hyde Park Angels, Evergreen Climate Innovations, Goose Capital
robotnik_take: Silicon-anode developer with prior $10M DoD contract. Capital onshores domestic Si-anode production — directly relevant to Group14, Sila comp set. Smaller scale and earlier than Group14/Sila but DoD revenue is differentiated.

company_description: Australian developer of diamond-based room-temperature quantum computers — using nitrogen-vacancy centers in synthetic diamond as qubits. Eliminates cryogenic cooling, enabling co-location with industrial customers.
co_investors: Main Sequence, Investible, Ultratech Capital Partners, MA Financial, Jelix Ventures, Rampersand, CM Equity Partners
robotnik_take: Diamond-based room-temperature quantum computing - eliminates cryogenics, addressing a key cost vector for IonQ/IBM-style systems. Co-location with industrial customers becomes plausible at room temp.

company_description: Drone-based inspection and analytics company (formerly DroneBase) specializing in energy infrastructure — solar farms, wind turbines, power lines, and oil and gas assets. Sells data and AI-based analytics to asset owners.
co_investors: Union Square Ventures, Upfront Ventures, Euclidean Capital, Energy Transition Ventures, Hearst Ventures
robotnik_take: Drone-data company (formerly DroneBase) rebrand and Series E around energy-asset inspection. Total raised $114M. Plays into renewables-infrastructure inspection demand alongside Skydio/AeroVironment.

company_description: Develops Starlab, a commercial space station planned as an ISS successor, in a joint venture with Airbus. Received a $160M NASA Commercial LEO Destinations award. Now Voyager Technologies, public on NYSE following a 2025 IPO.
co_investors: NewSpace Capital, Midway Venture Partners, Industrious Ventures, Seraphim Space
robotnik_take: Funding for Starlab commercial space station development. Later established Starlab JV with Airbus in July 2023; received $160M NASA CLD award. Voyager Technologies IPO'd in 2025.

company_description: Builds robotic rebar prefabrication systems for the construction industry. Strategic investor Tokyu Construction provides Japanese construction industry distribution.
robotnik_take: Rebar-prefabrication robotics extension brings Series A to $15M. Tokyu Construction as first-time strategic investor signals Japanese construction giants exploring US robotics partnerships.

company_description: Builds lithium-ion battery packs combining LFP cells (Aries) with dual-chemistry architectures (Gemini) for EV and stationary storage applications. Vertically integrated cell and pack manufacturer; restructured in 2024 after the EV-battery valuation correction.
co_investors: Temasek, Coatue, BMW i Ventures, Assembly Ventures, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Flex, Volta Energy Technologies
robotnik_take: LFP + dual-chemistry pack innovator (Aries/Gemini). $1.2B post crowned ONE a unicorn at the moment EV battery sentiment was peaking. Less of a pure-materials play vs. ONE's pack architecture, but vertically integrated cell/manufacturing thesis qualifies as battery materials infrastructure. Note: ONE later restructured in 2024.

company_description: French designer of the GAP9 ultra-low-power RISC-V application processor for hearables and battery-powered IoT devices. Competes with ARM Cortex-M and Ambient ML in ultra-low-power compute.
co_investors: Thales, Definvest, French Tech Seed Fund, Soitec, Zepp Health, Bpifrance
robotnik_take: Ultra-low-power RISC-V app processor (GAP9) for hearables and battery-powered IoT. Bpifrance/Thales presence signals strategic French sovereign-tech alignment. Direct competitor to ARM Cortex-M and Ambient ML.

company: Hua Hong Semiconductor (Hua Hong Manufacturing JV)
company_description: Joint venture building a 12-inch wafer fab in Wuxi, China for mature-node logic production at 65nm, 55nm, and 40nm. Output targets domestic Chinese demand for analog, power, and specialty chips as part of China's mature-node capacity expansion. Hua Hong Semiconductor (HKEX: 1347) is the parent foundry; the Wuxi JV is its capacity expansion vehicle.
co_investors: China Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund (Big Fund II), Wuxi Xi Hong Lian Xin Investment
robotnik_take: USD 4.02B equity injection into a $6.7B Wuxi 12-inch fab JV (mature nodes 65/55/40nm). Big Fund II contributing US$1.165B at ~29% stake. China's mature-node capacity expansion playbook accelerating despite US export controls. Compares to TSM's mature-node mix and Tower Semiconductor.

company_description: Chinese small satellite manufacturer (also known as Beijing Weina Star Technology) supplying spacecraft for the country's LEO constellation buildout. Mass-manufactures buses and integrated satellites for state and commercial constellation customers.
robotnik_take: ~400M yuan Series B/B+ for satellite manufacturing. Chinese satellite-maker peer to GalaxySpace; growing China commercial smallsat ecosystem.

company_description: Australian quantum control software company providing calibration, error suppression, and pulse-level control software used across qubit modalities — superconducting, trapped-ion, neutral-atom. Sits at the middleware layer between qubit hardware vendors.
co_investors: Alumni Ventures, ICM Allectus, Mindrock Capital, Bill Lightfoot, John Eales
robotnik_take: Quantum control software for multiple qubit modalities. Salesforce Ventures' first quantum bet. Funded scale-up across Sydney, LA, Berlin offices.

company_description: Builds the Ago automotive radar software platform that improves ADAS radar resolution and reduces false positives without changing the underlying radar hardware. Microsoft is a strategic investor.
co_investors: Microsoft, Prime Movers Lab, MaC VC, Gaingels
robotnik_take: Automotive radar software (Ago platform) targeting ADAS resolution and false-positive reduction. Microsoft's participation suggests cloud/compute partnership angle alongside the core sensor-software product.

company_description: Commercializes molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for producing primary steel and high-value metals directly by electrochemistry, eliminating blast furnace coal consumption. MIT spinout; ships high-value metals as first revenue product, with full MOE green steel targeted for later commercialization.
co_investors: Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund, SiteGround Capital, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BHP Ventures, Prelude Ventures
robotnik_take: MIT spinout commercializing molten oxide electrolysis (MOE) for green steel. Strategic from world's #2 steelmaker is structural validation. Series C first close; later expanded to $262M total in September 2023. Direct competitor to H2-DRI plays like H2 Green Steel/Stegra.

company_description: Operated orbital transfer vehicles (OTVs) for last-mile satellite delivery. Acquired by Katalyst Space Technologies in April 2025; competed with D-Orbit and Impulse Space in the OTV segment.
robotnik_take: Co-led Series A funds OTV demo mission. Last-mile satellite logistics play; parallel theme to D-Orbit, Impulse Space, Launcher (acquired by Vast 2023). Atomos was acquired by Katalyst Space Technologies in April 2025.

company_description: Japanese industrial drone services and software company. Saudi Aramco's venture arm led a strategic round to establish Terra Drone Arabia under Saudi Vision 2030, focused on industrial-inspection drone services.
robotnik_take: Aramco's VC arm led the round to set up Terra Drone Arabia under Saudi Vision 2030. Total raised to $97M. Reflects Saudi industrial-inspection drone ambition and Japanese-Saudi tech corridor.

company_description: Builds autonomous electric commercial mowers for landscape contractors and grounds-maintenance operators. Subscription-based deployment model with more than 7,500 preorders booked.
co_investors: ArcTern Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Amazon Alexa Fund, True Ventures, Inspired Capital, Lemnos
robotnik_take: Autonomous electric commercial mower vendor brings total to $60M with 7,500 preorders. Outdoor-autonomy thesis is gaining traction as a high-volume, lower-regulatory-friction wedge vs full AVs.

company_description: Builds mission management software-as-a-service for satellite operators. Y Combinator company founded by former OneWeb engineers.
co_investors: FCVC, Soma Capital, Liquid 2 Ventures
robotnik_take: Mission management SaaS for satellite operators founded by ex-OneWeb engineers. Below $3M threshold but flagship YC space deal in Q1; meaningful for ground systems/operations subsector tracking.

company_description: Builds neutral-atom quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped rubidium atoms. French headquarters with a manufacturing footprint in Quebec's DistriQ quantum innovation zone; commercial systems delivered to enterprise customers.
co_investors: Quantonation, Defense Innovation Fund, Daphni, Eni Next, European Innovation Council (EIC) Fund, Wa'ed Ventures, Bpifrance
robotnik_take: Largest equity quantum hardware round in Europe at time of close. Neutral-atom approach competes with PsiQuantum (photonic) and IonQ (trapped-ion); Pasqal targets 1,000-qubit capacity, lagging Quantinuum's commercial roadmap.

company_description: German construction robotics company building the LIFTBOT material-transport robot that automates scaffold logistics and site material delivery. Targets construction sites with high labor turnover.
co_investors: Cybernetix Ventures, Unorthodox Ventures, Nemetschek, True Ventures, MIG Capital
robotnik_take: Construction-site robotics (LiftBot hoist) brings total to $20M. Fifth Wall lead reflects real-estate-aligned LP base betting on construction productivity automation.

company_description: Builds autonomous yard trucks with integrated robotic arms for hooking and unhooking trailers at distribution centers. Deployed at customers covering about 20% of the North American yard-truck base.
co_investors: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), NVentures (NVIDIA), Koch Disruptive Technologies, NEA
robotnik_take: Autonomous electric yard truck developer brings total raised to $191M. NVIDIA Ventures participation signals strategic interest in distribution-yard automation as the wedge for trucking autonomy.

company_description: Chinese commercial launch company developing the Gravity-1 medium-lift launcher (6,500 kg to LEO) and the Gravity-2 reusable methalox vehicle. Competes with LandSpace, iSpace, and Galactic Energy.
co_investors: Minyin International, miHoYo, Vision Plus Capital, Pagoda
robotnik_take: 400M RMB Series A funds Gravity-1 medium-lift launcher (6,500kg LEO) and Gravity-2 reusable engine R&D. China launch sector crowding; comp to LandSpace, iSpace.

company_description: Canadian direct lithium extraction (DLE) company focused on Latin American brines in Chile and Argentina. Deploys its denaLi technology at existing brine producers as an upgrade rather than building greenfield evaporation ponds.
lead_investors: Evok Innovations, BDC Capital Climate Tech Fund
co_investors: Volta Energy Technologies, NGP, Helios Climate Ventures, The Grantham Foundation, Xora Innovation, Capricorn Investment Group
robotnik_take: Direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology focused on Latin American brines (Chile, Argentina). Series A2 at $50M brings total to $72M. DLE comp set with Lilac, EnergyX, Mangrove — Summit is differentiated by deployment focus on existing brine producers vs. greenfield projects. Rounds out the lithium upstream portfolio thesis.

company_description: MIT spinout producing low-carbon cement using an electrochemical process at ambient temperature, bypassing the high-emissions calcination step of conventional Portland cement. Strategic partner Siam Cement provides industry validation.
co_investors: Siam Cement Group, The Engine, Energy Impact Partners
robotnik_take: MIT spinout (Yet-Ming Chiang/Leah Ellis) producing electrified cement at ambient temperature. Cement is ~8% of global CO2 — credible decarbonization play. Strategic from Siam Cement (SCG) signals offtake validation. Comparable thesis to Brimstone, but uses electrochemistry vs. calcium-silicate; both pre-revenue at this stage.

company_description: Slovak company combining Photoneo (3D machine vision) and Brightpick (autonomous warehouse picking) into an integrated vision-and-robotics warehouse automation stack. Sells to European warehouse and 3PL operators.
co_investors: IPM Group, Alpha Intelligence Capital, H&D Asset Management, Venture to Future Fund, Kolowrat Group
robotnik_take: $19M extension brings Series B to $40M for the merged Photoneo (3D vision) + Brightpick (autonomous warehouse picking). Total raised $53M. Vision-stack + robot-fleet integration thesis playing out in EU.

company_description: French manufacturer of the Colossus firefighting unmanned ground vehicle, deployed at the Notre-Dame fire. More than 100 robots deployed in 15 countries for hostile-environment robotics applications.
robotnik_take: Maker of Colossus firefighting UGV (deployed at Notre-Dame fire) raises EUR 10M for hostile-environment robotics expansion. >100 robots in 15 countries — defense and emergency-services flywheel.

company_description: Belgian developer of AI-based rail autonomy software for trams, freight, and shunting operations. Customers include DB, SNCF, and NS; won the Betuweroute pilot for the first remote-controlled freight trains in the Netherlands.
co_investors: imec.istart
robotnik_take: AI-based rail autonomy for trams, freight, and shunting. Won Betuweroute pilot (first remote-controlled freight trains in NL). Customers include DB, SNCF, NS — rail autonomy is European-scale opportunity.

company_description: Develops the Light Control Metasurface (LCM) beam-steering chip for solid-state LiDAR. The LM10 commercial chip replaces moving parts in LiDAR with semiconductor beam steering for ADAS, robotics, and industrial applications.
co_investors: USAA, Uniquest
robotnik_take: Light Control Metasurface (LCM) beam-steering chips for solid-state LiDAR. Cumulative funding $56M post-round. Threat to mechanical LiDAR incumbents; LM10 commercial chip launched later in 2023.

company_description: Builds a multi-orbit (MEO and HEO) satellite communications constellation paired with edge computing capabilities. Targets mobile network operators with backhaul and managed services.
co_investors: MetaVC Partners, Promus Ventures, Temasek, Scottish Enterprise, KTSat
robotnik_take: Note: SpaceNews dated Jan 11 2023 but BusinessWire/Crunchbase show Jan 11 2022. Confirmed via SpaceNews archive — funding announcement covered by SpaceNews in their Jan 2023 listing. MEO/HEO satcom + edge compute play; MNO partnership angle.

company_description: French designer of the Tyr family of automotive ADAS and autonomous driving compute IP for L2+ to L5 vehicles. Competes with NVIDIA Drive Thor and Mobileye EyeQ in the AV silicon stack.
co_investors: Angel investors
robotnik_take: Below-threshold $5M flagship round; included as a flagship Series-letter ADAS/AD compute IP play. Tyr family targets L2+ to L5 vehicles; competes with NVDA Drive Thor and Mobileye EyeQ.

company_description: UK-based B2B autonomous driving software platform. Customers and partners include insurance, energy, and logistics operators deploying autonomous vehicles in industrial settings; Tencent is a strategic investor.
lead_investors: Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, ENEOS Innovation Partners
co_investors: BGF, Halma, Hostplus, Kiko Ventures, Ocado Group, Tencent, Venture Science, ZF
robotnik_take: B2B autonomy software platform — total raised $225M. Tencent's participation signals strategic Chinese interest in UK AV stack. Insurance and energy LP composition reflects industrial-deployment ambitions.

company_description: Operates a constellation of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites delivering all-weather, day-and-night imagery. Sells to defense, intelligence, and commercial customers; competes with ICEYE in commercial SAR.
robotnik_take: Growth equity follow-on to $97M Series C from April 2022; brings total to ~$250M. SAR EO comp to ICEYE; strategic capital from Thomas Tull's USIT signals dual-use defense play.

company_description: Israeli developer of teleoperation software for autonomous vehicles — remote-supervision middleware that lets human operators take over self-driving cars when needed. ComfortDelGro is a strategic transit-operator investor.
co_investors: MizMaa Ventures, IN Venture, Next Gear Ventures
robotnik_take: Largest-ever Series A for a teleoperation pure-play. ComfortDelGro's $4M anchor investment signals Asian transit operator interest in remote-supervision middleware as a path to AV deployment.

company_description: Designed Data Processing Units (DPUs) for data center networking and storage. Acquired by Microsoft in 2023 as an acquihire to support Azure's data center silicon initiative.
robotnik_take: Microsoft acquihire of Fungible's DPU team and IP at significant haircut to >$300M VC raised (notably from SoftBank Vision Fund). Sets DPU benchmark for Azure data-center silicon initiative; AMD-Pensando comparable. Below-water for prior backers.

company_description: Israeli developer of silicon-dominant extreme-fast-charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells. Partnered with Vietnamese EV maker VinFast through the VinES partnership for XFC cells in production vehicles.
co_investors: BP Ventures, Daimler, Samsung, EVE Energy, Roman Abramovich's Norma Investments
robotnik_take: Silicon-dominant XFC (Extreme Fast Charging) cell developer. Series D led by Vietnam EV maker VinFast as part of the VinES partnership for first-gen XFC cells in 2025 vehicles. Comp to Group14, NanoGraf, Sila — but StoreDot's go-to-market is cell-form-factor partnerships rather than anode-material licensing. Round size reported as $70M (closed) to $80M (target).

company_description: Australian-listed manganese miner developing the Butcherbird mine in Western Australia and a high-purity manganese sulphate (HPMSM) processing facility in Louisiana. Stellantis and GM are strategic offtake partners for EV battery cathode feedstock.
robotnik_take: Stellantis-Element 25 binding agreement: $30M strategic package — $15M equity at A$1/share + $15M offtake prepayment — to support Butcherbird (WA) manganese ore feedstock and a US HPMSM (high-purity manganese sulphate) processing facility (Louisiana). Q1 announcement; first $15M equity tranche closed July 2023. Combined with the GM $85M Element 25 facility (June 2023), positions E25 as the WA-to-US manganese cathode-precursor champion. Captures the OEM-funded onshoring playbook for unsexy but constraint-binding cathode minerals.

company_description: Singapore-based manufacturer of commercial cleaning robots for offices, retail, and large indoor facilities. Sells globally with growing US distribution.
co_investors: Supersteam Asia Pacific, Freny Firoze Irani
robotnik_take: Cleaning robot manufacturer at $80M pre-money valuation. TransLink's $7M check signals US VC interest in commercial-cleaning automation as proven-revenue category vs more speculative humanoid bets.

company_description: Canadian operator of the Skylark space-based space situational awareness constellation. Sells SSA data to satellite operators and governments; went public via SPAC in 2024. Competes with LeoLabs and Slingshot Aerospace.
lead_investors: Cartesian Capital Group (via Pangaea Three Acquisition Holdings III)
co_investors: Telesystem Space, Luxembourg Future Fund, Investissement Quebec, Luxembourg Space Sector Development Fund (SES-backed)
robotnik_take: First commercial space-based SSA constellation (Skylark satellites). Comp to LeoLabs, Slingshot, Privateer. Strategic backers — Telesystem, SES — signal MEO/GEO operator demand for SSA. Later went public via SPAC in 2024.

company_description: French developer of a co-manipulated robotic assistant for total knee arthroplasty. Targets European CE-mark approval for orthopedic surgical robotics.
co_investors: Cap Horn, Bpifrance
robotnik_take: EUR 15M extension brings Series B total to EUR 36M for orthopedic surgical robot maker. Funds development of co-manipulated robotic assistant for total knee arthroplasty ahead of CE-mark.

company_description: Manufactures and operates orbital launch vehicles (Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Starship) and the Starlink low-earth-orbit broadband satellite constellation. Provides launch services to commercial, government, and NASA customers and direct-to-consumer satellite internet.
co_investors: Founders Fund, Sequoia, Gigafund
robotnik_take: Largest private space round of Q1 2023; valued at $137B. Reinforces SpaceX dominance over public peers like RKLB (~$2B mkt cap) and ASTS.

company_description: Chinese manufacturer of 6-inch silicon carbide (SiC) wafers using the HTCVD growth process. Targets the domestic Chinese SiC substrate market as part of the country's drive for self-sufficiency versus Wolfspeed and Coherent (formerly II-VI).
robotnik_take: 6-inch SiC wafer manufacturer using HTCVD process. Funded amid China's drive for domestic substrate self-sufficiency vs. Wolfspeed/II-VI Western incumbents.
